chapters.title: Chapter 4451 Obtaining the Extreme Cold Pearl
paragraphs: After circling around the coral forest for a while, Ling Han finally charged out with the Blue Star Princess in tow.
Not far away, the blue screen of light could already be clearly seen.

"Let's go there," Ling Han said. Since Sha Tongyu and Sha Yuanxing were both here, he only had to bring the Blue Star Princess there. What need was there for him to waste his energy to go to the palace?
The Blue Star Princess was also very curious about the progress of the battle, and hurriedly nodded.
The area covered by this light screen was very large. After circling around for a while, Ling Han finally saw the ongoing great battle inside.
Jiao Yuan, who had once been arrogant and haughty, was now riddled with wounds. Not only had he lost an arm, but his body was also riddled with wounds, all of which had pierced through his body.
He was close to his end.

Jiao Yuan kept trying to break out of the siege, but the blue light screen blocked him. Though cracks appeared on the light screen with each punch, and it could be broken with a few more punches, how could Sha Tongyu and his brother possibly give him the chance to attack the light screen calmly?
Under the terrifying attack, Jiao Yuan had no choice but to parry.
Once Jiao Yuan returned to the battle zone, the light screen would automatically mend itself under the effects of the formation, which meant that everything had gone back to square one.
Thus, Jiao Yuan was a trapped beast, and death for him was only a matter of time.
And if it was not for the fact that Sha Tongyu and his brother did not want to pay too high a price, they would have long since killed Jiao Yuan.
Ling Han withdrew his gaze, and turned to look elsewhere.
Not far away, Jiao Delei and the other elites of the Underworld Nation were also surrounded. The elites of the Blue Star Nation were all mobilized, and even Sea Alligator Zhang was among them.
Sixteen Sect Masters versus six; the conclusion was already very clear.
Ling Han chuckled, and walked forwards with the Blue Star Princess in tow.
"Everyone, I've rescued Her Highness!" he said as he walked. "Since everyone is here, I'll leave her here."
Seeing Ling Han and the Blue Star Princess walk over, Jiao Delei and the others all looked furious.
How could they not understand by now? This was the trap that the Blue Star Nation had dug for them, and the most important chess piece was the Blue Star Princess.

It could be said that without the disappearance of the Blue Star Princess, there wouldn't have been so many elites from the Underworld Nation, giving the Blue Star Nation a chance to get rid of them all in one go.
It was too late for regrets.
"B*tch, you're going to die a horrible death!" Jiao Delei said through gritted teeth.
"How dare you!" The generals of the Blue Star Nation all rebuked. This was their future queen.
At first, they had been facing off against each other, but because of these words, they immediately began fighting again.

Ling Han also charged into the battle. Though the Celestial Qi contained in the kind of fruit of cultivation of a Sect Master was limited, and was not pure, Celestial Qi was too hard to find. Having it was better than having none.
"Die!" Jiao Delei roared as he glared at Ling Han. He didn't care about anything else, and he simply unleashed his full power at Ling Han.
"He, you're dreaming." Ling Han unleashed a cold punch. Wrapped in Destructive Energy, he instantly suppressed Jiao Delei to the point of being unable to fight back.
Without the help of a Spirit Tool, how could Jiao Delei possibly be a match for Ling Han? Under Ling Han's fists, he retreated continuously.

Among the generals of the Blue Star Nation, aside from Sea Alligator Zhang, the others had not witnessed Ling Han's battle prowess. At first, they were still puzzled. A mere Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator actually dared to barge into a battle at Sect Master-level. Just how tired of living was he?
But only now did they know that this human was actually heaven-defyingly strong!
Weng!

Ling Han selectively blasted out murderous aura attacks, instantly causing the generals of the Underworld Nation to cry out in pain. Even that Seven Stars sharkman showed an expression of pain, unable to resist.

Although the generals of the Blue Star Nation were confused and baffled, they were experienced in the battlefield, so how could they possibly miss such a good opportunity? Naturally, they took advantage of the opening to make a move.
Sixteen against six, one side was already on the upper hand, what more with Ling Han's full-power help?
Peng, peng, peng! With this round of attacks, they immediately killed one of Jiao Delei and his group, while another two were severely injured, practically losing their battle prowess.
The moment Ling Han made his move, the outcome of the battle was instantly decided.
Although Jiao Delei and the others would definitely be destroyed in the end, their stubborn resistance would definitely cause a certain amount of damage to the generals of the Blue Star Nation.
Now, with the addition of Ling Han, they could eliminate the enemy without any damage. This effect was shocking, wasn't it?

Jiao Delei released a furious roar of despair, but it was useless. Under the effects of the murderous aura, Ling Han didn't need to make a move at all. Sea Alligator Zhang and the others attacked with all their might, and very soon, Jiao Delei and the others were all killed.
Ling Han moved very quickly, and took away the fruits of cultivation of these elites of the Sea Race one by one.
Sea Alligator Zhang and the others gritted their teeth. This human was really not reserved at all.
However, with Ling Han's existence, they had indeed killed their opponents without paying any price. This was also the reward that Ling Han deserved.
"Ah!" At this moment, Jiao Yuan was finally killed as well. A Venerate Tier elite died in battle, and a powerful shockwave spread out, traveling far and wide.
"Jiao Ming will soon find out about Jiao Yuan's death. With his personality, he will definitely launch a wave of attacks," Sha Yuanxing said.
"M-hm," Sha Tongyu replied with a nod. "However, he's only one person, after all. Moreover, he's also missing many generals, so we can definitely block him."
"Congratulations, Your Majesty!" Sea Alligator Zhang and the other generals all half-knelt, their faces filled with joy.
As it turned out, the king and his brother had not fallen out with each other. This was all a trap.
Now, the Blue Star Nation no longer had to worry about being bullied by the Underworld Nation.
Sha Tongyu raised his hand, indicating for everyone to rise, while his eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Even when they had been battling fiercely just now, he still had the spare energy to divide a portion of his attention to Ling Han.

This was truly a terrifying human. He was clearly only in the Spirit Transformation Tier, yet possessed battle prowess on the level of Sect Master. In fact, he even had some mysterious means that could affect a large number of Sect Masters.
"Very good, you saved the princess," he said. With a wave of his hand, a bead instantly shot towards Ling Han.
Extreme Cold Pearl.
Ling Han stretched out a hand to catch it, and said with a smile, "Many thanks, Lord Monarch. Then, I shall take my leave."

He had no interest in participating in the battle between the members of the Sea Race. For him, the most important thing was to increase his cultivation level, so that he could advance into the ranks of Sect Masters.

"Not staying?" Seeing Ling Han leave, Sha Yuanxing said with a smile, "Though this human is only a Spirit Transformation Tier, he has the ability to influence the outcome of a battle between Sect Masters. If we can absorb him into our ranks, when we resist the counterattack of the Underworld Nation, our casualties would be even smaller."

"This is a matter of the Sea Race, after all. Moreover, that human is filled with pride, so he may not listen to us," Sha Tongyu said. "That's good too. As long as he doesn't help the Underworld Nation, victory is still in our grasp."

"True." Sha Yuanxing nodded. Now that the Underworld Nation was short of a Venerate Tier, ten Sect Masters, and the high-end battle prowess of their ranks was directly halved. If the Blue Star Nation still couldn't deal with this, then they really didn't have the right to exist.
"Let's go back. We need to make some preparations to face Jiao Ming's counterattack," Sha Tongyu said. "You haven't returned home for many years."
"Haha, all right!" Sha Yuanxing nodded.
The two elites walked side by side. The Blue Star Princess naturally had the protection of the generals, so there was no need to worry that they would really encounter bandits.

chapters.title: Chapter 4452 Finally Becoming Sect Master
paragraphs: Ling Han didn't care about the revenge from the Underworld Nation.
He did not return to the main city of the Blue Star Nation. Instead, he found a coral bush nearby, and after hiding inside, began to refine the Extreme Cold Pearl.
As the Imperial Scroll channelled, endless energy surged over, as well as a sliver of Celestial Qi.

Previously, though Ling Han had extracted the Celestial Qi of the six Sect Masters, they were all negligible. They had indeed improved the dimensions in his body slightly, but they were still far from saturating the dimensions.
And now, there was also Celestial Qi nurturing and increasing the strength of the dimensions inside his body.
Invigorating.
This feeling was really comfortable. It was like he was soaking in a hot spring, and every single pore on his body had opened up.
And what made Ling Han even happier was the fact that under the nourishment of this sliver of Celestial Qi, the dimensions in his body were also gradually becoming saturated.
It was finally about to be completed.
Sect Master-level was really close at hand.
Ling Han hurriedly suppressed his excitement, and continued to absorb Celestial Qi.
Two days later, the Celestial Qi was completely absorbed, and Ling Han smiled.
Success.
"After so many days of battle, my accumulation is already enough."

He had long since reached the peak stage of the Spirit Transformation Tier. The only thing missing was that the dimensions in his body weren't perfect enough, so he no longer needed to accumulate comprehension of this cultivation level.
Furthermore, the opponents he was fighting now were all at the level of Sect Master, so the experience he had accumulated was enough.
"Begin breaking through to Minor Advanced Tier!"
Ling Han sat in a cross-legged position. He released the hold on his cultivation level, and allowed it to soar madly.
Regulations of heaven and earth appeared, one after another. Ling Han actually "saw" a higher level dimension.

The energy of heaven and earth had dimensions, and the level of energy that could be absorbed and converted into mystical power was the lowest. It was parallel to this world, and was in the same dimension. And higher level energy was in a higher dimension. This could not be touched, and could only be sensed through divine sense.
Why did one need Spirit Diagrams?
The Spirit Diagram was to sense the path corresponding to the higher level energy of the dimension. Without this path, the divine sense would not be able to touch this kind of dimension.
Ling Han could see higher level dimensions now because he was in the process of breaking through. After he completely broke through, it would be impossible for him to enter into this state again.

And the so-called Spirit Diagram, was it that when predecessors had broken through to the level of Sect Master and Venerate Tier, they had glimpsed high-dimensional energy, and subsequently deduced it in reverse, and thus grasped the corresponding high-level energy?

Ling Han discovered that as he was currently breaking through to the Minor Advanced Tier, he could only see six levels of high-level energy. There was no seven, eight, or nine-star high-level energy, and if it was Destructive Energy, there was even less need to mention it.

Every kind of high-level energy was in the corresponding high-level dimension, and they were clearly separated. However, there were also some energy that were exceptions. They were extremely unstable. At one moment, they would be in this dimension, and at another, they would be in that dimension, changing indefinitely.
Celestial Qi!
Ling Han immediately understood why Celestial Qi could be used to nurture the fruit of cultivation, but other high-level energy couldn't?

Because this kind of energy was extremely unstable, and did not have a fixed dimension, when it entered into a normal dimension and could be captured, it would naturally be absorbed just like ordinary energy.
However, Celestial Qi itself belonged to a higher level, so it was naturally awesome.
The first step to breaking through to Minor Advanced Tier and forming the fruit of cultivation!

The fruit of cultivation was the understanding of martial arts, and the grasp of the essence of heaven and earth. After forming the fruit of cultivation, the speed of channeling Regulations would be ten times or even a hundred times faster than Spirit Transformation Tier.
Why was Sect Master able to suppress Spirit Transformation Tier?

A Sect Master was able to summon Regulations with a single move, and turn them into an attack. His speed was ten to a hundred times faster than a Spirit Transformation Tier, so this naturally was a one-sided suppression. Of course, a Sect Master was also completely superior to Spirit Transformation Tier in terms of power.

Ling Han had already walked his own path. Thus, he only needed to bury this knowledge and turn it into a Tree of Dao, then nourish it with Celestial Qi, and produce the fruit of cultivation. When the fruit of cultivation ripened, it would transform into Fourth Extreme, and that would be Venerate Tier-level.
In his mind, a small dot of light appeared. This was the seed of the fruit of cultivation.
Inside Ling Han's body, an earthshaking change happened.
The formation of this dot of light signified that Ling Han had taken the most crucial step, and had already advanced into Minor Advanced Tier.
However, precisely because of this, Ling Han's divine sense could no longer see the energy in the high-dimensional space.

It didn't matter. With the Spirit Diagram, he could extract energy from the high-level dimension, and with the Celestial Qi, as long as it appeared in this space, he would be able to sense it and capture it.
"Previously, I was equivalent to a Five Star Sect Master, and now that I have truly advanced into the level of Sect Master, how strong would I be?"
Ling Han casually raised his hand, and waves of power surged. Regulations materialized in his hand, forming God Tools, ferocious beasts, and various other forms.
"The greatest improvement is still the use of Regulations. Power has only increased by one star, at most," Ling Han murmured.

In truth, his power had long since reached the level of Sect Master, and the height of five stars at that. Thus, after he had truly broken through to the level of Sect Master, the increase in power was not as great as he had imagined.
However, the speed at which he channelled Regulations was even faster, far surpassing the level of an ordinary Sect Master. This was the greatest boost to his battle prowess.
"The higher the cultivation level, the smaller the advantage of power, and the more important the soul is."
Drawing on Regulations naturally belonged to an ability of divine sense, and it was the same for extracting high-level energy. At this point, the importance of divine sense was further highlighted.
"Remodel the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower."
"Then, go and find Guan Xinghan, and the others to call them to account!"

Ling Han began to reconstruct the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. He used the Sect Master-level Regulations to refine the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon. Endless high-level energy was extracted and transformed into Dao Flames.
After a whole ten days, he finally stopped.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was already Six Stars. Moreover, this was forged from Origin Gold, and by itself, it possessed great might. Even if Ling Han had just advanced to the Minor Advanced Tier, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could still be considered the strongest six-star Spirit Tool.
"Let's go!"
He stood up and returned to the main city of the Blue Star Nation.
However, when he arrived, he shockingly discovered that all the outsiders had left.
—The Blue Star Princess had already been rescued, so what was the point of everyone staying here?

On the other side, the Underworld Nation was unwilling to accept this great loss, and launched a great battle, but their high-end battle prowess was severely damaged, causing them to lose this battle, and they had no choice but to retreat back to the main city of the Underworld Nation.

At present, this sea belonged to the Blue Star Nation, at least for the next tens of thousands of years, unless a prodigy from the Underworld Nation rose up strongly and turned the situation around single-handedly.
Ling Han hurriedly moved, and continued onwards.
A dozen over days later, he entered into the territory of the Underworld Nation.
He kept a very low profile. After all, Jiao Delei ultimately died by his hand. If his father knew that he was passing by, would he let him go so easily?
Another seven days later, he had already left the main city of the Underworld Nation far behind.
Now, he had nothing to worry about.
Ling Han used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, but this time, he shockingly discovered that there were trajectories in space. When he followed these trajectories, his speed instantly spiked tenfold.
This was the true Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.

On the other side, the Underworld Nation was unwilling to accept this great loss, and launched a great battle, but their high-end battle prowess was severely damaged, causing them to lose this battle, and they had no choice but to retreat back to the main city of the Underworld Nation.

At present, this sea belonged to the Blue Star Nation, at least for the next tens of thousands of years, unless a prodigy from the Underworld Nation rose up strongly and turned the situation around single-handedly.
Ling Han hurriedly moved, and continued onwards.
A dozen over days later, he entered into the territory of the Underworld Nation.
He kept a very low profile.
After all, Jiao Delei ultimately died by his hand.
If his father knew that he was passing by, would he let him go so easily?
Another seven days later, he had already left the main city of the Underworld Nation far behind.
Now, he had nothing to worry about.
Ling Han used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, but this time, he shockingly discovered that there were trajectories in space.
When he followed these trajectories, his speed instantly spiked tenfold.
This was the true Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.

chapters.title: Chapter 4453 Waterfall
paragraphs: A smile appeared on Ling Han's face.
After advancing into Minor Advanced Tier, everything was different.
Why was it that Minor Advanced Tiers could be called great elites, while Spirit Transformation Tiers couldn't?
Taking this step, the true qualitative change was not power, but rather the grasp of the Regulations of heaven and earth.
Xiu, Ling Han's figure continued to speed up. In fact, even his physical body was faintly aching.

Ling Han didn't dare to speed up any further. After reaching this kind of high speed, the Regulations transformed into blades that slashed at his body. If he was any faster, his body would be forcefully sliced into pieces.
This surprised him. Even with his physique, he couldn't withstand running at full speed?
No wonder it was said that Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was not only a movement technique, but also an offensive technique.
Invigorating!

Ling Han thought internally. In future, he was completely capable of capturing someone, and just like that, he would be able to run as fast as lightning, and who knew how many people would be able to hold up against that.

Three days later, he exited the sea, and there was a plain ahead of him. After walking for another two days, he could see a massive waterfall from afar, crashing down from the skies. Even at such a far distance, he seemed to be able to hear the loud splashes of waves.
After seeing the waterfall, and then truly arriving at the foot of the waterfall, Ling Han still spent a day's time, which showed how colossal this waterfall was.

Ling Han surveyed the surroundings. The waterfall was cascading down, forming a wide river, and there were many people standing at the banks of the river at the foot of the waterfall. They were all outsiders who had entered this time.

However, Ling Han did not see such Golden Generations like Guan Xinghan, or Liu Xiyun. Nor was there that crazy woman, Feng Miaoling. Even the Silver Generations and ordinary Imperial Sons were missing.

Someone was currently charging against the waterfall, all the way upwards, but in their rush, they had lost their momentum, and were washed down by the waterfall. Then, they were washed far away by the rapid flow of the river, and only then did they manage to climb out of the river and onto the bank.
Ling Han walked over and asked the others about the situation.
Seeing that it was Ling Han, the person who was questioned immediately shivered, and explained the situation in full detail.
As it turned out, if one wanted to go to the next stage, they would have to go against the flow of the waterfall. That was the only path there.
Should he directly fly into the sky, and then take a shortcut?
No, some people did indeed want to take a shortcut, but in the end, they were killed by the terrifying Regulations.
This was the Imperial Path, and only those with the strongest abilities, talent, and determination could pass through. Otherwise, wouldn't the Imperial Path be undeserving of its name?
Thus, after arriving here, the majority of Dao Child cultivators were also blocked, unable to advance any further.
Those who were lucky naturally obtained great fortune, and those who were unlucky... hoho, that was all they could do.
"Ling Han is here!"
Instantly, whispers spread out. Everyone looked over, focusing their gazes on Ling Han.
"If it's Ling Han... there shouldn't be any problem, right?"
"There's definitely no problem. The impact of this waterfall varies from person to person. The higher one's cultivation level, the greater the force they'll sustain."
"Sigh, I really want to know. He's clearly in the Spirit Transformation Tier, but why is his battle prowess so terrifying?"
"Hehe, if you know, then wouldn't you be able to become a second Ling Han?"
"Who knows how many Imperial Clan elites wanted to capture him and snatch his secret, but what happened? Do you know how many Imperial Sons this guy killed?"
Everyone was envious. It was clear that Ling Han had only come from the Holy Land, but why was he a hundred times, or a thousand times more outstanding than them?
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back and looked at the waterfall. Just as he was about to leap in, he paused slightly.
He dismissed the idea of charging into the waterfall, and instead continued to size up this waterfall.

Shua, right at this moment, a flash of sword light suddenly appeared out of thin air, slashing towards Ling Han's neck. The Regulations condensed and entwined around the blade of the sword, endlessly increasing the destructive power of this strike.
Strange Shadow Steps, assassin from the Battle God Palace
The attacker... was shockingly a Sect Master, and an eight-star Sect Master at that.

If Ling Han was still a Tenth Change, then if he did not react in advance, then even if he possessed a supreme movement technique like Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he would still be beheaded by this strike, and would not be able to dodge at all.
But now... hehe.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and grabbed out. Pa, the blade of the sword was grasped in his hand.

"Why do you guys always like to deliver yourselves to be killed when my cultivation level increases?" Ling Han shook his head. At present, he was a One Star Sect Master, and if it was battle prowess, even he himself did not know how strong he had become.

The Sect Master-level assassin faltered upon hearing this. He hadn't expected Ling Han's reaction to be so quick. Moreover, Ling Han's power was also so great that he could even block this sneak attack.
"Minor Advanced Tier elite!" The assassin was astonished. He hadn't imagined that Ling Han would actually break through at such a critical moment.
Realization instantly dawned on him. No wonder Ling Han had come so late. Previously, he must have hidden somewhere to break through.
"Damn it!" He abandoned his sword without hesitation, turned around and fled.
As a qualified assassin, he had always believed in leaving after a single strike, and definitely did not want to linger in battle.
"Can you leave?" Ling Han threw a punch. Boom! Regulations shot out casually, turning into a rope that bound the assassin.
There was a flash of cold light, and the assassin drew another sword, slashing out at the rope of Regulations.
Peng!
The sword struck down, and the rope of Regulations actually did not break.

The assassin was astonished. Although the sword in his hand wasn't a Spirit Tool, it was forged from Six Star materials. After he activated it, it was powerful enough to unleash the might of a nine-star Sect Master, yet it was still unable to slice through Ling Han's Regulations.

This young man's rate of growth was really too fast. It had only been a hundred years, and he had already advanced into Sect Master Tier, which was comparable to the Golden Generation. And in terms of battle prowess of the same tier, even the Golden Generation could only stare in dumbfounded shock.

He had not entered into the Imperial Path deliberately to kill Ling Han. Instead, his main purpose was to contend for the great opportunity, but since he had seen Ling Han, there was naturally no reason for him not to make a move.
However, the result made him feel great regret.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and casually waved his fists. However, it was as if the heaven and earth were responding to him. The Regulations bloomed like flowers.
The assassin was astounded.
How was the strength of a Sect Master judged?
Power was a part of it, but aside from that, there was another more important factor, and that was Regulations.

Ordinarily speaking, a One Star Sect Master could only draw on one type of Regulations. If one wanted to draw on two types, three types, or even more Regulations, he would need to accumulate them over a long period of time. Of course, if he took too long to accumulate them, the Regulations that had been formed the earliest would dissipate. There was a limit to this, and one could not accumulate Regulations forever.
Ling Han threw out a punch so quickly. Logically speaking, he should only be able to deliver a Six Star Regulations, but what did he see? Regulations were blooming like flowers!
How many Regulations did this have to be?
Nine... fifteen.
The assassin knew very well that he could condense ten Regulations in an instant, surpassing the ordinary eight-star Sect Master, yet he was still unable to compare to Ling Han?
This was too freakish!
He hurriedly parried with his sword, not daring to be struck by Ling Han at all. Otherwise, with so many Regulations unleashed at the same time, even if he did not die, he would be severely injured.
However, even though they were both clashes of six-star Regulations, there was no qualitative difference. In that case, those with more numbers would definitely have an advantage.
Boom!
In the exchange of blows, the Regulations of that assassin were completely annihilated, and Ling Han still had four left. They turned into four Divine Swords, and continued to slash out.

chapters.title: Chapter 4454 Killing the Eight Star Sect Master
paragraphs: The assassin was shocked, and hurriedly dodged.
"How could you possibly be so strong!" He paid a small price to dodge this attack, and a wound appeared on his arm.
This was too inconceivable. This was merely a One Star Sect Master, and he could actually condense fourteen streaks of Regulations in a single strike. Who would believe this?
All around them, everyone was also dumbfounded.

Those prodigies who had not broken through to the level of Sect Master were still fine, but those prodigies that were already on the level of Sect Master were all gritting their teeth. They knew very well how difficult it was to deliver a punch with fourteen flashes of Regulations.
Sect Masters below five stars didn't even need to think about it, and for those above five stars, they would need a little time to accumulate. It definitely couldn't be done in an instant.
So, what kind of monster was this?
Ling Han merely smiled. The reason why he was so freakish was naturally because his divine sense was too perfect and too powerful.

In the first place, his divine sense had already surpassed the level of an ordinary Sect Master, and after crossing to the Other Side, his divine sense had also reached perfection. Afterwards, it was further purified. Who could compare to the quality of this kind of soul?
The stronger and more perfect the divine sense, the faster the speed of sensing and extracting the Regulations of heaven and earth would be.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "That's right. I'm also curious. How can others live with themselves if I am so powerful?"
F***, this was showing off.
But in truth, Ling Han indeed had the right to do so.
A freak like him, was there a second one in this world?
"Even the Golden Generation can't compare!"
"Perhaps, Yang Yihuan or Myriad Dao can."
"That's right, there's also these two freaks!"
Though everyone admitted that they were no match for Ling Han, based on simple jealousy, they wracked their brains to think of competitors for Ling Han, refusing to admit that he was invincible.
The assassin roared, and tried his best to break out of the siege.
However, this was all in vain.

In terms of power of Regulations, he was Eight Stars, while Ling Han was only Five Stars. In reality, he was on the upper hand. However, in terms of Regulations, Ling Han could unleash 14 Regulations with a single strike, while he could only unleash 10. Moreover, Ling Han was overwhelming him.
Thus, both of them had their own advantages, and for the moment, it was hard to decide the victor.
Ling Han entered into a prime state, and used the Han Fists. Instantly, his battle prowess spiked madly.

Previously, when he had battled against a Great Emperor ar the same cultivation level, it was clear that their power levels were completely equal, but it was still the Great Emperor of the same cultivation level that had emerged victorious, suppressing Ling Han to the point that he did not have any temper. Why? That was simple. Every Great Emperor had walked their own path. Thus, so what if their power levels were the same?
It was the same now. Ling Han had already begun to walk his own path. Though he had not reached the height of a Great Emperor, his opponent was still no Great Emperor.
Very soon, he had the upper hand.
A dead silence fell.
A One Star Sect Master could crush Eight Stars!
Heavens, who could believe this?

When one had reached the level of Minor Advanced Tier, martial artists could be called great elites, and there was a gulf between a One Star Sect Master and a Two Star Sect Master. Practically no one could fight above their cultivation level.
It could not be helped. For those that could become great elites, which one of them was not a prodigy among prodigies?
Since both of them were prodigies, why was it that you could battle with a disadvantage in cultivation level?
Thus, Ling Han's performance was simply inconceivable. His freakishness was unbelievable.
However, reality was reality. Under Ling Han's barrage of punches, the assassin was practically unable to fight back.
Seeing that the situation was not good, the assassin began to try breaking out of the siege at all costs.
He would rather sustain severe injuries than die.
Ling Han smiled, and couldn't be bothered to waste any more time. He activated his murderous aura.
Weng!
"Ah!" The assassin immediately grabbed his head and screamed. He felt as if his mind was about to explode, and his seven apertures were all covered with blood.
Ling Han caught up to him, and attacked aggressively.

The assassin barely managed to counterattack, but under the suppression of the murderous aura, he couldn't organize a decent counterattack at all. The wounds on his body increased in number and became heavier.
After a few dozen more moves, he was forcefully killed.

Everyone looked at Ling Han with reverent gazes. This guy was already capable of killing an Eight Stars Sect Master. Then, aside from Lin Xuan and a limited few members of the Golden Generation that had advanced into Venerate Tier, who else would be able to suppress him?
Would this era belong to this young man?

Ling Han didn't collect the fruit of cultivation from this assassin. Firstly, the assassin was a human, so it would be too much of a conflict for him to dissect his own kind and use their parts. Secondly, he had already advanced to the level of Sect Master, so he needed pure, high-quality Celestial Qi to nourish the fruit of cultivation.
He ignored the reactions of the others. Instead, he stood up and entered the waterfall.
Boom! A devastating power instantly surged over, with Regulations transforming into small swords that slashed at his body, yearning to tear him into pieces.

Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen. As he advanced to the level of Sect Master, the Starlight Screen also underwent a qualitative change, fusing with the Regulations and further improving its defenses.
Regulations against Regulations, both sides were Six Stars, and Ling Han was unafraid.
This small swords of Regulations were continuously and endlessly washing over Ling Han's body. It was as if there were three, or even five, Sect Masterstaking turns to attack Ling Han.
If it was another One Star Sect Master, he would definitely collapse very quickly.
One against three to five, how was he supposed to block?
However, Ling Han could condense fourteen flashes of Regulations with a casual strike, so what was this worth against him?
Going against the flow, he charged towards the top of the waterfall.
After charging up for a while, the impact of the waterfall suddenly increased, and the strength of small swords of Regulations also increased accordingly.
Ling Han merely smiled, and did not throw a punch. He still used the Starlight Screen to block.
It was enough.
This rendered everyone speechless. It wasn't like they hadn't attempted to go against the flow of the waterfall before. What was the result?
Looking at Ling Han again, he hadn't made a move yet. It was too easy for him.
When he had charged halfway, the impact increased further, and the small swords formed by one streak of Regulation had also turned into three!
This was a little terrifying. Under the continuous barrage of attacks, even Ling Han had no choice but to become slightly more alert, brandishing his fists to disperse the attacks.
Charge, charge, charge again.
Three quarters, four-fifths, nine-tenths!

Ling Han was already nearing the top of the waterfall. At this moment, the impact had reached the level of a Four-Star Sect Master. The small swords of Regulations had also formed into four streaks. This was enough to make 99% of One Star Sect Masters despair.
However, Ling Han was still at ease, easily reaching the end.
There was a black door of light in the center of the waterfall ahead of him.
Was this the Transference Portal that would lead to the next area?
Ling Han thought to himself, yet he rushed over without hesitation, and entered into the doorway of light.
Instantly, a mysterious power took effect, and space changed.
When Ling Han took another step, he actually appeared in the desert.
He didn't immediately move. Instead, he closed his eyes and sensed this area.
He still couldn't sense the ley lines.

Ling Han shook his head. This made him unable to use the Star Steps, but that was all right. He had now grasped the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. This was the strongest movement technique in the world, so wasn't it enough?
He walked forwards. Since he was not familiar with this place, he was not bothered either. He simply headed in a specific direction.
After walking for three days, a castle appeared ahead of him.
He walked over, and as his eyes swept over the surroundings, he couldn't help but feel surprised.

One against three to five, how was he supposed to block?
However, Ling Han could condense fourteen flashes of Regulations with a casual strike, so what was this worth against him?
Going against the flow, he charged towards the top of the waterfall.
After charging up for a while, the impact of the waterfall suddenly increased, and the strength of small swords of Regulations also increased accordingly.
Ling Han merely smiled, and did not throw a punch.
He still used the Starlight Screen to block.
It was enough.
This rendered everyone speechless.
It wasn't like they hadn't attempted to go against the flow of the waterfall before.
What was the result?
Looking at Ling Han again, he hadn't made a move yet.
It was too easy for him.
When he had charged halfway, the impact increased further, and the small swords formed by one streak of Regulation had also turned into three!
This was a little terrifying.
Under the continuous barrage of attacks, even Ling Han had no choice but to become slightly more alert, brandishing his fists to disperse the attacks.
Charge, charge, charge again.
Three quarters, four-fifths, nine-tenths!
Ling Han was already nearing the top of the waterfall.
At this moment, the impact had reached the level of a Four-Star Sect Master.
The small swords of Regulations had also formed into four streaks.
This was enough to make 99% of One Star Sect Masters despair.
However, Ling Han was still at ease, easily reaching the end.
There was a black door of light in the center of the waterfall ahead of him.
Was this the Transference Portal that would lead to the next area?
Ling Han thought to himself, yet he rushed over without hesitation, and entered into the doorway of light.
Instantly, a mysterious power took effect, and space changed.
When Ling Han took another step, he actually appeared in the desert.
He didn't immediately move.
Instead, he closed his eyes and sensed this area.
He still couldn't sense the ley lines.
Ling Han shook his head.
This made him unable to use the Star Steps, but that was all right.
He had now grasped the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
This was the strongest movement technique in the world, so wasn't it enough?
He walked forwards.
Since he was not familiar with this place, he was not bothered either.
He simply headed in a specific direction.
After walking for three days, a castle appeared ahead of him.
He walked over, and as his eyes swept over the surroundings, he couldn't help but feel surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 4455: Brother Monkey appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The people here were all outsiders, but there were more than a thousand of them.
—Just how many people had been stuck at the waterfall previously?
Yet there were more than a thousand people here. What did that mean?
More people who had taken other rainbow bridges had gathered here. In fact, all those who had taken different rainbow bridges would be gathered here.
“Ling Han!” A cold voice rang out. Lin Xuan stepped over. The Venerate Tier aura surged, and standing in front of Ling Han, he was like a lion that was staring at a weak lamb.
This kind of comparison of strength was completely one-sided.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! More Imperial Sons appeared. There were Golden Generation Imperial Sons, Silver Generation Imperial Sons, and ordinary Imperial Sons.
Being able to become the Imperial Son, if one did not even have the ability to pass through the Imperial Path, that would really be too inferior.
Aside from them, there was also Myriad Dao, Origin and Ding Shu, but He Luo and Yang Yihuan were still absent.
With their strength, how could it be that they couldn’t even make it here?
Of course, that was impossible. Thus, there could only be one reason, and that was the passageway corresponding to the rainbow bridge that they had taken had not opened yet.
This was very normal. For example, on the seven islands on the sea, everyone had to work together. It did not mean that anyone with overwhelming battle prowess would definitely be fast.
Or perhaps they had entered the Imperial Path many times, and gone to some special place.
Feng Miaoling was present, but she did not make a move. She merely hugged her sword sheath, and looked coldly at those Imperial Sons.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What is it? It’s been a long time. Have you missed me?”

“You’re already at death’s door, and you still dare to be so arrogant?” Guan Xinghan sneered. Although he was a whole major tier lower than Lin Xuan, he was also a Golden Generation, so he didn’t appear weak in front of Lin Xuan.

Because if he wanted to, he could completely advance into Venerate Tier in a short period of time. However, he wanted to be stronger, and that was why he was slowly polishing his cultivation at Minor Advanced Tier.
Ling Han glanced at him and said, “The adults speak, so kids should shut up. Don’t you know the rules?”
Guan Xinghan was instantly seething with anger. His eyes were baleful, and he felt an urge to attack.
“Ling Han, you are really a centipede,” Lin Xuan said calmly, “You have clearly been blocked from Imperial Path, yet you can still appear in front of me. This is really a shock to me.”

Seeing that Lin Xuan had no intention of immediately making a move, Guan Xingxuan didn’t dare to overstep his boundaries. After all, he was a Venerate Tier elite, so appropriate respect was still necessary.
‘Are you saying that I won’t die, or that my vitality is tenacious?’
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “There are still many things that surprise you!”
Lin Xuan ignored him, and continued, “However, you are too stupid. You clearly know that I want to kill you, yet still dare to appear in front of me. This is practically courting death!”
Ling Han’s smile remained unchanged, but thoughts raced through his mind.

When it came to battle prowess, even if he had the Saint Tool in hand, it was still impossible for him to match the Venerate Tier elite. It could not be helped. Limited by his cultivation level, the Saint Tool could not unleash its strongest might.
So, the only option was to run?

Even if he couldn’t use the Star Steps, Ling Han was confident that with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight’s extreme speed, allowing him to have the advantage of a major tier even in front of an Imperial Son. He wouldn’t be afraid of a Venerate Tier.
However, he had just advanced into the ranks of Sect Masters, and was just about to kill everyone in his way, when a Venerate Tier appeared. Was someone playing around with him?
“Which b@stard dares to bully Old Sun’s brother?” At this moment, a voice filled with violence suddenly sounded.
Ling Han immediately looked pleasantly surprised, and looked towards the source of the voice, “Brother Monkey!”
This voice was none other than Brother Monkey!
Everyone also followed Ling Han’s gaze, their faces filled with surprise.
At this time, there was actually someone who dared to help Ling Han?
Didn’t he know that Ling Han’s opponent was the Golden Generation, and a Venerate Tier at that? Moreover, it was not just one even?
The people in front of him all stepped aside, and then a monkey with the face of a thunder god appeared.
Who else could it be but Brother Monkey?

Right now, Brother Monkey was dressed in a suit of golden armor. There was also a crimson cloak wrapped around his back, and he held a black metal staff in his hand. However, there were nine golden threads on each end of the metal staff.
Brother Monkey cocked his head, and the staff in his hand was already raised, pointing directly at Lin Xuan.
This attitude was too provocative, exuding a monstrous viciousness.
Lin Xuan also looked over, and couldn’t help but raise his eyes in surprise.
A Venerate Tier elite!
This was actually a Venerate Tier elite.

It wasn’t rare for Venerate Tier elites to appear. Merely the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan had around 20 Venerate Tiers, and if one looked all over the world, to say nothing of tens of thousands of Venerate Tiers, there would definitely be a few thousand.
However, those that could enter the Imperial Path were extremely rare.

As far as he knew, there was only himself, Imperial Son Ming, and Imperial Son Tian. Because there was still a relative age limit for entering into the Imperial Path, Venerate Tier elites had to be under five thousand years old.
But now, another Venerate Tier of the Monkey Race had actually appeared, which naturally surprised him.
“Who are you?” he asked darkly.
However, Brother Monkey didn’t answer. Instead, he charged over and said, “Take a strike from Old Sun’s staff first!”
Boom, the metal rod crashed down like a mountain, no, a mountain did crash down. Regulations intertwined, indescribably terrifying.
That was how domineering he was. He was not going to play around.
Lin Xuan’s expression also changed drastically. He didn’t dare to face this attack head-on, instead leaping back in retreat.
This staff missed its target, and hit the ground. The ground instantly cracked, and trembled madly, but what was surprising was that the castle ahead of them was unmoved.
However, what was even more shocking was the sturdiness of the ground.
A Venerate Tier elite’s attack actually only cracked the ground, and did not shatter or disintegrate it.
Next, the cracked earth was actually healing, as if it was filled with vitality.
As expected of the Imperial Path. How strange.
Yet Ling Han’s attention was not on this. Instead, he exclaimed in pleasant surprise, “Brother Monkey, you have broken through to Venerate Tier!”
Brother Monkey slung the metal rod over his shoulder, “I have broken through, and rushed to Two Stars at that!”
“Haha!” Ling Han laughed loudly. He was both happy for Brother Monkey, and in his case, he had another powerful helper.
Seeing the two brothers converse, everyone was surprised.
Among the Golden Generation, Lin Xuan, who could be considered the strongest, was actually forced back by a monkey’s staff strike, not daring to face it head-on?
Heavens!

The Imperial Sons all wore solemn expressions, especially the Golden Generation. They were far more familiar with how terrifying Lin Xuan was than the others. Even he didn’t dare to face him head-on, so just how powerful was his opponent?
Lin Xuan frowned. It wasn’t that Brother Monkey was more freakish than him, but that he was at a disadvantage in terms of cultivation level.
Even if he had obtained a considerable number of opportunities in the Imperial Path, he was presently only a One Star Venerate. There was still some time before he could break through.
After all, the higher one’s cultivation level, the more difficult it would be to break through. He needed to accumulate more experience.
“A Two Star Venerate Tier!” he spat out word by word, wariness flickering in his eyes.

If the other was just those ordinary Venerate Tier elites outside, then he wouldn’t care. After all, wouldn’t the Golden Generation be able to battle those one level above them? However, those who could appear here were definitely prodigies among prodigies, especially those at the Venerate Tier. Being able to enter the Imperial Path at such a young age, how awesome was that?
When Brother Monkey had moved just now, he had seen very clearly that there were nine Seven Star Regulations entwined around the metal rod.
Though he was conceited, he was also very clear that after he advanced into Two Stars, he would only be able to fire out nine Seven Star Regulations with a single strike.
Thus, this monkey’s natural talent in cultivation was definitely not inferior to his.
Since that was the case, the difference of a single star was like the difference between heaven and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 4456: Domineering Monkey
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Brother Monkey humphed, and looked at Lin Xuan. “Have you asked Old Sun’s staff for permission to kill my brother?”
This attitude was too disdainful.
Lin Xuan was a Golden Generation elite, so how could he tolerate such contempt?
But after all, there was an obvious gap in strength between them. He had no choice but to suppress the fury in his heart, and asked darkly, “Who are you, sir?”
Such a freakish genius, comparable to the Golden Generation, could it be that he was the same kind of monster as Yang Yihuan?
“Your Grandpa Sun!” Brother Monkey placed the staff on his shoulder. Amidst his strange violence, there was also a kind of shamelessness.
Lin Xuan’s eyes bulged, and he almost burst into action.
This was too despicable. For better or worse, you are a Venerate Tier, so how could you say such shameless words?
“You—” He pointed at Brother Monkey.
“You, what you, eat Old Sun’s staff again!” Brother Monkey had a hot temper, and immediately swung the staff again, completely unreasonable.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The strength of a Two Star Venerate Tier elite was unleashed to his heart’s content. Brother Monkey was incomparably domineering.

Lin Xuan couldn’t contain his anger any longer, and he summoned the Jade Water Sword replica to parry this attack. However, there was a difference of one star between the two of them, so he was instantly sent flying.
Brother Monkey took advantage of the victory to continue the attack. “To dare wound one of Old Sun’s brothers, if I don’t beat you into mush, Old Sun will write my name backwards!”
He was too aggressive. Under the barrage of staff strikes, Lin Xuan was completely unable to match him, and could only dodge left and right.
Everyone was dumbfounded upon seeing this.
This was the Golden Generation. In a situation when their cultivation levels were equal, he actually looked like he was outmatched?

Actually, even the Golden Generation couldn’t possibly be invincible among their peers, but their reputation was too great, making everyone have the misconception that they were invincible among their peers.
Now that the legend had been shattered, everyone was naturally surprised.
“Brother Lin, let me give you a hand!” Imperial Son Ming moved, joining the battle.
“Two Stars versus One Star, this is too unfair. I’ll join too.” Imperial Son Tian also joined the battle.
The three Venerable Tier-level Golden Generation elites teamed up to battle Brother Monkey.

These three people were all One Star Venerate Tier elites, and when they joined forces, their battle prowess had more or less reached Two Stars. Thus, it wasn’t long before the battle situation was stabilized.
Brother Monkey laughed loudly, his heroic spirit soaring. As he brandished the metal rod, there was a terrifying pressure. It was as if a light strike would shatter even a star.
“Saint Tool!” Imperial Son Ming exclaimed in astonishment.

This was no ordinary metal rod, but had been forged from Saintly Material. However, it was only so-so. It was not a Saint Tool, and could not draw on Saint-level Regulations. However, Saintly Material was Saintly Material, after all. When it was brandished, it was extraordinarily heavy, and had terrifying destructive power. One would be severely injured if he even came into contact with it.
Hiss, just how terrifying was this monkey’s strength?
“I know, you’re a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor!” Imperial Son Tian said in a solemn voice.
Battle, Saint, Emperor!
A Great Emperor!
Everyone exclaimed in shock. No wonder Brother Monkey was so awesome. As it turned out, he was actually the descendant of a Great Emperor, and was also the Imperial Son.

“What are you blabbering for? Come fight me!” Brother Monkey’s fighting spirit blazed, and he brandished his staff repeatedly. Regulations and power perfectly fused together, their might shocking the heavens.
He suppressed the three Golden Generations all by himself, and it was only him who could attack. Lin Xuan and the others could only defend.
Everyone was speechless as they watched.
Could it be that this was the end of the legend of the Golden Generation?

Previously, Ling Han had appeared out of nowhere, sniping Imperial Sons all the way, sweeping aside all opposition of the Silver Generation. In the end, there were even two Golden Generations that had been defeated by him.

Fortunately, the two Golden Generations were still at a low cultivation level after all, so he was still unable to shake the foundations of the entire Golden Generation. Now, however? The three most powerful members of the Golden Generation were still being suppressed.

From today onwards, the legend of the Golden Generation was really going to be exposed. For example, Ling Han, Yang Yihuan, and Brother Monkey all came into being aggressively, completely not inferior to the Golden Generation at all. In fact, they were even slightly superior.
Brother Monkey had battled to the point of madness, and was seething with rage. His eyes were about to burst, and his high fighting spirit had solidified, soaring into the heavens!
This stunned everyone. Such fighting spirit had never been seen before.
No wonder Brother Monkey’s ancestor’s title was Battle Saint. He was really a battle maniac, unyielding and forceful.
Brother Monkey gave him a beating. His style of battle was ‘I can be injured, but I will definitely defeat you’.

However, Lin Xuan and the others didn’t want to fight him head-on. If they were injured here, it would obviously affect their subsequent journey on the Imperial Path. Thus, once their morale weakened, they were naturally at an even greater disadvantage.
Thankfully, they were the Golden Generation, after all. With the three of them working together, they could still defend completely. In fact, they even had the vague momentum to counterattack.
Lin Xuan and the others wanted to defend until Brother Monkey’s fighting spirit fell, so that Brother Monkey would take the initiative to ask for peace. In that way, they would naturally be proud.

However, the problem was that Brother Monkey had inherited the courage of his ancestor. Once he started fighting, he didn’t consider the consequences at all. He only had one thought, and that was to determine the victor.

This caused Lin Xuan and the others to be unable to bear it at all. If they continued to fight like this, the three of them would definitely be finished. Of course, Brother Monkey was definitely not much better either. It was very likely that he would die with them.
This was something that they could not accept.
Who were they?
This was the Golden Generation, some of the strongest prodigies among prodigies. They had a high chance of becoming Emperor.
Would they die with Brother Monkey? Or would they be severely injured from the battle, and lose all hope of becoming Emperor?
How could this be!
Thus, the three of them had no choice but to seek peace.
However, Brother Monkey didn’t care at all. “If you guys want to kill Old Sun and my brother, you’ll have to suffer Old Sun’s fury!”
The metal rod swept out, and Brother Monkey became even more deranged.
Helpless, Lin Xuan and the others could only flee. Meanwhile, Brother Monkey gave chase, not allowing the slightest bit of sand to enter his eyes1.
Three fled, while one pursued. In an instant, they had disappeared into the horizon.

The moment the four Venerate Tier elites left, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. This was the only four Venerate Tier elites. With them here, even the other Golden Generation elites would feel suppressed.
“Ling Han!” Guan Xinghan shouted again. His eyes were filled with killing intent as he stared at Ling Han.
Ling Han glanced at him, and asked casually, “What is it? Are you asking for a beating?”
“There’s no one protecting you now, and you still dare to be arrogant?” Guan Xinghan said coldly.
Xiu, Ling Han had already charged out. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, and wherever the flaming wings flapped, they actually formed multiple small firebirds that pounced towards Guan Xinghan.
What, Ling Han actually dared to take the initiative to attack?

Everyone was astonished. It should be known that Guan Xinghan was an Eight Star Sect Master. Although he couldn’t be considered one of the best in the Golden Generation, he was definitely the stronger ones. Thus, Ling Han’s initiative to attack was practically courting death.

“Where did you get such courage from?” Guan Xinghan sneered. He was naturally aware of Ling Han’s strength. Although he was freakishly heaven-defying, possessing strength capable of matching the Five Star Sect Master when he was in the Spirit Transformation Tier, he was neither a Five Star Sect Master nor an ordinary Sect Master!

He stretched out a hand, which turned into a giant palm that grabbed out at Ling Han. It was like it was forged from rock, exuding an ancient aura. There were also streaks of dark veined patterns that interwove to reveal the profound secrets of the heaven and earth.
Humph, Ling Han had been able to act arrogantly in front of him previously completely because of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, but in a head-on confrontation?
Even 10 Ling Hans added together wouldn’t be able to withstand a single strike from him.
‘Die!’
Peng, the phoenix wings swept past, and flames burned the skies. That rock-like hand actually melted rapidly.
‘F*ck!’

It was as if a light strike would shatter even a star.
“Saint Tool!” Imperial Son Ming exclaimed in astonishment.
This was no ordinary metal rod, but had been forged from Saintly Material.
However, it was only so-so.
It was not a Saint Tool, and could not draw on Saint-level Regulations.
However, Saintly Material was Saintly Material, after all.
When it was brandished, it was extraordinarily heavy, and had terrifying destructive power.
One would be severely injured if he even came into contact with it.
Hiss, just how terrifying was this monkey’s strength?
“I know, you’re a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor!” Imperial Son Tian said in a solemn voice.
Battle, Saint, Emperor!
A Great Emperor!
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
No wonder Brother Monkey was so awesome.
As it turned out, he was actually the descendant of a Great Emperor, and was also the Imperial Son.
“What are you blabbering for?
Come fight me!” Brother Monkey’s fighting spirit blazed, and he brandished his staff repeatedly.
Regulations and power perfectly fused together, their might shocking the heavens.
He suppressed the three Golden Generations all by himself, and it was only him who could attack.
Lin Xuan and the others could only defend.
Everyone was speechless as they watched.
Could it be that this was the end of the legend of the Golden Generation?
Previously, Ling Han had appeared out of nowhere, sniping Imperial Sons all the way, sweeping aside all opposition of the Silver Generation.
In the end, there were even two Golden Generations that had been defeated by him.
Fortunately, the two Golden Generations were still at a low cultivation level after all, so he was still unable to shake the foundations of the entire Golden Generation.
Now, however?
The three most powerful members of the Golden Generation were still being suppressed.
From today onwards, the legend of the Golden Generation was really going to be exposed.
For example, Ling Han, Yang Yihuan, and Brother Monkey all came into being aggressively, completely not inferior to the Golden Generation at all.
In fact, they were even slightly superior.
Brother Monkey had battled to the point of madness, and was seething with rage.
His eyes were about to burst, and his high fighting spirit had solidified, soaring into the heavens!
This stunned everyone.
Such fighting spirit had never been seen before.
No wonder Brother Monkey’s ancestor’s title was Battle Saint.
He was really a battle maniac, unyielding and forceful.
Brother Monkey gave him a beating.
His style of battle was ‘I can be injured, but I will definitely defeat you’.
However, Lin Xuan and the others didn’t want to fight him head-on.
If they were injured here, it would obviously affect their subsequent journey on the Imperial Path.
Thus, once their morale weakened, they were naturally at an even greater disadvantage.
Thankfully, they were the Golden Generation, after all.
With the three of them working together, they could still defend completely.
In fact, they even had the vague momentum to counterattack.
Lin Xuan and the others wanted to defend until Brother Monkey’s fighting spirit fell, so that Brother Monkey would take the initiative to ask for peace.
In that way, they would naturally be proud.
However, the problem was that Brother Monkey had inherited the courage of his ancestor.
Once he started fighting, he didn’t consider the consequences at all.
He only had one thought, and that was to determine the victor.
This caused Lin Xuan and the others to be unable to bear it at all.
If they continued to fight like this, the three of them would definitely be finished.
Of course, Brother Monkey was definitely not much better either.
It was very likely that he would die with them.
This was something that they could not accept.
Who were they?
This was the Golden Generation, some of the strongest prodigies among prodigies.
They had a high chance of becoming Emperor.
Would they die with Brother Monkey?
Or would they be severely injured from the battle, and lose all hope of becoming Emperor?
How could this be!
Thus, the three of them had no choice but to seek peace.
However, Brother Monkey didn’t care at all.
“If you guys want to kill Old Sun and my brother, you’ll have to suffer Old Sun’s fury!”
The metal rod swept out, and Brother Monkey became even more deranged.
Helpless, Lin Xuan and the others could only flee.
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey gave chase, not allowing the slightest bit of sand to enter his eyes1.
Three fled, while one pursued.
In an instant, they had disappeared into the horizon.
The moment the four Venerate Tier elites left, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
This was the only four Venerate Tier elites.
With them here, even the other Golden Generation elites would feel suppressed.
“Ling Han!” Guan Xinghan shouted again.
His eyes were filled with killing intent as he stared at Ling Han.
Ling Han glanced at him, and asked casually, “What is it?
Are you asking for a beating?”
“There’s no one protecting you now, and you still dare to be arrogant?” Guan Xinghan said coldly.
Xiu, Ling Han had already charged out.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, and wherever the flaming wings flapped, they actually formed multiple small firebirds that pounced towards Guan Xinghan.
What, Ling Han actually dared to take the initiative to attack?
Everyone was astonished.
It should be known that Guan Xinghan was an Eight Star Sect Master.
Although he couldn’t be considered one of the best in the Golden Generation, he was definitely the stronger ones.
Thus, Ling Han’s initiative to attack was practically courting death.
“Where did you get such courage from?” Guan Xinghan sneered.
He was naturally aware of Ling Han’s strength.

Although he was freakishly heaven-defying, possessing strength capable of matching the Five Star Sect Master when he was in the Spirit Transformation Tier, he was neither a Five Star Sect Master nor an ordinary Sect Master!
He stretched out a hand, which turned into a giant palm that grabbed out at Ling Han.
It was like it was forged from rock, exuding an ancient aura.
There were also streaks of dark veined patterns that interwove to reveal the profound secrets of the heaven and earth.
Humph, Ling Han had been able to act arrogantly in front of him previously completely because of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, but in a head-on confrontation?
Even 10 Ling Hans added together wouldn’t be able to withstand a single strike from him.
‘Die!’
Peng, the phoenix wings swept past, and flames burned the skies.
That rock-like hand actually melted rapidly.
‘F*ck!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4457: Destruction of the Myth
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
What was going on? What was going on?
Everyone was watching dumbly, their eyes blank.
What had they seen?
Ling Han had actually blocked Guan Xinghan’s attack!
How was this possible?
Who was Guan Xinghan?
This was the Golden Generation, and he was already about to reach the end of the Minor Advanced Tier. His abilities could be considered one of the strongest in this tier.
But in Ling Han’s case?
“He just entered into Sect Master level.”
“En, from the aura that I sensed, he is indeed One Star Sect Master without a doubt.”
“Previously, he was only in the Spirit Transformation Tier, so it’s normal for him to have just advanced into the level of the Sect Master Tier.”
“The problem is... how can he stand against an Guan Xinghan who is Eight Stars!”
Hiss, everyone inhaled sharply, feeling their scalps go numb.

Previously, Brother Monkey had moved aggressively, and it was one against three, suppressing the three Venerate Tier-level Golden Generation elites. It had already caused everyone to be stunned, causing the invincible legend of the Golden Generation to teeter on the verge of collapse.
But now, Ling Han was even more kickass, attacking a stronger opponent with himself being weaker, not losing at all. Just how freakish was he?
Guan Xinghan also focused his gaze, “You actually suddenly advanced to the level of Sect Master!”

He knew very well that when Ling Han had been in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, he had already possessed strength that could match the strength of a Five Star Sect Master. Now that he had advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier, his abilities had naturally increased even further.
The problem was, how long had it been? This brat actually broke through?
Was the barrier of cultivation level non-existent?

Logically speaking, without accumulating enough power for too long, if one was in a rush to break through, it would definitely lead to the shortcoming of having weak battle prowess. However, this was completely unapplicable for Ling Han, who was overwhelmingly strong.
He sighed deeply, and immediately calmed down.
He hadn’t lost. Moreover, he was an Eight Star Sect Master. He was no weaker than Ling Han, so what was there to be afraid of?

“From now onwards, you will be eliminated at all costs!” Guan Xinghan said balefully. When your freakishness threatens the Golden Generation’s ability to become Emperor, you would naturally be eliminated.
—Unless you had a Great Emperor-level background, then everyone would be wary, and would not dare to make a move.
But in Ling Han’s case?
He only had a single Saint backing him up, and in the case of Buddha Doga, his reaction should not be too intense.
Ling Han chuckled, “Then you all would also have to have such abilities!”
He attacked again, unleashing the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. Flames soared into the sky.

He didn’t just use the movement technique alone. He shot out the Han Fists. This was his own path based on the various Imperial Techniques that he had used as reference. It was a fist technique completely suited to himself.
Boom! He threw a punch, and heaven and earth reverberated. Regulations materialized, transforming into fourteen God Tools that slashed at Guan Xinghan.

Guan Xinghan humphed, and replied with a palm strike, “You are indeed extraordinary. You have just entered the ranks of Sect Master, and can already deliver fourteen Six Star Regulations in a single strike. It can be claimed that there has never been anyone like you before, and there will never be anyone like you in future. However, I am an Eight Star Sect Master!”
As he delivered a palm strike, it turned into a millstone. It was as black as ink, yet was densely covered with silver veined patterns, and was filled with demonic nature.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han’s figure instantly slid back.

In terms of power, he was still no match for an Eight Star Sect Master, what more when it was a Golden Generation. Furthermore, Guan Xinghan could also deliver fifteen flashes of Regulations with a single strike. In fact, he had one more flash than Ling Han. This naturally was his advantage again.
However, Ling Han had walked his own path. Wasn’t this the same?

Guan Xinghan’s figure also swayed, and he retreated more than ten steps. Teng, teng, teng! With every step he retreated, the ground cracked a bit, and after a dozen steps, a deep ravine appeared on the ground.
Hiss, it was a tie.
In a battle of an Eight Star Sect Master versus One Star Sect Master, and it was a Golden Generation at that, yet he could only manage a tie?
What kind of freak are you!
Everyone looked at Ling Han in shock, completely speechless.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!

Guan Xinghan was both speechless and stunned. He had already overestimated Ling Han, yet he was still confident that he could win. This was because Ling Han’s power and grasp of Regulations were all inferior to his. Thus, there was no reason for him to lose.
However, after exchanging blows, he found out that the feeling that Ling Han gave him... was just like a young Great Emperor that had walked out of the primitive doors.
It was clear that their cultivation levels were completely the same, yet he was still being suppressed. He had no temper at all.
Now, this feeling was exactly the same.
No, no, no. If Ling Han was also Eight Stars, it wouldn’t be as simple as suppressing him. Instead, he would be able to easily crush him.
How was this possible! He was the Golden Generation!
Guan Xinghan’s expression was livid. How could it be that the legend of the Golden Generation was really going to be destroyed?
Ling Han didn’t give him time to be stunned. With a battle cry, he unleashed another punch.
He was influenced by Brother Monkey’s fighting spirit. Now, he only wanted to fight vigorously and to his heart’s content.
Who cares about victory or defeat, who cares about loss or gain!
I only ask for a battle.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

With the support of such fighting spirit, Ling Han attacked without any reservations, and in truth, he could both disperse a portion of the attack he took, and also had a strong physique as a shield, so he completely had that kind of confidence.

On the other hand, Guan Xinghan was also a Body Arts practitioner, but he hadn’t cultivated the True Dragon Imperial Scroll, so his physique at the same cultivation level couldn’t possibly compare to Ling Han’s. Moreover, he couldn’t automatically disperse attacks either.
Thus, he would have reservations when he attacked, to avoid trading injury for injury with Ling Han.
In this way, he naturally gradually fell into a disadvantage.
Everyone was once again astounded by this. This was the Golden Generation! He had the advantage of seven minor levels of cultivation level, yet he was actually outmatched?
You’ve got to be joking.
And all the Imperial Clan elites looked cold, their killing intent blazing madly.
Ling Han was too freakish, far surpassing the strongest generation, so much so that others didn’t even have the confidence to match him.
This kind of person... had to be killed.
Otherwise, would there still be any suspense about the battle for the throne?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Another Golden Generation charged out, joining the battle.

Boom, the Golden Generation had long since advanced into Sect Master-level. The lowest cultivation level among them had reached Five Stars. Every single one of them could pose a threat to Ling Han, what more when twenty over of them were attacking together?

In fact, Chang Daoyu, Su Qianhai, and the other Nine Star Sect Masters were also among them. Any one of them would be slightly stronger than Ling Han in a one-on-one battle, what more when they were working together?

Yet Ling Han was completely unafraid. His fighting spirit was like a tidal wave, and as Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, he shuttled back and forth among the great Imperial Sons, throwing punches madly. Regulations exploded, and he would fight anyone he saw.
On the other hand, the Imperial Sons were slightly apprehensive. They couldn’t hurt their own people, right?

Relying on his speed, Ling Han was able to move freely under the combined attacks of the Imperial Sons. Though he was constantly facing a life-threatening danger, he was always able to resolve it in time.
F***, this was really invincible!
Everyone was watching, all of them gritting their teeth, completely in disbelief.
As it turned out, Ling Han was already this powerful.

Ding Shu, Origin, and Myriad Dao were also watching, all of them frowning slightly. They too had incredibly strong confidence, but if they asked themselves honestly, if they were in Ling Han’s shoes, just how many moves would they be able to sustain from the attacks of so many Imperial Sons?
Without Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, the world’s top movement technique, they probably wouldn’t be able to last ten moves.
They all had ambitions to become Emperor, but Ling Han suddenly seemed to be leaving them in the dust, causing them to feel a strong sense of urgency.
