chapters.title: Chapter 4458: All Arrived
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Now, Ling Han had cast aside all thoughts of victory and defeat, and only wished for a satisfying battle.
Invigorating!
He continued to laugh loudly, and his Han Fists continued to attack. It was as if he wanted to exhaust all of the mystical power in his body.
However, even if he was so freakish, even if he still had the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, his opponents were still over twenty Golden Generations, after all. As time passed, he was still wounded.
Wounds were left on his arms, lower abdomen, and thighs. Blood was gushing out, but it was as condensed like liquid gem, and did not roll down.

And this was still because of his strong physique, as well as the fact that he could disperse a portion of the attack on his own. Otherwise, this would not be something as simple as just a wound appearing. Instead, his arms, legs, or even his waist would have been severed.
But so what?
Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and merely swung his fists even faster. With a single strike, fourteen Regulations bloomed at the same time, their destructive power incredibly terrifying.

A great many Imperial Sons were also injured, but they were all five-star or six-star Sect Masters, and their individual battle prowess was already no match for Ling Han. If it was not for the help of others, they might even have been killed by Ling Han.
This caused them to be shocked, and their killing intent also blazed even brighter.
They definitely could not allow Ling Han to continue growing. Otherwise, they would really be facing the judgment of an apocalypse.
Because there was no precedent of the Golden Generation joining forces, they naturally lacked coordination at the beginning, but as the battle continued, this coordination slowly improved.

It was just a few Nine-Star Sect Masters that were impeding Ling Han, and as for the others, they were accumulating Regulations on the sidelines. The moment they attacked, a dozen over Regulations bloomed, and even the Void was about to be torn apart.
After advancing to the level of Sect Master, he indeed had the ability to tear open the Void.

The Golden Generation was freakish in the first place, so even the Five Star Sect Master could unleash 12 flashes of Regulations in a single strike. If he condensed them to the extreme, it was completely possible that he could unleash 15 flashes of Regulations in a single strike.
This was naturally terrifying, and posed a huge threat to Ling Han.
In just a short while, the injuries on Ling Han’s body increased, and his whole body had turned bright red.
Of course, the Imperial Sons had also paid a considerable price, but with so many people sharing the burden, the situation was naturally much better than Ling Han.
“Hiss, he actually didn’t retreat?” Everyone bared their teeth, stunned by Ling Han’s fighting spirit.

To say nothing of a one-on-many battle, even if it was a one-on-one battle, with Ling Han’s cultivation level as a One Star Sect Master, no one would call him a coward if he retreated after a few exchanges with any Golden Generation cultivator. They would only give him a thumbs up.
But now, Ling Han had already slapped the Golden Generation’s face repeatedly, yet he was still embroiled in battle?
It was impossible for him to win, so what else was there to prove?

Ling Han really didn’t want to prove anything. Since he could still fight, he would fight until he was at the end of his line. In any case, once Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, who would be able to catch up to him?
He channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and rapidly recovered from his injuries, maintaining his condition at almost all times.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He aggressively counterattacked. This was his style. ‘If you don’t trifle with me, I won’t trifle with you either, but if you anger me, I’ll return the favor tenfold, or a hundredfold.’
‘Die!’

The Golden Generation was indeed engaged in a fierce battle, and had no time to think. Meanwhile, the remaining Silver Generation and the ordinary Imperial Sons all felt their hearts grow colder and colder. As it turned out, they were still so far away from the highest level of battle prowess.

Now, their cultivation level was gradually catching up. A great many members of the Silver Generation had advanced into Sect Master-level, but they knew that if they joined the battle, they would only be insta-killed by Ling Han.
Since when had the Silver Generation become so weak?
No, it was not that they were weak, but rather that Ling Han was too strong.
“Hmm?”
Two figures descended from the sky, and when they saw the intense battle that was ongoing, they all looked surprised.
Yang Yihuan, He Luo!
These were two people who had entered the Imperial Path at least ten times. Their abilities were unfathomable.
“This brat... is too shocking!” He Luo looked at Ling Han, surprise flashing across his face.
“He is indeed amazing.” Yang Yihuan nodded, but at the same time, he was also confused.

Previously, when he had appeared, he had swept aside the Silver Generation, his might unmatched. Only Myriad Dao could match him, but now, another guy had actually appeared, which made even him feel apprehensive.
He suddenly felt like things had gone out of control.
“Yi?” He Luo looked in a direction, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. “Feng Miaoling!”
Yang Yihuan also looked over, and similarly looked slightly surprised. However, he immediately felt relieved. The two of them had appeared, so what was so strange about Feng Miaoling also appearing?
What about the other guys? Had they not arrived yet, or had they still not appeared?

There were a few “old” guys that had even walked through Imperial Path several times more than he had, so it was normal that they still hadn’t appeared, as there was no need for them to walk through Imperial Path again.
“Brother Yang, do you want to play?” He Luo pointed at the battle ahead of them.
“Forget it.” Yang Yihuan shook his head. “Can’t you see that Feng Miaoling is only watching the battle?”

He Luo smiled, and cast another look at Ling Han. His eyes could not conceal a sliver of shock, and then he said, “The prodigies of this generation are like a gushing spring. After great repression, a great explosion has occurred. Looks like our fated opportunity would be in this lifetime.”
“Brother He is no longer suppressing your cultivation level?” Yang Yihuan asked with a smile.
“Brother Yang, isn’t that what you think as well?” He Luo also smiled.
The two of them laughed loudly.

Actually, they had long since cultivated to the Venerate Tier, but every time they cultivated to this cultivation level, they would sever their cultivation level and start from the beginning again and again. Every time they re-cultivated, their battle prowess would become slightly stronger.
To them, it was too easy to return to Venerate Tier-level. They had already experienced this many times.
Weng, a terrifying aura assaulted them.
“En?” The two of them were startled, and simultaneously looked behind them.
A figure streaked across the skies, and instantly appeared above the battle.

“Bunch of weaklings. You can only bully Old Sun and my brother if you join forces!” Brother Monkey appeared, and with a cold humph, two streaks of white gas shot out from his nostrils. Boom, the white gas shot down, instantly causing a huge explosion.
Boom! The Golden Generation elites were all thrown off their feet, drenched in blood.
So what if they were the Golden Generation? With a gap of a major tier, they would only be insta-killed by Brother Monkey.
And this was still because Brother Monkey had not delivered a fatal strike. Otherwise, with a single thought from him, even a Sect Master would only die.
Of course, the Imperial Sons all had Substitution Seals. They would have to be killed a few more times, to use up all their Substitution Seals.
This was not because Brother Monkey was apprehensive, but rather because he wanted to leave these people for Ling Han to deal with.
“Scram!” Brother Monkey shouted lightly. His Fiery Golden Eyes were domineering and filled with killing intent.
These Golden Generations didn’t even dare to fart. This was a Venerate Tier, and he could smack them to death with a single strike. How could they be qualified to speak tough?
“Brother Monkey, where are those three people?” Ling Han also stopped, not even casting a look at Guan Xinghan and the others.
This caused the Golden Generation elites to want to vomit blood. The feeling of being ignored was even more humiliating than being scolded harshly.
“They ran away,” Brother Monkey said very easily.
Ling Han nodded, and his fighting spirit subsided. He slung an arm around Brother Monkey’s shoulder, “Brother Monkey, there’s been no news of you for so long.”
“I went to a place, and Old Sun almost died inside.”
C

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
Now, Ling Han had cast aside all thoughts of victory and defeat, and only wished for a satisfying battle.
Invigorating!
He continued to laugh loudly, and his Han Fists continued to attack.
It was as if he wanted to exhaust all of the mystical power in his body.
However, even if he was so freakish, even if he still had the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, his opponents were still over twenty Golden Generations, after all.
As time passed, he was still wounded.
Wounds were left on his arms, lower abdomen, and thighs.
Blood was gushing out, but it was as condensed like liquid gem, and did not roll down.
And this was still because of his strong physique, as well as the fact that he could disperse a portion of the attack on his own.
Otherwise, this would not be something as simple as just a wound appearing.
Instead, his arms, legs, or even his waist would have been severed.
But so what?
Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and merely swung his fists even faster.
With a single strike, fourteen Regulations bloomed at the same time, their destructive power incredibly terrifying.
A great many Imperial Sons were also injured, but they were all five-star or six-star Sect Masters, and their individual battle prowess was already no match for Ling Han.
If it was not for the help of others, they might even have been killed by Ling Han.
This caused them to be shocked, and their killing intent also blazed even brighter.
They definitely could not allow Ling Han to continue growing.
Otherwise, they would really be facing the judgment of an apocalypse.
Because there was no precedent of the Golden Generation joining forces, they naturally lacked coordination at the beginning, but as the battle continued, this coordination slowly improved.
It was just a few Nine-Star Sect Masters that were impeding Ling Han, and as for the others, they were accumulating Regulations on the sidelines.
The moment they attacked, a dozen over Regulations bloomed, and even the Void was about to be torn apart.
After advancing to the level of Sect Master, he indeed had the ability to tear open the Void.
The Golden Generation was freakish in the first place, so even the Five Star Sect Master could unleash 12 flashes of Regulations in a single strike.
If he condensed them to the extreme, it was completely possible that he could unleash 15 flashes of Regulations in a single strike.
This was naturally terrifying, and posed a huge threat to Ling Han.
In just a short while, the injuries on Ling Han’s body increased, and his whole body had turned bright red.
Of course, the Imperial Sons had also paid a considerable price, but with so many people sharing the burden, the situation was naturally much better than Ling Han.
“Hiss, he actually didn’t retreat?” Everyone bared their teeth, stunned by Ling Han’s fighting spirit.

To say nothing of a one-on-many battle, even if it was a one-on-one battle, with Ling Han’s cultivation level as a One Star Sect Master, no one would call him a coward if he retreated after a few exchanges with any Golden Generation cultivator.
They would only give him a thumbs up.
But now, Ling Han had already slapped the Golden Generation’s face repeatedly, yet he was still embroiled in battle?
It was impossible for him to win, so what else was there to prove?
Ling Han really didn’t want to prove anything.
Since he could still fight, he would fight until he was at the end of his line.
In any case, once Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, who would be able to catch up to him?
He channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and rapidly recovered from his injuries, maintaining his condition at almost all times.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
He aggressively counterattacked.
This was his style.
‘If you don’t trifle with me, I won’t trifle with you either, but if you anger me, I’ll return the favor tenfold, or a hundredfold.’
‘Die!’
The Golden Generation was indeed engaged in a fierce battle, and had no time to think.
Meanwhile, the remaining Silver Generation and the ordinary Imperial Sons all felt their hearts grow colder and colder.
As it turned out, they were still so far away from the highest level of battle prowess.
Now, their cultivation level was gradually catching up.
A great many members of the Silver Generation had advanced into Sect Master-level, but they knew that if they joined the battle, they would only be insta-killed by Ling Han.
Since when had the Silver Generation become so weak?
No, it was not that they were weak, but rather that Ling Han was too strong.
“Hmm?”
Two figures descended from the sky, and when they saw the intense battle that was ongoing, they all looked surprised.
Yang Yihuan, He Luo!
These were two people who had entered the Imperial Path at least ten times.
Their abilities were unfathomable.
“This brat... is too shocking!” He Luo looked at Ling Han, surprise flashing across his face.
“He is indeed amazing.” Yang Yihuan nodded, but at the same time, he was also confused.
Previously, when he had appeared, he had swept aside the Silver Generation, his might unmatched.
Only Myriad Dao could match him, but now, another guy had actually appeared, which made even him feel apprehensive.
He suddenly felt like things had gone out of control.
“Yi?” He Luo looked in a direction, and couldn’t help but feel surprised.
“Feng Miaoling!”
Yang Yihuan also looked over, and similarly looked slightly surprised.
However, he immediately felt relieved.
The two of them had appeared, so what was so strange about Feng Miaoling also appearing?
What about the other guys?
Had they not arrived yet, or had they still not appeared?

There were a few “old” guys that had even walked through Imperial Path several times more than he had, so it was normal that they still hadn’t appeared, as there was no need for them to walk through Imperial Path again.
“Brother Yang, do you want to play?” He Luo pointed at the battle ahead of them.
“Forget it.” Yang Yihuan shook his head.
“Can’t you see that Feng Miaoling is only watching the battle?”
He Luo smiled, and cast another look at Ling Han.
His eyes could not conceal a sliver of shock, and then he said, “The prodigies of this generation are like a gushing spring.
After great repression, a great explosion has occurred.
Looks like our fated opportunity would be in this lifetime.”
“Brother He is no longer suppressing your cultivation level?” Yang Yihuan asked with a smile.
“Brother Yang, isn’t that what you think as well?” He Luo also smiled.
The two of them laughed loudly.

Actually, they had long since cultivated to the Venerate Tier, but every time they cultivated to this cultivation level, they would sever their cultivation level and start from the beginning again and again.
Every time they re-cultivated, their battle prowess would become slightly stronger.
To them, it was too easy to return to Venerate Tier-level.
They had already experienced this many times.
Weng, a terrifying aura assaulted them.
“En?” The two of them were startled, and simultaneously looked behind them.
A figure streaked across the skies, and instantly appeared above the battle.
“Bunch of weaklings.
You can only bully Old Sun and my brother if you join forces!” Brother Monkey appeared, and with a cold humph, two streaks of white gas shot out from his nostrils.
Boom, the white gas shot down, instantly causing a huge explosion.
Boom!
The Golden Generation elites were all thrown off their feet, drenched in blood.
So what if they were the Golden Generation?
With a gap of a major tier, they would only be insta-killed by Brother Monkey.
And this was still because Brother Monkey had not delivered a fatal strike.
Otherwise, with a single thought from him, even a Sect Master would only die.
Of course, the Imperial Sons all had Substitution Seals.
They would have to be killed a few more times, to use up all their Substitution Seals.
This was not because Brother Monkey was apprehensive, but rather because he wanted to leave these people for Ling Han to deal with.
“Scram!” Brother Monkey shouted lightly.
His Fiery Golden Eyes were domineering and filled with killing intent.
These Golden Generations didn’t even dare to fart.
This was a Venerate Tier, and he could smack them to death with a single strike.
How could they be qualified to speak tough?
“Brother Monkey, where are those three people?” Ling Han also stopped, not even casting a look at Guan Xinghan and the others.
This caused the Golden Generation elites to want to vomit blood.
The feeling of being ignored was even more humiliating than being scolded harshly.
“They ran away,” Brother Monkey said very easily.
Ling Han nodded, and his fighting spirit subsided.
He slung an arm around Brother Monkey’s shoulder, “Brother Monkey, there’s been no news of you for so long.”
“I went to a place, and Old Sun almost died inside.”
C

chapters.title: Chapter 4459: Lost All Six Senses
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han told Brother Monkey about his experiences during this time.

Brother Monkey went to a Mystery Realm to break through to the Venerate Tier. Thus, he didn’t connect to the Galaxy Network again. When he came out, Ling Han basically didn’t use the Galaxy Network anymore, and it just so happened that the Imperial Path opened, so Brother Monkey directly set foot on the Imperial Path.
As they conversed, more and more people gradually arrived.
Ling Han looked around, yet he didn’t discover the empress, the large black dog, and the others.
Could it be that they were still blocked outside?

Ling Han’s expression was slightly dark. These Imperial Clan elites were truly shameless. It was one thing for them to block him, but they were even stopping the large black dog, the empress, and the others!
Humph, so what if you guys do this? In the end, the imperial throne would have nothing to do with the so-called Golden Generation.
Ling Han’s killing intent soared. By the looks of it, he would have to kill a few more Imperial Sons.
“The doors are open!” Someone said, and the doors of the ancient castle ahead of them were actually slowly opening.
By the looks of it, all the corresponding passageways of the rainbow bridges had already been opened. Thus, the next section of the path had also been opened.
In an instant, everyone squeezed in through the gap in the door that had been opened.

Those that had appeared here now were all prodigies among prodigies. They had experienced multiple eliminations, so every single one of them were extremely strong competitors. They had to make the most of their time, and could not fall behind others.
“Brother Monkey, let’s go too,” Ling Han said to Brother Monkey.
“Alright.” Brother Monkey nodded. “Then let us brothers turn this place upside down.”
“Haha!” Ling Han was also filled with heroic spirit.
The two brothers walked towards the main doors of the ancient castle together. At this time, Ding Shu also walked over. Beside him was Myriad Dao, Origin and Feng Miaoling.
“Do you still want to spar?” Ling Han looked towards Ding Shu.

He had made an agreement with Ding Shu. Whoever could break through their limits at a certain cultivation level, and the other could not, or whoever could win in a battle of equal cultivation levels, would be able to take the position of Big Brother.
At present, they were both at the level of Sect Master, so he did not know whether Ding Shu would challenge him or not.

Ding Shu was extremely depressed. After he had advanced to the level of Sect Master, he had indeed wanted to have a battle with Ling Han, but when he had seen the great battle between Ling Han and the Golden Generation, he knew that he had no chance.
The gap was a little wide.
“When I break through the limits of the Minor Advanced Tier, I’ll battle you again,” he said dejectedly.
“En?” Ling Han raised a brow.
“Big, Big Brother!” Ding Shu said through gritted teeth.

This was too despicable. In the Genesis World, he was also an absolute overlord, and no one could compete with him. Yet now, he actually had to address Ling Han as Big Brother, which made him feel extremely displeased.
That was because the two of them had the same starting point, and had both originated from the Genesis World. Why was he inferior to Ling Han?

Origin and Myriad Dao had already stepped onto Minor Advanced Tier. However, these two people weren’t familiar with each other. It was just that they had been famous on the Galaxy Network before, and had risen up at almost the same time, which was why they were listed together.

They entered into the ancient castle, and saw that this place was filled with great trees that soared into the skies. Vegetation covered the ground, densely packed together, yet not a single building could be seen.
“Brother Ling, I’ll take my leave first,” Origin clasped his hands and said to Ling Han.
“All right,” Ling Han nodded. With everyone together, how were they supposed to split the treasures?
It was best to separate, to avoid conflict.
The others did the same. Even Ding Shu took his leave. They were all confident, and were completely unafraid of encountering danger.

Meanwhile, Ling Han and Brother Monkey walked forwards. They passed through the forest, and stepped on the grass. The Spiritual Qi here was dense, and the vegetation was growing madly. It was lush and verdant.

Although Brother Monkey had an impulsive personality and wouldn’t waste time on words if he could fight, he was very patient at this moment. He jumped up and down along the way, and didn’t clear a path with his staff.
“There’s Celestial medicine!” Brother Monkey suddenly exclaimed, raising his nose.
Yi, Brother Monkey’s nose was also like a dog’s?
Ling Han did not say anything about this, and merely followed Brother Monkey. Very soon, they discovered a Celestial medicine.
Unfortunately, this Celestial medicine was only Five Stars, and did not have much effect on Ling Han and Brother Monkey.
It was fine. Couldn’t he still give this to the empress and the others?

Sha, sha! sha. The sound of rustling leaves rang out, and they could see that someone had also come over. However, when he saw Brother Monkey and Ling Han, his expression immediately became serious. Hurriedly, he clasped his hands, and slowly retreated.
Ling Han picked up the Celestial medicine, and Brother Monkey did not even cast a second look at it. Naturally, he did not take a five-star Celestial medicine to heart.
The two of them continued onwards.
“Brother Monkey, after the Imperial Path is over, should we return to Celestial Sea Planet to take a look?” Ling Han asked.
“Sure,” Brother Monkey nodded. “It’s been a long time since I last saw Chen Fengyan. At that time, he was always following behind Old Sun.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle. When Chen Fengyan saw that he had advanced to the level of Sect Master, what kind of expression would he have?
It would have been fine if that old nephew had advanced into Sect Master-level, but if he was still in Spirit Transformation Tier, he would probably die of embarrassment.
Haha, he was actually slightly expectant.
Ling Han thought mischievously.

The two brothers continued to advance. There were indeed a considerable number of opportunities in this ancient castle, but they were mostly targeted at those below the level of Sect Master. Perhaps it was because they were more unlucky, so they did not manage to find them.
They didn’t deliberately search for it. After walking for a while, a corner of the building vaguely appeared ahead of them.
The two of them exchanged a look, and both sped up.
It wasn’t long before a building appeared before them.
This was a palace, and in terms of location, it should just happen to be in the centre of this ancient castle.
They arrived at the entrance of the palace. The doors were already open, but they could only see complete darkness. As for anything else, they could not see anything else.
“Let’s go.”
Brother Monkey was fearless, and took the lead.
Ling Han smiled, and followed closely behind, walking alongside Brother Monkey.
The moment he entered, darkness instantly enveloped him. He couldn’t see anything at all, and it was as if he had suddenly become blind.
No, not only sight, but also hearing. In fact, even his divine sense had been cut off.
Ling Han had clearly entered with Brother Monkey, yet at this moment, he couldn’t sense Brother Monkey’s presence at all.
He suddenly turned around, yet he couldn’t see the door at all.
Transferred?
He turned around and walked forward.
Two steps later, he appeared outside the palace and came out.
The world was clear, and sight, hearing, and divine sense all returned.
In just a short while, Brother Monkey also strode out.
“Interesting. The six senses are sealed in here,” Brother Monkey said.
Ling Han nodded, and smiled at Brother Monkey, “Again?”
“All right.”
The two of them entered into the palace once more, and instantly, the feeling of relaxation disappeared again. However, neither of them retreated this time. Instead, they continued onwards.
With his six senses sealed, even if Ling Han communicated with his divine sense, he was still unable to contact Brother Monkey. He felt as if he was the only one in this world.
No, there were still millions and millions of dimensions in his body. Every dimension was filled with vitality and intelligent life.
Countless psychic powers of belief were released. Though they were all extremely weak, as the saying went, ‘dripping water penetrates stone’, one mustn’t underestimate weak power.
Ling Han strode forwards, and after about ten minutes, light suddenly appeared ahead of him.
The galaxy shone brilliantly!

chapters.title: Chapter 4460: Burying Time
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
They were clearly walking in the palace inside the ancient castle, so why was there suddenly a field of dazzling stars?
Ling Han was surprised. He was presently standing in the galaxy. There were stars in the distance, and as the starlight shone on him, it was as cool as water.
Yi, he clearly hadn’t channeled any movement technique, nor had he stepped on Regulations, so how could he stand in the galaxy?
This most likely wasn’t a genuine galaxy.
Ling Han strode forwards. As expected, the Void seemed to have solidified, allowing him to walk easily.

However, he had only taken a few steps, when a star suddenly exploded with astonishing light. Then, he saw a figure appear in front of him. It was made up of starlight, and had an indescribable beauty to it.
However, this starlit human figure immediately threw a punch at Ling Han.
Fight? Come on then!
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and charged towards the starlight figure, his iron fists also booming loudly.

Peng! He exchanged a punch with the starlight person, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. The starlight person’s power was actually only slightly inferior to his, and there were as many as eight Regulations.
This was battle prowess that could match the Golden Generation’s.
However, in front of Ling Han, what was this worth?
He did not use his full power, but with a barrage of punches, it was only ten moves, and the starlight figure was forcefully shattered.
Yi?
He discovered that the star that had previously exploded had shot a ray of light towards him, which directly surged in his mind, nourishing his fruit of cultivation.
This was originally a small sapling, but now, it had grown slightly.
Yi, Celestial Qi?
However, after a while, the light from the star disappeared.
Ling Han looked over, and saw that this star was much dimmer than before. Perhaps, after a few more times, it would completely dim.

In other words, only those who had entered this space the earliest would have the chance to be nurtured by the starlight. As for those who had entered after that, even if they too had walked all the way here, they would not have such great fortune.
Ling Han smiled in satisfaction.
He continued to advance, and soon, another star lit up. Then, the figure of starlight reappeared.
Its strength... was more or less the same.
Ling Han stepped forward to greet him. With a few punches and kicks, he had dealt with this starlit person.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, who could be a match for him?
After destroying this starlit human figure, his Dao Fruit Tree grew a little.
He laughed loudly, and pushed forwards. With the continuous nourishment of the Celestial Qi, his fruit of cultivation also grew at an astonishing speed.
As expected of the Imperial Path, it was a place of great fortune.

Originally, Ling Han was still some distance away from the Golden Generation, especially those like Lin Xuan and the others, who had already advanced into Venerate Tier, but through this kind of fateful encounter, he was completely capable of catching up or even surpassing a portion of the Golden Generation.
Right now, Ling Han was already standing at the forefront of the younger generation.
As they battled, the speed at which he disposed of his opponents was too fast. Merely a day later, he had arrived at the end, and saw that a path had appeared ahead of him.
He couldn’t help but feel regretful. It ended just like that?
Though the Dao Fruit Tree was thriving, it still hadn’t produced any fruit of cultivation. It was still some distance away.
He tried to retreat, but when he walked again, no starlight figure appeared again.
There was nothing else that could be done. He should just continue onwards.

He walked out of the passageway, and surveyed the surroundings. He saw that there was actually a cemetery ahead of him. Multiple burial mounds towered. Some tombstones were as tall as three thousand meters, and the burial mounds were like great mountains. Some tombstones had been broken, and it was unknown whether it was because they had been corroded by time, or had been broken in battle.
Would there be Yin souls or zombies charging out?
Ling Han was filled with anticipation as he strode into the cemetery.
However, the breeze rustled eerily, but no enemy appeared.
Er, all right then.
Ling Han was slightly disappointed. At present, he longed for battle, because if he battled and killed enemies here, there would be many benefits.
He walked past one tomb after another, his eyes sweeping over them, wanting to see who was buried here.
However, these tombstones were all the same, with no words on them.
Were the people buried here all nameless people?
Ling Han suddenly felt an urge to dig up a grave. Was someone really buried here?

He forcibly dismissed this kind of impulse. If the ancients had really slumbered here, then how could he bring himself to dig up their graves when there was no enmity between them? How could he allow the ancients to not be able to have peace even after death?
The deeper he went into the cemetery, the eerier and darker the environment became. There was also a bone-deep chill.
After walking for half a day, the exit of the cemetery appeared ahead of him, or rather the entrance.
What surprised Ling Han was that there was actually another thatched cottage here.
It couldn’t be that there were people living here, right?
Ling Han walked over, yet saw the thatched cottage creak open, and an old man in grey robes walk out.

“Dream of a Thousand Years.” The grey-robed elder stretched lazily, then turned to look at Ling Han, as if he had just seen him. A hint of surprise appeared on his face, “Young man, what are you doing here?”
This old man... could not be seen through at all!
A Saint?
But in the case of Saints, wouldn’t they be unable to enter into the Imperial Path?

He was presently standing in the galaxy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4461: Heaven Crushing
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was snoring loudly.
He entered one dream after another, and it was so real that it was difficult for him to distinguish dream from reality.
In the dream, he began as a weak cultivator and continued to grow until he reached his peak. Again and again, it repeated endlessly.
But in this kind of dream, not everything went smoothly for him.
Sometimes, he would be killed right after advancing into the Foundation Building Tier, and at other times, he would become a Saint.
Ling Han tried all kinds of cultivation techniques. Some didn’t work, while others did, broadening his horizons.

He was walking on his own path. This kind of dream that seemed so real was too helpful, letting him know how much time he could save by walking on this path. There was no need for him to take the wrong path.
After an unknown amount of time, Ling Han slowly woke up.
His cultivation level hadn’t increased in the slightest, and so had his divine sense. However, Ling Han had a feeling that his battle prowess had become stronger again.
That was because he had advanced a little further on the path that he had taken.
He got up, and saw that the grey-robed old man was no longer in the room. Only the wine pot was still there, as if it was proving that Ling Han’s experiences before he got drunk were all real.
“This old man... who exactly is he?”

Ling Han felt that the number of elites in this universe had exceeded his imagination. Ever since the appearance of Buddha Doga, the top elites had popped out, one after another. For example, the Lord of Yin River, the Lord of Blood Ocean, as well as some planet that had suddenly appeared, where there was obviously a supreme elite within the restrictions.
They were all Pseudo-Emperors?
These people who already had one foot into the imperial throne seemed to be about to achieve dao right in front of his eyes. If he competed with them, how small would his chances of winning be?
The grey-robed elder he had met previously was plain and unadorned, completely insignificant, but it was precisely because of this that Ling Han felt that the latter was strong.
—For better or worse, he was already at the level of Sect Master, yet he could not even sense the strength of the other party. Then wouldn’t that indirectly mean that the other party was strong?
“Hiss, could this senior also be a Pseudo-Emperor?”
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He was only a Sect Master, and the difficulty level had already reached the point that he would have to face many Pseudo-Emperors?
This was obviously impossible. Perhaps there were a few Pseudo-Emperors that had come from ancient times, but there should be pitifully few of them.
“No matter what, I only have one path to take, and that is to become stronger as soon as possible.”
Ling Han exited the straw hut, and planned to continue onwards. However, he suddenly felt an aura approach.
He stopped, and looked behind him.
A slender figure rapidly approached. This was a young man who looked to be only twenty-three or twenty-four years old. He was dressed in snow-white silk robes, spotless, as if he was a deity.
His appearance was very ordinary, but his eyes were extremely lively, and his gaze was even deeper. One would be captivated with a single look, and be unable to extricate himself.

It was as if he had not expected that there would be someone ahead of him. Thus, when he saw Ling Han, a hint of surprise appeared on his face, but he quickly withdrew it, and asked, “How should I address you, friend?”
This person was at the level of Sect Master, but his exact star level could not be distinguished. There was a fog enshrouding him, and even his eye technique could not see through it.
Ling Han sized him up a few times, then said, “Ling Han.”

“Ling Han?” The young man gave an ‘oh’, as if he had obtained a very good reason. If it was Ling Han, then it would not be strange for him to walk ahead of him. He smiled slightly, “I am Heaven Crushing.”
Heaven Crushing!
The Heaven Crushing that had risen up strongly on the Galaxy Network all those years ago? The Heaven Crushing that had been on the same level as Myriad Dao and Origin?

It was extremely likely that he was the second person to walk out of the palace. This meant that his battle prowess at the same cultivation level was extremely strong. As expected of the freak that could stand side by side with Origin and Myriad Dao.
“Brother Ling, how about a spar?” Heaven Crushing asked.
Ling Han raised a brow, and said, “Sure!”
At first, he had no intention of fighting. Instead, he was in a rush to go to the next place, and continue to increase his cultivation level.
However, with his personality, how could he be afraid of a battle when he was being challenged?
Fine, then let’s have a spar with the last of the three strongest members of Galaxy Network from all those years ago.
Heaven Crushing let out a battle cry, and already charged towards Ling Han.
Boom, the two of them did not dodge, and came to a head-on confrontation.
Teng, teng, teng! Ling Han couldn’t help but retreat. Meanwhile, Heaven Crushing also swayed and bled from between his thumb and forefinger.

This strike... Heaven Crushing had the upper hand in terms of power, but in terms of Regulations, he was slightly inferior to Ling Han. Thus, the result was that Ling Han was sent backwards, while Heaven Crushing was slightly injured.
“Are you really a One Star Sect Master?” Heaven Crushing waved his hand, and the wound quickly healed.
“As real as can be,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Heaven Crushing’s smile disappeared, and his expression became serious.
That attack just now could be considered a tie. Both of them had their own strengths, but he was a Four-Star Sect Master!
Four stars against one star, and it was actually a tie, which he could not accept.
—If this was known to a Golden Generation like Guan Xinghan, he would definitely complain incomparably, because even an Eight-Star Sect Master like them would only be able to fight Ling Han to a tie.
You did it with just four stars, so how much more awesome was that compared to the Golden Generation?
“Impressive!” Heaven Crushing said sincerely, then charged out again.
Boom!
He controlled Regulations, and shot out a palm strike. Space was forcibly torn apart, and high-level energy surged, turning into a terrifying and boundless attack.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid, and greeted the attack with a raised fist.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Neither of them used any tricks, and merely faced the other head-on.
After several dozen moves, Ling Han was indeed sent flying a great many times, but in truth, it was Heaven Crushing that was at a greater disadvantage.
That was because after every exchange of blows, the injuries he had sustained were real and genuine.

It wasn’t that his defense wasn’t high. In fact, he was also a Body Arts cultivator. However, he was slightly weaker than Ling Han, so he only suffered some light injuries every time. His foundations weren’t damaged, and it didn’t affect his battle prowess at all. However, he was covered in blood, and he looked extremely disheveled.
“Great!” Heaven Crushing threw his head back and roared with laughter. “Ling Han, show me all of your abilities. Otherwise, if you’re insta-killed by me, don’t regret it!”
Boom! A layer of black energy suddenly wrapped around his hands, causing one’s heart to palpitate.
‘Holy f*ck!’
Ling Han faltered upon this. He was far too familiar with this. This was Destructive Energy!
Through his and Ding Shu’s examples, it could be proven that only the Genesis World’s Master could grasp Destructive Energy.
Hiss!
Ling Han did not say another word, and also channelled out the Destructive Energy. However, he controlled it slightly, and only wrapped it around his fists.
“Yi?” Heaven Crushing was also taken aback.
The two of them exchanged a look, and both of them gave an ‘oh’ in their hearts. They were already completely aware of each other’s origins.
“Come!” Heaven Crushing roared, unleashing a murderous aura that transformed into a divine saber in Ling Han’s mind. It was going to wreak havoc.
Ling Han humphed. The Dao Fruit Tree trembled slightly, and this God Tool shattered.
In terms of divine sense, which Sect Master could compare to him?
He was very curious. At first, he had thought that only he and Ding Shu were from Genesis World, but now, he shockingly saw a third one.
What about Origin and Myriad Dao?
Doubt welled up in Ling Han’s heart. Perhaps these two people were as well.
...Just how many were there?

chapters.title: Chapter 4462: Energy Jade
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han pondered, but his hands didn’t stop, endlessly exchanging blows with Heaven Crushing.
They didn’t hold anything back, unleashing their ultimate techniques and Mystical Powers.

Of course, Ling Han still held back, such as the strength of the Destructive Power, and he did not use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower either, and in fact, he still hadn’t used the Han Fists yet. Now, this was one of his strongest trump cards.

Heaven Crushing roared endlessly, and as his hands attacked repeatedly, his divine sense also condensed Regulations, turning into multiple God Tools. Like giant axes that opened the sky and struck the ground, they slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han laughed loudly. He too condensed Regulations, turning them into God Tools, and greeted Heaven Crushing.
After fighting for half a day, it was still a tie.
The two of them stopped at the same time. It would be meaningless to continue fighting unless they used their stronger trump cards.
“Trade?”
“All right!”
Neither of them said what they wanted to trade, but both of them knew very well.
Sure enough, they each took out a Spirit Diagram and handed it over to the other.
Ling Han unfoldedit to take a look. Heaven Crushing was not playing any tricks. This was indeed a corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.
Of course, he didn’t play any tricks either.
The two of them took the Spirit Diagram and began to cultivate. After half a day, they stood up at practically the same time, and traded back the Spirit Diagrams.
From this, it could be seen that there was not much difference in their comprehension ability.
As expected of the ruler of the Genesis World!

Though they had all had different encounters after coming out of Genesis World, there was really nothing to be said about their comprehension ability for being able to become the overlord of a territory. They were definitely the best choice.
“Please.”
“Please.”
The two of them exchanged a smile, then went their own way.
In future, they would definitely be powerful competitors on the Imperial Path, but before that, they appreciated each other’s talent.

“If I encounter Myriad Dao and Origin again, I definitely have to test them out again. Whether they are the Genesis World’s Masters or not,” Ling Han murmured. He had already obtained six corners of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and according to his deductions, he would be able to reach perfection with three more corners.
Thus, if Origin and Myriad Dao had both mastered Destructive Energy, he would only be a sliver away from completely mastering Destructive Energy.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. With a competitor like Heaven Crushing, he didn’t dare to slack off, and he had to make the most of his time.
As for Brother Monkey, there was naturally no need for him to worry at all. He was a Two Star Venerate Tier elite, and in this place, he was the strongest elite, without equal.
After walking for a while, a dried up lake appeared in front of him.
What dense Spiritual Qi.

Ling Han was shocked, and saw that there were multiple pieces of brightly coloured jade at the bottom of the lake. It was precisely these stones that were exuding a dense energy, that he could sense even from very far away.
This energy was extremely pure, without the slightest impurity.
Ling Han descended, but he didn’t dare to move too quickly. Otherwise, if he disturbed the balance of this space, it was very likely that an energy storm would form, and even he would be torn apart.

The entire area around the lake was filled with dense energy that had almost solidified. Furthermore, its level was extraordinarily high. Even if Ling Han had already slowed down his pace, he had only created a slight breeze, and the surrounding energy had already turned into blades, slicing at his body. Instantly, a considerable number of holes appeared in his clothes, as well as a few wounds.

How terrifying. This destructive power was comparable to a Nine Star Sect Master. Furthermore, this was only produced through Ling Han’s slight movements. If his movements were slightly greater, just how terrifying would it be?
Moreover, Ling Han had already channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, yet his wounds were actually unable to heal. Although his injuries weren’t severe, this was still extremely strange.
However, the more this was the case, the more curious Ling Han became.

He advanced slowly, feeling as if he were forcibly squeezing into a formation created by God Tools. It was inevitable that he would be scraped, and the result of touching the God Tools would be lacerations.
Was there anyone that would torture themselves like this?
Ling Han grimaced. It was useless even if he activated the Starlight Screen, as it would explode with a light touch.
He advanced slowly, leaving a trail of blood behind him. It was an extremely tragic sight.
It hurt, it hurt, it hurt. Ling Han gritted his teeth. When these energy blades sliced into his body, it was really very painful, causing him to almost cry.
He took out that Saint Tool, wanting to use the natural treasure to resist these energy blades. However, he shockingly discovered that the shield formed by the precious pearl was ineffective.
Strange, wasn’t this treasure capable of resisting natural negative effects?
This was the handiwork of some elite?
It didn’t seem like it.
Ling Han sensed with his senses. This was indeed the purest energy. The reason why it possessed such terrifying destructive power was because it was too dense.

This was just like how a paper sword couldn’t kill someone. However, if one compressed 1000 or 10,000 pieces of paper into a thin piece of paper and made it into a sword, would one still be unable to kill someone?
If one walked one path to the extreme, no matter how weak they looked, they would still be able to unleash terrifying might.
Ling Han suddenly came to a realization.
Unfortunately, he did not dare to sit down and cultivate in seclusion here. That would really be a suicidal action.
He walked slowly, and finally arrived in front of the jade closest to him. He stretched out a hand to touch it, and it was extraordinarily hard.
This was completely condensed from the power of heaven and earth!
Hiss, this was extremely terrifying.

It should be known that the energy of heaven and earth could not be seen at all, and could only be sensed, and this was only the energy of a low-level dimension. The energy of a high-level dimension could only be communicated through the divine sense following the path of the Spirit Diagram.
He had only heard of energy that was so dense that it turned into gas, and now, it had actually turned into a solid body, and it was extremely hard at that. Just how dense was it?
No wonder the surrounding environment had become filled with killing intent. The slightest movement could disintegrate a person.
Ling Han thought internally. If this energy jade could be carved into a weapon, then just how much damage would it cause when shot out?
Absorb it?
That was impossible.

Firstly, after reaching the level of Sect Master, the factor that troubled cultivators was Celestial Qi, and not mystical power. Secondly, this was too dense. Even absorbing a little was enough to make Ling Han suffer greatly, and it was not impossible that his body would directly explode.
En, since that was the case, then what about making it into a weapon?
Ling Han carefully stored the Energy Jade in his hand into his Spatial Tool, but with a pa, this Tool directly exploded.
F***, so terrifying?
Ling Han switched to another Spatial Spirit Tool and tried again. The result was the same; it couldn’t bear the weight at all.
‘Can’t I deal with you?’
Ling Han directly drew out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and put it away again.
This time, the Energy Jade was safely stored into the first level of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han smiled eerily. If Origin Gold still couldn’t deal with you, then you really could fly to defy the heavens.
Since he had already taken one, why shouldn’t he take a few more?
Ling Han moved again, and began to roam around at the bottom of the lake, endlessly picking up the Energy Jades. After spending half a day’s time, he finally collected all of them.
He gritted his teeth. He had been bleeding all this while, and his wounds were extremely painful.
Since he had picked everything up, he had to leave as soon as possible.
Ling Han still didn’t dare to move too quickly. He slowly retreated, and in this process, he discovered that the energy intensity of the environment had slightly weakened.

chapters.title: Chapter 4463: Frightening Might
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was understandable.

The reason why the environment was so dangerous was because of those Energy Jades. Now that the Energy Jades had been taken away, the environment would naturally recover slowly. However, this time could possibly be very, very long.

Ling Han finally retreated out of the lakebed area. When he arrived at a completely normal environment, he hurriedly sat down in a cross-legged position and channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique again. His injuries were finally under control, and they were slowly improving.
It should be known that for such superficial injuries, he should have been able to heal them immediately with a single thought.
After a whole three days, the wounds finally scabbed over completely, but they were only scabs.
Ling Han retrieved an Energy Jade and started to examine it.
Ling Han’s divine sense swept over it, and his expression changed slightly.
The energy contained within could only be described as terrifying.
In an analogy, this was equivalent to the sum of all the energy on a large star.
What kind of concept was that?
The Venerate Tier elite was powerful enough, wasn’t he? As long as the Venerate Tier elite was given enough time, he would be able to blast a star to bits.

However, if a star exploded, the energy that burst out in that instant would be enough to shatter even the Venerate Tier elite. Thus, the Venerate Tier elite had the ability to destroy a star, but would definitely not do so, unless he no longer wanted his life, or could escape before the arrival of the great explosion.
However, this was extremely difficult, because even if the Void was torn open, the massive explosion of the planet was enough to affect even the surrounding Void.
Thus, the Saints were basically the ones who had obliterated planets.
How could Ling Han’s face not turn green?
Previously, it was equivalent to him sitting on a barrel of dynamite. He was really lucky not to have died.
“As expected, the ignorant are fearless. If I had known that these Energy Jades would be so terrifying, would I still go down?”
Ling Han murmured to himself. This was because the Energy Jade wasn’t stable. It would explode if he exerted too much effort.

Thankfully, the lakebed area was extremely dangerous, so he didn’t dare to make any big movements at all. He had to be careful. Otherwise, if his hands and feet were a little heavier... he would have been done for.
“What if I use this thing to smash someone?”

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. This Energy Jade was too unstable. As long as one took a bit of force, it would detonate the energy within, and the power that would burst out would be enough to insta-kill a Venerate Tier.
Perhaps, even Saints could be wounded if they were careless.
Of course, if he was obliterated the moment it left his hand, he would be the unluckiest person.
“That’s not right!”
“This should be even more destructive than a star exploding, because just how big is a star? And just how big is this thing?”
Under the condensation of millions and millions of times, how could destructive power be equivalent?
“If I go and smash people like this, will I also seek death?”

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel suspicious. Because he had never tried it before, he had absolutely no idea what kind of terrifying destructive power would be created after this Energy Jade exploded, and just how wide would the radius of effect be.
“Hmm?”
Someone was coming.
Lin Xuan.
Ling Han fled into the shadows at the first instant. Although the Strange Shadow Steps wasn’t the world’s fastest movement technique, it was definitely the most impressive technique of concealment.
Lin Xuan descended, and a suspicious expression appeared on his face.
Just now, he had sensed an aura, but now, it had disappeared.
Ling Han?
This was his first reaction. Otherwise, how many people could hide in front of him?
“Come on out, what’s the point of hiding?” he said calmly, but his voice was booming, turning into waves that spread out in all directions.
Under the soundwave, the air was crushed and distorted, and no one could hide at all.
Ling Han moved quickly to dodge the soundwaves.
He retreated 50km, and only then did the soundwave weaken. It did not have such powerful might.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. He had just wanted to know the might of the Energy Jade, so wasn’t this a very good opportunity?
Let’s give it a try.
He held onto an Energy Jade, then suddenly swung his hand. Xiu, this jade smashed towards Lin Xuan.
Even though there was a distance of 50km between the two of them, with the Sect Master-level power, it was enough to penetrate a planet with a rock. This little bit of distance was really not much.
Xiu, the Energy Jade tore through the air, whistling as it smashed towards Lin Xuan.
Ling Han, on the other hand, turned around without hesitation. He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and fled.

He wasn’t afraid of Lin Xuan, but he was afraid of the shockwave created by the explosion of the Energy Jade. A distance of 50km was too insecure for a large explosion that could kill a Venerate Tier elite.
He didn’t have a Substitution Seal.
“Humph!” Lin Xuan immediately discovered Ling Han, and directly stretched out a hand to grab him.
Hong, a large hand split open the skies, and in an instant, it had reached a few hundred km, a few thousand km, as if the whole heaven and earth could be covered by it, terrifying without bounds.
When a Venerate Tier elite made a move, so what if it was a Sect Master?

He naturally saw the jade that was thrown at him, but he didn’t take it seriously at all, all right? To say nothing of the fact that this was only a rock, so what if it was a Spirit Tool? Activated by a Sect Master, even the might of an Imperial Weapon would be limited. It couldn’t possibly pose a threat to a powerful Venerate like him.

The Energy Jade was extremely unstable. Originally, the intense friction with the air was enough to cause it to explode, but previously, Ling Han had wrapped the mystical power around it, which had the effect of cutting it off, so it did not explode.
However, Lin Xuan sent out a palm strike, and Venerate Tier-level power surged out. What was Ling Han’s tiny bit of mystical power worth?
Boom, the Energy Jade immediately exploded.
In an instant, Lin Xuan’s expression changed drastically in shock.
‘Holy f*ck!’
This was too terrifying. Was a Saint making a move?
He hurriedly turned around to flee, using all his strength.

He indeed had the Substitution Seal on him. However, this was created by a Saint, and it could only take effect on attacks below the level of Saint. If he took this attack head-on, his only fate would definitely be death.

He was the Golden Generation, after all, and he was also one of the three strongest prodigies in this prodigy group. His movement technique was also astonishingly fast. In fact, he didn’t even hesitate to use the secret technique, with blood spurting from all over his body. In an instant, he exploded with speed that surpassed his own strength.
Hong, energy surged rapidly. To say nothing of Lin Xuan, even Ling Han’s Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was far inferior to this speed.
Under Lin Xuan’s incredibly terrified gaze, the energy that had exploded had already caught up to him and swallowed him whole.
“F*ck!”
Ling Han turned around to take a look, and gritted his teeth. That was because the energy wave was presently catching up to him at a frightening speed.

In this Mystery Realm, there was no way for him to tear a rip into space and flee. Furthermore, in fact, with how terrifying this burst of energy was, even if he had entered into the Void, as long as it was still affecting the core area, he would still be affected by the energy.
Thus, he could only flee with all his might now.
It was too late!

Boom, the energy shot over from his back, and directly sent Ling Han flying. Then, it caught up to him, and was sent flying again. After more than a dozen times, the might of this great explosion finally reached its greatest extent. Terrifying energy surged towards the skies and the ground.

Looking up, a massive mushroom-shaped energy mass had appeared in the sky, and as for underground, it could not be seen for the moment, but as long as the energy mass dispersed, he should be able to see a massive sinkhole.

chapters.title: Chapter 4464: Severely Injured
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
Hu, he could feel pain, which meant that he was not dead yet.
Ling Han crawled up, only to discover that all of his clothes had been torn to shreds. His skin was also riddled with wounds, some of which were so deep that even his bones could be seen.
Hiss, he had clearly run so far, but the energy storm still affected him.
As expected of a deadly move that could kill Venerate Tier elites.

Thankfully, he had fled fast enough, and the area affected by the concentrated Energy Jade was much smaller, but within this range, it was ten to a hundred times more terrifying than the explosion of a star.
“I wonder if Lin Xuan is dead yet.”
Ling Han looked at the ball of energy soaring into the sky. Even if he was still very far away, he could still feel that terrifying fluctuation. If he rushed in now, his only fate would be death.
After a long time, this energy storm finally passed. Though there were still lingering shockwaves in the air, they no longer had much destructive power.
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique and got his injuries under control. However, he was severely wounded, and wouldn’t be able to recover in a short while.
It was fine, as long as it did not affect his battle prowess.
He strode forward, his eyes continuously searching.
As expected, a deep pit was blasted into the ground, and there was still dense energy rising from it.
After a while, he revealed a smile.
Found him.
Near the edge of this deep pit, there was a person lying down. Who else could it be but Lin Xuan?
However, the present Lin Xuan was in a miserable state. He had lost his left arm and right leg, and his whole person was sprawled out on the ground. The flame of life was extremely weak.
He wasn’t dead yet?

Ling Han was astonished. Venerate Tier elites were truly difficult to kill. He had long since prepared himself, and he had fled with all his might. However, he was still riddled with wounds. Meanwhile, Lin Xuan was caught off guard, and he actually didn’t die?
However, looking at where Lin Xuan had fallen, it was clear that he was already at the periphery of the great explosion.
“You really can run!” Ling Han shook his head.

“Ling, Han!” he called out through gritted teeth, his voice filled with fury.
He had almost died!

Now, though his life was saved, he had lost an arm and a leg. Of course, he was a Venerate Tier, and furthermore, he was the Imperial Son. The clan definitely had Great Herbs to help him recover, and it would not leave behind any future trouble.
But the moment he thought of it, he still felt lingering fear.
Previously, he was really just a little bit away from the gates of hell.

He used his divine sense to check on his present state, and couldn’t help but pale. He had suffered heavy injuries, and his abilities had already fallen out of Venerate Tier. Furthermore, if he didn’t treat his injuries in time, his injuries would worsen, and his abilities would fall further.

“Die!” he roared in fury. He had actually almost died at Ling Han’s hands, causing him to feel lingering fear and fury.

These weren’t Seven Star Regulations, but rather Six Star Regulations.

His battle prowess was far inferior?
Then he’d use the Spirit Tool to compensate for it.
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Weng, the Pseudo Imperial Weapon released a terrifying aura.
This wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, but how could the might of Origin Gold be negligible under the power of a Sect Master?
Peng!
Lin Xuan’s attack arrived, and was completely blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Meanwhile, a bolt of lightning flashed past, striking back at Lin Xuan.

Zi, blazing white lightning was still flickering around him, indescribably terrifying.
The might of this strike was actually comparable to his strength!

This was truly a f*cking slap to his face. He had just said that this couldn’t possibly be the Imperial Weapon, and what was the result? He was incredibly familiar with that boundless aura. It was the Imperial Weapon!
No, he immediately overturned his decision.
This wasn’t the Imperial Weapon. It didn’t have the aura of a Great Emperor.
“Origin Gold!” he exclaimed in shock, greed flickering in his eyes.

The Imperial Weapon was forged by the Great Emperor, and the material used to forge the Imperial Weapon was the Origin Gold. However, every piece of Origin Gold was in the most dangerous places of this heaven and earth. Even the Great Emperor would have to pay a certain price to retrieve it.
Thus, the Imperial Weapon had only been forged after the Great Emperor had ascended Dao, and he had gone to look for Origin Gold.
But now? Ling Han actually had a piece of Origin Gold in his possession.
Lin Xuan couldn’t help but feel extremely regretful. If he had known earlier, he would have killed Ling Han at all costs and snatched the Origin Gold from him.
Before becoming Emperor, he already possessed the Origin Gold, so what kind of nature-defying good fortune was this?
This was equivalent to having obtained destiny, and was destined to become Emperor.

“I can’t let you live!” Lin Xuan said balefully. He definitely had to kill Ling Han. Otherwise, with how freakish he was, and how he had been blessed by destiny, how could his course to becoming Emperor be blocked??
On the other hand, if he obtained the Origin Gold, it would be equivalent to being blessed by the heavens, and he would naturally be able to stand out from the rest.
Boom! He unleashed his full power.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and greeted the attack with a punch. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floated lightly, releasing streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. As lightning flashed, it was incredibly terrifying.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely. Ling Han had the help of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, so he was completely unafraid of Lin Xuan. Power clashed, and Regulations clashed.
Very quickly, Lin Xuan frowned.
He was severely injured, and his abilities had decreased to the level of a Nine Star Sect Master. However, this battle prowess was still unstable, and was still declining.
The problem was that Ling Han was filled with fighting spirit. His battle prowess was at its peak, and if this continued, he would definitely be in trouble.
He could no longer fight. If he continued to fight, he would definitely die!
Lin Xuan forcibly endured the humiliation, turned around and fled.
As long as his injuries were under control, when his strength returned to Venerate Tier-level, killing Ling Han would naturally be a piece of cake.
However, this was really an incomparable humiliation. A dignified Venerate Tier elite, a Golden Generation elite at that, was actually forced to flee for his life by a One Star Sect Master?
How humiliating.

chapters.title: Chapter 4465: Out of options
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lin Xuan fled.
Ling Han smirked coldly, and set off in hot pursuit.
“Lin Xuan, have you ever thought that this day would come for you?” he said through divine sense.
Lin Xuan’s face flushed red, and killing intent surged from his body. However, he had to forcefully suppress this urge.

This was a great humiliation. This was really a great humiliation. He was a dignified Golden Generation, and had the potential to be number one, yet was actually being hunted down by a nameless nobody. How could he accept this?
In his eyes, no matter what accomplishments Ling Han had achieved, he was only an ant.
It could not be helped. This was the pride of the Imperial Clan.
But now, this pride had been mercilessly shattered.
“If you don’t use underhanded techniques, killing you will only be the matter of a single move!” he retorted through divine sense.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh out loud, “Lin Xuan, you, a Fourth Extreme cultivator, can bring yourself to say such words to me, a Minor Advanced Tier cultivator?”
‘Nonsense, you already have the advantage of a major tier and a great many minor levels. If you still can’t win in a head-on battle, then why don’t you quickly find a rope to hang yourself with?’
Lin Xuan merely sneered, “When I recover from my injuries, that will be the day of your death!”
He made up his mind. Once he recovered his abilities, he would kill Ling Han at all costs.

This was to wash away the humiliation, and definitely could not let a third person know about today’s matter. On the other hand, it was also for the sake of the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon. Though it was far from being powerful, but it represented the fortune of heaven and earth.
The heavens favoured him, and he was destined to become Emperor!
“You won’t be able to wait until this day!” Ling Han also said coldly. Lin Xuan wanted to kill him, so how could he not want to kill him?
Xiu, the two of them used their movement techniques to the extreme, and streaked through the skies at an incredibly fast speed.

In terms of movement technique speed, Lin Xuan was originally not inferior to Ling Han. After all, he was a Venerate Tier and added with an Imperial Technique, this was comparable to Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. But the problem now was that his strength had declined, which greatly affected his speed.
To his shock, he discovered that Ling Han was slowly catching up to him.

If he was caught up, his injuries would become more and more serious as they continued to battle. His battle prowess would also decline further, and in the end, he would no longer be a match for Ling Han.
Then next year, today would really be the day of his death anniversary.
Anxiety gripped at his heart, and he increased his speed as much as possible. At the same time, he tried his best to search, wanting to use the terrain to throw him off his tail.
However, this was a flat stretch of land, and there was no place to hide at all, causing him to lose all hope.
Behind him, Ling Han was getting closer and closer.

“Lin Xuan, go all out in battle. At the very least, you can die with some dignity.” Ling Han shot out a punch. He had already used the Han Fists, Regulations glowed, Destructive Energy blazed. He had obtained the sixth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and the destructive power of Destructive Energy had increased to another level.
They were too close, so Lin Xuan had no choice but to turn around to parry. Peng, with just one punch, he was sent flying.
What!
Lin Xuan’s expression changed drastically again. His battle prowess had clearly decreased just a little, so why had he fallen into such a disadvantage in this exchange?
Moreover, his protective mystical power was rapidly being destroyed. A terrifying energy surged over, causing him serious injury.
What kind of high-level energy was this? It was as if he had been directly struck by an Imperial Weapon, and it was indestructible.
Hiss, what kind of monster was this?
“You’ve already walked your own path!” Lin Xuan was shocked, his eyes popping out of his head, filled with envy and jealousy.
To become Emperor, one would definitely have to walk their own path, but these words were really easy to say. If one really wanted to do it, it would be as difficult as ascending the heavens!

Ordinarily speaking, the Great Emperors of the past would only begin to walk their own paths when they had reached the consummate level of Venerate Tier. By the time they reached the level of Saint, this path would become even clearer, and they would eventually reach the end, where they would become Emperor.
Even for someone as freakish as him, he still had absolutely no idea how to take that first step.
However... this guy in front of him, who was only at the level of Sect Master, had done it.
He was only One Star!
No, looking at the completion rate of this fist technique, it was definitely not something that had just been cultivated!
Heavens, could it be that Ling Han had already started to walk his own path when he was in the Spirit Transformation Tier?

Lin Xuan was speechless with shock. He had already overestimated Ling Han, but only now did he know that his understanding of Ling Han was only the tip of the iceberg. This person had too many secrets.
He turned around and started to run.

In terms of battle prowess, he was already no match for Ling Han. Thus, the only thing he could do was flee. As long as he could throw Ling Han off his tail, and when his injuries recovered, he would still be able to crush Ling Han. Furthermore, this kind of battle prowess suppression could still be maintained for a very long time.
As long as, as long as he could escape!
However, Ling Han had already caught up to him, and didn’t give him any chance at all. Under the barrage of punches, he was tired of parrying.

The destructive power of Han Fists was already terrifying to begin with, what more when it was boosted with the Destructive Energy. If a Great Emperor at the same cultivation level stood in front of Ling Han, he would probably be beaten to burst.
“Ah!” Lin Xuan roared. He was unwilling to accept this.
His true strength was enough to overwhelm Ling Han, and once he killed Ling Han, the latter’s fortune would all belong to him.

Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, Pseudo-Imperial Weapon... These were all items that he was extremely envious of. Obtaining one would allow him to leave the rest of the Golden Generation behind in the dust, and there was no other that could match him. But now, he was like a stray dog.
He felt sullen. He was really unwilling to accept this.

“Hoho, unreconciled?” Ling Han smirked coldly, “In the past, you relied on the fact that your cultivation level was higher than mine, and bullied me whenever you wanted to. Have you ever thought about whether I am willing or not? Just how much anger have I been holding back?”
“And now, I’ll return them all to you!”

Peng, peng, peng! Han Fists waved furiously, and though Lin Xuan managed to just barely disperse them, he was still scraped by the aftermath of the strikes. Just how terrifying was Destructive Energy? It immediately caused his injuries to worsen.
His expression twisted, and he cursed, “You are merely a lowly commoner. How can you compare to me?”
“I am a Golden Generation, and I am the strongest Imperial Son!”
Boom!
What answered him was Ling Han’s powerful and fierce punch.
Lin Xuan was instantly sent flying, his body slanting as he crashed several dozen km away. Only then did his momentum finally run out, and he landed with a bang.
“Yi?” A surprised voice rang out.
Lin Xuan spat out a mouthful of blood, and forcibly raised his head, only to see a person standing in front of him.
Yang Yihuan.
He couldn’t help but feel as if he had found his savior. Hurriedly, he exclaimed, “Friend Yang, save me!”
What pride? He couldn’t care less; he didn’t want it anymore!

At present, he only wanted to live. As long as he could live on, he would have a chance for revenge, and as long as he killed Ling Han, he had a 99% chance of becoming Emperor, and once he became Emperor, would the world dare to slander him?

Yang Yihuan raised his head, only to see that Ling Han had already caught up. A look of confusion appeared on his face, and he was even more stunned. Since when had Ling Han become so powerful? He could even defeat a Venerate Tier elite?
Ling Han stopped, and his eyes focused on Yang Yihuan. He asked calmly, “Brother Yang, do you want to interfere?”
Yang Yihuan spread his hands and said, “I’m not familiar with this Brother Lin, so why should I interfere?”
Lin Xuan instantly felt his vision darken, and almost fainted.

He hurriedly said, “Yang Yihuan, I am the descendant of Fire Cloud Ancestral King, and if you save me, the rewards will be incredibly generous! Furthermore, from now onwards, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan will become your backer, and no one in this world would dare to offend you!”
Ling Han was extremely curious as he looked at Yang Yihuan. He wanted to see if Yang Yihuan would be moved.
