Lin Xuan spat out a mouthful of blood, and forcibly raised his head, only to see a person standing in front of him.
Yang Yihuan.
He couldn’t help but feel as if he had found his savior.
Hurriedly, he exclaimed, “Friend Yang, save me!”
What pride?
He couldn’t care less; he didn’t want it anymore!
At present, he only wanted to live.

As long as he could live on, he would have a chance for revenge, and as long as he killed Ling Han, he had a 99% chance of becoming Emperor, and once he became Emperor, would the world dare to slander him?
Yang Yihuan raised his head, only to see that Ling Han had already caught up.
A look of confusion appeared on his face, and he was even more stunned.
Since when had Ling Han become so powerful?
He could even defeat a Venerate Tier elite?
Ling Han stopped, and his eyes focused on Yang Yihuan.
He asked calmly, “Brother Yang, do you want to interfere?”
Yang Yihuan spread his hands and said, “I’m not familiar with this Brother Lin, so why should I interfere?”
Lin Xuan instantly felt his vision darken, and almost fainted.
He hurriedly said, “Yang Yihuan, I am the descendant of Fire Cloud Ancestral King, and if you save me, the rewards will be incredibly generous!
Furthermore, from now onwards, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan will become your backer, and no one in this world would dare to offend you!”
Ling Han was extremely curious as he looked at Yang Yihuan.
He wanted to see if Yang Yihuan would be moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 4466: Regrowing Severed Limbs
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“No one dares to trifle with them?” Yang Yihuan countered with a question.
“Of course!” Lin Xuan nodded, a hint of pride appearing on his face.
The Imperial Clan was a noble existence that had been developed over countless years. Even in this kind of situation, it was inevitable that he would feel a little proud.
Yang Yihuan couldn’t help but splutter in laughter, “Then let me ask Brother Lin, why are you being hunted? Since no one dares to trifle with the Lin Clan, what need is there for me to interfere?”
This!
Lin Xuan was directly dumbfounded, not knowing how to answer at this moment.
F***, who the f*** knew that there was such a freak like Ling Han, that would dare to make a fatal move even on Imperial Clans.
This kind of monster would only appear once in tens of millions of years. If he didn’t die, he would either become a Saint or become Emperor in the future.
Why was he so unlucky to have encountered him?
Everyone said that the prodigies of today were all unlucky, because they had encountered the Golden Generation, and were destined to be outshone.

But now, he realized that it was the Golden Generation that was the most unfortunate. They were clearly the generation that had the greatest chance of becoming Emperor, but in the end? One after another, freaks popped out, completely overshadowing their brilliance.

“Golden Generation, hoho.” Yang Yihuan seemed to feel rueful, “I really don’t know where you guys got the courage to call yourselves that! And you say you’re comparable to the Great Emperors of the past? Haha, I’m about to die of laughter!”
This was extremely mocking, and it was clear that he was extremely disdainful of the Golden Generation.
If it were any other time, Lin Xuan would have definitely moved by now, letting him know the consequences of disrespecting an Imperial Son, especially the Golden Generation.
But now? He could only feel resentment in his heart.

“In the past, the Great Emperor was much stronger than you guys!” Yang Yihuan shook his head, and said, “To say nothing of the Great Emperor, even I could have easily defeated you at the same cultivation level back then! Even so, I still had to slumber for eternity, continuously increasing my strength so that I would be qualified to fight for the throne in this lifetime.”
“You? Hehe.”
This was practically a merciless blow.

Although Lin Xuan hadn’t fought Yang Yihuan before, Yang Yihuan had walked out of the demonic mist and defeated the Silver Generations consecutively, proving that his talent was comparable to the Golden Generation. Perhaps, it was possible that he had really surpassed the Golden Generation.
Thus, Yang Yihuan was indeed qualified to say such words.
The Golden Generation? Bullsh*t, just showing off.

Lin Xuan suffered a huge blow. He had always thought that he was already close to how the ancestor of the Lin Clan had once been, and in future, could become the second Great Emperor of the Lin Clan, creating a legend and myth.
But now that he was suddenly told that he was still very far away from the Great Emperor, how could he not be shocked?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Then please step back a little, Brother Yang.”
“All right.” Yang Yihuan nodded, and as expected, stepped back.
Lin Xuan was filled with despair. It wasn’t easy for him to meet someone, and it was still a freak like Yang Yihuan. In the end, the latter wasn’t willing to make a move at all.
His injuries worsened further. If he continued to battle Ling Han, his only fate would be death.
However, if he didn’t fight, his only fate would be death.
A cornered beast would still fight, what more when it was a Golden Generation like him. He would definitely not raise his head and wait for death until the moment of his last breath.
He still had this bit of fighting spirit.
“Then, let’s fight to the death!” Lin Xuan was prepared. Faced with Ling Han, although he only had one leg and one arm, he exuded a powerful aura.
Once one was prepared to die, they would naturally burst out with a powerful fighting spirit.
Boom, he began to combust the Imperial Blood, making his final gamble.

However, combusting the Imperial Blood was extremely useful when one was at a lower cultivation level. It could greatly increase one’s battle prowess, but the better one’s natural talent, the higher one’s cultivation level, and the lesser the boost brought by combusting the Imperial Blood.

For a Venerate Tier elite and Golden Generation like Lin Xuan, the boost brought about by combusting Imperial Blood was negligible, but when the situation had reached such dire straits, he naturally had to use whatever means he could.

However, as the Imperial Blood boiled, Lin Xuan’s aura was like an ocean, rippling out in waves. It was actually continuously increasing, not only reaching the level of a Nine Star Sect Master. In fact, it was even possible that he could even surpass this level.
How was this possible!
Even Lin Xuan himself had not expected this. He looked at the severed arm in disbelief, and felt an itch and pain in his bones, but what was shocking was that the severed arm was presently regrowing!
Not only was his severed arm regrowing, but so was his severed leg.

It should be known that it was either a Saint-level Great Herb, or a Saint, that was qualified to regrow a severed limb, but now, his vitality was clearly greatly damaged, and his battle prowess had dropped to the level of Sect Master, but he actually regrew a severed limb?
How could he not be shocked?
This was the result of combusting the Imperial Blood.
That’s not right. Burning the Imperial Blood could only increase one’s battle prowess. Since when could it be used as a Saintly medicine?
Ling Han and Yang Yihuan hadn’t expected this either. Astonishment spread across their faces.
Have you f cheated?

In a mere instant, Lin Xuan’s severed arm and leg regrew, and his strength had also stabilized at the level of Nine Star Sect Master. In the end, he was still unable to break through to the level of Venerate Tier.
However, his injuries had already stabilized, and did not worsen any further. Thus, he had completely gained the ability to battle Ling Han again.

“Haha, hahahaha!” This was something that even Lin Xuan hadn’t expected, but he was naturally overjoyed about this. “Ling Han, you didn’t expect this, did you? This is the power of the Imperial Clan!”
He spoke as if everything was under his control.

“Die!” Lin Xuan charged out. Now that he had all his limbs, his injuries were also under control. He was only short of returning to Venerate Tier-level battle prowess, so he naturally had nothing to fear.
Ling Han smiled faintly. As long as he was still a Sect Master, what did he have to fear?
Let’s battle!
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and greeted Lin Xuan’s attack. The two of them once again engaged in a bloody battle.
As Yang Yihuan watched the battle, he murmured, “This isn’t right. How can burning Imperial Blood allow severed limbs to regrow?”
He racked his brains, greatly troubled by this problem.
After a long while, his expression suddenly changed, “Unless—”
He did not continue, but rather nodded, his expression becoming serious, “So that’s how it is!”

“Then should I give him a helping hand?” Yang Yihuan murmured to himself, “After all, we’re both on the same side! Sigh, forget it, forget it. This guy’s aptitude is just so-so, and there’s no way he can become Emperor. The real Imperial Son of the Lin Clan definitely can’t be him!”
If anyone heard this muttering, they would definitely go numb with shock.
According to him, even the Golden Generation was only “average aptitude”. In fact, they were not even qualified to be called the Imperial Son?

Yang Yihuan looked at Ling Han and said, “This brat is the one who deserves to be taken seriously. His battle prowess is actually so freakish, and is even slightly stronger than the young Great Emperor. If I want to become Emperor, he should be the strongest competitor.”
He observed carefully, and his expression became more and more serious. Ling Han had already walked his own path, and this was something that he had not managed to do either.

Severing his cultivation level time and time again, starting from the beginning, wasn’t it all for the sake of planting seeds to regrow from the destruction, waiting for a day when he could walk out on his own path?
But he had done it in a single go.
“Could it be that one is really destined to become Emperor?” He frowned, “If it is not you, no matter how hard you try, there would always be no hope?”
He turned to look at Ling Han again, killing intent flickering in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 4467: Killing Lin Xuan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
However, Yang Yihuan ultimately didn’t make a move.
He turned around and left, his expression resolute.

After this journey on the Imperial Path, he would no longer sever his cultivation level. Instead, he would attempt to break through to Saint Tier. After accumulating for so many lifetimes, it was time for him to set everything aside and walk his own path.
With such worries, how could he possibly become Emperor?
What Great Emperor wasn’t filled with confidence in themselves? How could they be so cowardly?
Ling Han and Lin Xuan battled fiercely.
Now, Lin Xuan no longer had any worries. Although he only had the battle prowess of a Sect Master, he didn’t have to worry about his injuries worsening at all. He was naturally unafraid.
Ling Han naturally wasn’t afraid either. He unleashed his Han Fists, unleashing his full battle prowess.
Regulations were like flowers, and the fist technique was elegant, either heavy or light, changing according to one’s will.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floated up and down, pouring down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. This was Ling Han’s first layer of defense. Even if it was broken, there would still be the Starlight Screen, and if it was broken, there would still be his tough physique, which could automatically disperse a portion of the attack power.
In terms of defense, he was freakish.

And in terms of attack, he was similarly freakish. Though he was limited by his cultivation level, and it was inevitable that there would be an upper limit to his abilities, when the Han Fists were used, Destructive Energy surged, this was still incredibly terrifying.
Lin Xuan shockingly discovered that even if he had the battle prowess of a nine-star Sect Master, he was still unable to suppress Ling Han.

It could not be helped. The Pseudo-Imperial Weapon was too strong, and had practically blocked all his attacks. Even if it had not dispersed all its power, only twenty to thirty percent of its might was left, so what threat could it pose to Ling Han?

On the other hand, his physique was only slightly tougher in terms of defense, but against Destructive Energy, it was practically useless. The destructive power of this kind of high-level energy was too terrifying.
He was extremely confused. Could it be that there was a high-level energy that surpassed nine stars in this world?
Otherwise, why couldn’t the Nine Star Energy that he had mastered compare to it?

He was injured, and Destructive Energy was filled with destructive power. Once it invaded his body, he would need to expend a great amount of energy to resist. Otherwise, under the wreaking havoc of this energy, his physical body would be destroyed, and his soul would also be destroyed.
With this bit of power, it was inevitable that his battle prowess would decrease slightly.

And this was a vicious cycle. That was because his battle prowess had dropped, which meant that the chances of him being hit by Ling Han’s attacks would become higher, and then his injuries would worsen. He would have to divide more attention to resist the Destructive Energy.
Hiss, it had already come to this, so why was he still unable to change his fate?
Lin Xuan gritted his teeth before turning around to flee again.
Ling Han gave chase, while laughing loudly, “Lin Xuan, why are you running again?”
“Come, come, come. Didn’t you want to kill me?”
“Weren’t you filled with pride just now?”
Hearing Ling Han’s mockery, Lin Xuan’s face flushed red, but he didn’t say a word.
He couldn’t win, so what could he do?
His figure flashed rapidly. Because his injuries were already under control, there was no need for him to worry.
However, he was still not as fast as Ling Han. Very soon, Ling Han had caught up to him, and they had another great battle.
With every battle, Lin Xuan would be struck a few times by the Destructive Energy, and his injuries would slowly accumulate. His situation began to become worse again.
However, Lin Xuan no longer had any Imperial Blood that he could burn. Now, he was completely focused on fleeing for his life.
He still held onto hope. As long as he encountered Imperial Son Ming or Imperial Son Tian, everything could be turned around.

However, as time passed, he still hadn’t come across Imperial Son Ming or Imperial Son Tian. This place was far too vast, so to coincidentally came across these two people, his chances of success would be infinitesimally close to zero.
Half a month later, Lin Xuan was once again in despair.
His injuries were so severe that he could barely suppress them any longer.

This time, it was caused by the gradual acccumulation of Destructive Energy. The destructive power of this kind of high-level energy was too great, and it was also very stubborn. It was incredibly hard to remove, unless he could stimulate and expel it without being disturbed. If he wanted to accomplish this task in battle, this was an impossible mission.
His body was covered with injuries, and there were even some places where his bones could be seen. Logically speaking, he should have already collapsed.

However, the Golden Generation was still the Golden Generation, after all. Lin Xuan was filled with a longing for life, and this turned into an incomparable fighting spirit, allowing him to persevere.
Even Ling Han was slightly impressed. In terms of willpower, Lin Xuan was really tenacious.
Unfortunately, he could not possibly spare this opponent just because of this.

“It’s time to end this!” He charged forward, and with a wave of his divine sense, xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu, fourteen streaks of Regulations turned into God Tools that appeared out of thin air, slashing towards Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan resisted with all his might, but his battle prowess dropped again. He was still pierced by one of the blades of Regulations, causing him to scream in pain. His right arm instantly drooped.
Ling Han was neither happy nor angry, and once again shot out a punch.
Peng!
Lin Xuan tried his best to resist, but his arms were crossed over his chest, and they were directly pierced through by a punch.
Pu!
Ling Han’s fist directly pierced through Lin Xuan’s chest. Destructive Energy exploded, instantly annihilating all of Lin Xuan’s vitality.
Lin Xuan’s eyes widened, filled with shock and astonishment.
Had he really died?
Didn’t he have a Substitution Seal?
“You—” He only managed to say a single word before his head tilted, and he collapsed onto the ground.
Ling Han breathed a long sigh of relief. This Golden Generation was truly difficult to kill. It had actually taken him half a month’s time.
However, he had finally killed Lin Xuan in the end, and vented his anger harshly.

He searched Lin Xuan’s corpse, and found a few Spatial Spirit Tools. One of them even contained a considerable number of Celestial medicines, reaching six stars, which was what he was in desperate need of now.

This must have been obtained by Lin Xuan before, but he was already a Venerate Tier elite, so he naturally did not need Six Star Celestial medicines. However, with how precious it was, there was definitely no reason for him to waste it, so he put it away.
Now, however, Ling Han was benefiting from this.
“You have finally done a good deed.” Ling Han smiled faintly. He did not immediately consume the Celestial medicine, but rather began his journey.
Originally, he was the first, but now, in order to hunt down Lin Xuan, he had spent a whole half month’s time. A great many people should have surpassed him by now.
He determined the direction, then advanced.
Another seven days later, another palace appeared ahead of him.
He walked to the door, and saw three words written on it: Golden Roc Palace.
Ling Han was extremely curious. Who had built this?
However, an old man in grey had built a tomb before and buried time. It didn’t seem strange for a Golden Roc Palace to appear here.
He entered the palace, and this time, his six senses weren’t sealed. This was a grand palace, and the walls, ceiling, and ground were all decorated with lifelike golden rocs.

These golden rocs were all different in size, and their movements were also different. Some were spreading their wings and flying high, some were fighting with their prey, and some were sleeping soundly. After Ling Han had taken a few steps, he was presently stepping on a golden roc. Suddenly, with a flash of golden light, this golden roc actually came back to life.
A sharp cry rang out, and the golden roc pounced towards Ling Han. Ling Han met it head-on, but it was incredibly powerful. Its battle prowess was not just a little bit stronger than him.
He still wanted to charge forward, but as he charged forward, he activated even more golden rocs.
Ling Han hurriedly retreated. If he continued to charge forward, he would be seeking death.

Logically speaking, he should have already collapsed.
However, the Golden Generation was still the Golden Generation, after all.
Lin Xuan was filled with a longing for life, and this turned into an incomparable fighting spirit, allowing him to persevere.
Even Ling Han was slightly impressed.
In terms of willpower, Lin Xuan was really tenacious.
Unfortunately, he could not possibly spare this opponent just because of this.

“It’s time to end this!” He charged forward, and with a wave of his divine sense, xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu, fourteen streaks of Regulations turned into God Tools that appeared out of thin air, slashing towards Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan resisted with all his might, but his battle prowess dropped again.
He was still pierced by one of the blades of Regulations, causing him to scream in pain.
His right arm instantly drooped.
Ling Han was neither happy nor angry, and once again shot out a punch.
Peng!
Lin Xuan tried his best to resist, but his arms were crossed over his chest, and they were directly pierced through by a punch.
Pu!
Ling Han’s fist directly pierced through Lin Xuan’s chest.
Destructive Energy exploded, instantly annihilating all of Lin Xuan’s vitality.
Lin Xuan’s eyes widened, filled with shock and astonishment.
Had he really died?
Didn’t he have a Substitution Seal?
“You—” He only managed to say a single word before his head tilted, and he collapsed onto the ground.
Ling Han breathed a long sigh of relief.
This Golden Generation was truly difficult to kill.
It had actually taken him half a month’s time.
However, he had finally killed Lin Xuan in the end, and vented his anger harshly.
He searched Lin Xuan’s corpse, and found a few Spatial Spirit Tools.
One of them even contained a considerable number of Celestial medicines, reaching six stars, which was what he was in desperate need of now.
This must have been obtained by Lin Xuan before, but he was already a Venerate Tier elite, so he naturally did not need Six Star Celestial medicines.
However, with how precious it was, there was definitely no reason for him to waste it, so he put it away.
Now, however, Ling Han was benefiting from this.
“You have finally done a good deed.” Ling Han smiled faintly.
He did not immediately consume the Celestial medicine, but rather began his journey.
Originally, he was the first, but now, in order to hunt down Lin Xuan, he had spent a whole half month’s time.
A great many people should have surpassed him by now.
He determined the direction, then advanced.
Another seven days later, another palace appeared ahead of him.
He walked to the door, and saw three words written on it: Golden Roc Palace.
Ling Han was extremely curious.
Who had built this?
However, an old man in grey had built a tomb before and buried time.
It didn’t seem strange for a Golden Roc Palace to appear here.
He entered the palace, and this time, his six senses weren’t sealed.
This was a grand palace, and the walls, ceiling, and ground were all decorated with lifelike golden rocs.
These golden rocs were all different in size, and their movements were also different.
Some were spreading their wings and flying high, some were fighting with their prey, and some were sleeping soundly.
After Ling Han had taken a few steps, he was presently stepping on a golden roc.
Suddenly, with a flash of golden light, this golden roc actually came back to life.
A sharp cry rang out, and the golden roc pounced towards Ling Han.
Ling Han met it head-on, but it was incredibly powerful.
Its battle prowess was not just a little bit stronger than him.
He still wanted to charge forward, but as he charged forward, he activated even more golden rocs.
Ling Han hurriedly retreated.
If he continued to charge forward, he would be seeking death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4468: Golden Roc Palace
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was extremely disheveled as he fled from the palace.

He was already strong enough, but these golden rocs were all on the level of the Nine Star Sect Master, and were completely comparable to the Golden Generation. Without using his trump card, Ling Han wouldn’t even be able to match one of them, what more a bunch of them?
Thus, it was impossible to barge through this place by force.
Ling Han walked to the entrance of the palace. Previously, he had only drawn it out by stepping on the pattern of the golden roc. Then, what if he directly flew over?
Stepping on empty air, he strode forwards.
However, he had not taken a few steps, when he saw a golden light flash, and another golden roc flew out from the ground, pouncing towards Ling Han.
‘F*ck! It’s useless even if I don’t step on the ground?’
Ling Han sighed. This place was obviously not so easy to pass through.
He started to battle with the golden roc. He unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and the Han Fists, unleashing his full power.
However, he discovered that this golden roc wouldn’t be injured at all.

Right now, to kill a Nine Star Sect Master of the Golden Generation, he could only rely on the Destructive Energy to slowly wear down his opponent’s wounds. This would allow his opponent’s wounds to continue to worsen until they eventually became uncontrollable.
However, this golden roc wouldn’t be injured at all, and it would maintain its strongest state at all times. How was Ling Han supposed to deal with this?
He had no choice but to retreat. There was no point in continuing the battle.
Was it impossible to forcefully barge through or fly through the air?
Ling Han once again returned to the entrance of the palace, and began to carefully observe.
There was no reason that it could not be passed. It was just that he had not found the trick yet.
Ling Han carefully observed, taking in all the images.
After a few minutes, he closed his eyes, but in his mind, images came to life. Those golden rocs danced in his mind.
After a while, he opened his eyes, looked at the ceiling, looked at his surroundings, and then looked at the ground.
A smile slowly appeared at the corners of his lips.
So that was the case.

When the patterns on top, bottom, left, and right were combined, it just happened to be a three-dimensional map of the golden roc hunting. If he stood on this path, he would be attacked, as if he was its prey.
However, there was also the image of the golden roc resting. Standing at this kind of node, he would be safe.
That should be the case.
He took a step, and he had already stepped on a floor tile. As expected, he was safe and sound.
He continued onwards, one step after another, all landing at a safe node.
As expected, his judgement was correct.
Ling Han continued to advance. After spending some time, he arrived at the end of the palace hall. There was a door here that allowed him to walk out.
He took a few more steps, and had already walked out of the palace.
Yi, there were no benefits at all?
Ling Han frowned. Or could it be that he had passed too late, so there was no longer any benefit for him?
Thankfully, he had killed Lin Xuan, and obtained a few Six Star Celestial medicines. Otherwise, he would really have suffered a great loss.
Let’s go.
He quickened his pace, and his figure shot forwards rapidly.
Along the way, he left the mountains and rivers behind him. With Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, his speed was indescribably fast.
Yi?
He could see a dense mist seething ahead of him.
It couldn’t be another place with dense energy, right?

Ling Han flew over, and with a sweep of his gaze, he discovered that what was exuding dense mist was a massive rock, but it was not the Energy Jade that he had previously obtained. This rock was as black as ink, and the aura it exuded was like a sharp blade. Even though it was still very far away, Ling Han still felt a stinging sensation.
And at the top of this large rock, there was actually a plant that was similarly pitch-black. It had bloomed a dark green flower, the size of a palm.
There were still a few people standing under the large rock.
Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, He Luo, Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, Ding Shu, the strongest few of the younger generation were all here.
Sensing Ling Han’s approach, these seven people all cast their eyes over. When they discovered that it was Ling Han, everyone’s eyes narrowed.
Ling Han was too freakish, and could be considered the strongest competitor.
“Yo, everyone is here,” Ling Han waved his hand in greeting.
“You really came at the right time,” Myriad Dao said first.
“What is it?” Ling Han looked towards Ding Shu.

“Just when the destructive power of the Black Ink Stone was about to reach its lowest point, you just happened to appear,” Ding Shu said. “Sigh, there’s going to be another competitor for this Iron Ink Flower.”
Iron Ink Flower?
“Brother Ling is so strong, so why don’t we team up and kick him out of the competition?” Yang Yihuan suddenly suggested.
“All right!” He Luo immediately nodded, his face all smiles.
“Agreed.”
“Agreed.” Ding Shu and the others all nodded.
“Agreed.” Unexpectedly, even Feng Miaoling nodded.
Ling Han looked towards Ding Shu, and couldn’t help but sigh. Was this really his underling?
“Brother Ling, it can’t be helped. You’re too strong. If we don’t work together to kick you out first, then no one will be able to win over you!” Yang Yihuan said with a faint smile.
Of course, this was only an excuse. They were all the top prodigies in the world, so which one of them wasn’t bursting with confidence?
Ling Han sighed, “You guys are the strongest prodigies in the world, after all. Is it appropriate for you to target me like this?”
“Hehe.” Yang Yihuan and the others only smiled, without the slightest bit of embarrassment.
“Why doesn’t anyone tell me what this Iron Ink Flower is?” Ling Han said with a smile. “If it’s useless, there’s no need for you guys to chase me away. I’ll leave by myself.”
“Then you can leave. It really isn’t of much use,” Origin said with a smile.
“Sigh, it’s meaningless to say that.” Ling Han shook his head.
“There’s Celestial Qi contained in the Iron Ink Flower, and it’s of the highest quality.” It was Feng Miaoling who revealed the truth.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. No wonder even someone like Yang Yihuan, who had experienced Imperial Path a few times, was attracted. That was the highest grade of Celestial Qi.
He broke into a grin, “Then I’m sorry. Looks like we really have to fight!”
“Come!”

His majestic aura soared into the sky. The seven people in front of him could be considered the strongest prodigies of the current era. In a one-on-one battle of equal cultivation levels, even the Golden Generation was no match for them.
And now, Ling Han actually wanted to fight the seven of them alone?
If it was anyone else, they would have lost their courage and confidence, right?
However, Ling Han’s fighting spirit soared, and he only wanted to have a vigorous battle.
Yang Yihuan was the first to move, charging towards Ling Han.
Origin and Myriad Dao followed closely behind, unleashing battle prowess that was indescribably terrifying.
Ling Han let out a battle cry and charged forwards.

Under the combined attacks of the three strongest prodigies of the current era, Ling Han didn’t dare to hide his strength anymore. Han Fists was unleashed, and his fighting spirit surged out like an ocean.
“What!”
“He has already created his own path!”

Feng Miaoling and He Luo both exclaimed in shock. Even if they severed their cultivation level and cultivated again and again, they still hadn’t touched the slightest bit of it. They were completely unable to find their own path.
Yet Ling Han had accomplished this!
“Haha, Brother Ling, come fight me!” Origin and Myriad Dao Ling both laughed loudly, and their offensive immediately changed.
Their moves were no longer limited to some kind of Imperial Technique, but were incredibly agile, possessing their intent.
This was... their own path of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4469: Chaotic Battle of the Strongest Prodigies
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
What!

Feng Miaoling and He Luo were given a fright again, and Yang Yihuan was also gritting his teeth. He didn’t expect that aside from Ling Han, there would be another two freaks who had walked their own paths.
Heavens, why had they appeared in this era?
Who would have thought that Ling Han was not the only person who had walked out of his own path of cultivation at the level of Sect Master. There was also Origin, as well as Myriad Dao.
Ling Han smiled and unleashed his murderous aura toward the two of them.

Weng, he immediately discovered that Yang Yihuan was completely unaffected by the barrage of murderous aura. He had rare treasures to resist this kind of attack, and if it was Origin and Myriad Dao, they too used their divine sense to launch a fierce counterattack.

In a one-on-one battle, it was definitely Ling Han’s divine sense that was stronger, but he was multitasking. To attack three people at the same time, the might of the murderous aura naturally decreased slightly, and was just barely dispersed by Origin and Myriad Dao.
In this way, the three of them knew what was going on.
The other... probably had the same origins as him.

If one wanted to cultivate a Mystical Power like the murderous aura, they would have to make use of the Power of Dimension in their bodies when they were in the mortal level, and aside from the Genesis World’s Master, who else could do it?
As expected!
Ling Han had verified it. Origin and Myriad Dao were also the masters of the Genesis World.
En, after the battle, he could trade with them for something like the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram and so on.
The four of them battled fiercely.
Though both Origin and Myriad Dao had walked their own paths, they had clearly just begun, and were far from being comparable to Ling Han.
To make a forceful comparison, then it was possible that they had only taken five or six steps, and if it was Ling Han, he was already a hundred steps away.
Thus, though it was one against three, Ling Han was not at a disadvantage at all.
“Haha, I’m also here to join in on the excitement!” He Luo laughed loudly, and joined the battle.

His fighting spirit soared. In this era, there were actually three people that had walked out on their own path of cultivation, causing him to feel tremendous pressure and excitement. He was going to have a vigorous battle, and who knows, he may be able to gain enlightenment.

Feng Miaoling, Ding Shu, and Heaven Crushing also joined the battle in quick succession. What shocked Yang Yihuan and the other two “old prodigies” was the fact that Ding Shu and Heaven Crushing also walked out of their own paths of martial arts.
‘Holy f*ck!’
They were stunned to the extreme. This kind of prodigy... there were actually as many as five of them?
At the beginning, it was indeed a battle of seven against one, but as the battle continued, the battle situation became chaotic.

They were all prodigies, so they were naturally dissatisfied with each other. Moreover, the space was limited for a seven against one battle, so it was inevitable that they would collide with each other. As they collided, it was inevitable that flames of war would erupt.
The scene was a complete mess. At present, everyone saw everyone else as their enemy, and their battle prowess was fully unleashed. They had no qualms at all, and barged around recklessly.
‘Hmm?’
They could all be considered top-notch elites among Sect Masters, and immediately discovered that the aura exuded by the Black Ink Stone was weakening.
One could harvest herbs now!

Previously, this aura was filled with killing intent, and even they did not dare approach, or they would definitely be killed. But now, this aura was rapidly weakening, which meant that the time was ripe, and they could pluck the Iron Ink Flower.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Their battle became even more intense, with each person unleashing their full power.

There were indeed some that were stronger. It could not be helped. It was impossible for everyone’s cultivation level to be exactly the same, but no matter how strong you were, if you were targeted by two or three people at the same time, there was still nothing you could do.
Hence, everyone was impeded, and could not break out of the siege to pluck that Celestial medicine.
At this point in the battle, everyone was truly angered.

They were all the strongest prodigies of the present generation, and all of them were filled with confidence in themselves. They all thought that they could suppress the masses, and stand out from the masses. Thus, they also set aside their previous agreement.

The value of the Iron Ink Flower was indeed astonishing, but without this kind of treasure, they could still advance. However, if they could suppress the masses now, that would be an indescribable sense of accomplishment.
In their eyes, this could be seen as a prelude to the competition for the throne. In future, the eight of them would be the strongest competitors on the path to becoming Emperor.
Hence, none of them were willing to admit defeat, and all wanted to charge out of the siege.
The Eight Immortals Cross the Sea, each showing their Mystical Power1.

As the battle progressed, those like Ding Shu and Heaven Crushing all used Destructive Energy, but Origin and Myriad Dao still didn’t, making Ling Han suspicious. Though they were the Genesis World’s leaders, it was highly possible that they didn’t obtain the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.
“That should be about it.”
Ling Han was no longer zealous in battle. With a battle cry, he began to break out of the siege aggressively.
He channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and he charged forward. Surging flames burst out, forcing those around him to have no choice but to retreat and temporarily avoid his attacks.

This movement technique was an Imperial Technique in the first place, and possessed super strong attack power. It belonged to the secret technique of the ancient True Phoenix that allowed it to move unhindered in the world, so how could it not be powerful?
Furthermore, it was fast.
Xiu, Ling Han shot out like an arrow of fire, directly breaking through the siege.
Yang Yihuan and the others all gave a loud shout, and chased after Ling Han with all their might. All of them shot out their strongest techniques, determined to stop Ling Han no matter what.
The Iron Ink Flower was a small matter, but whoever could stand out and pluck this Celestial medicine would have an even more important significance.
However, in terms of speed, what movement technique could compare to Phoenix Wings Divine Flight?
Ling Han left them in the dust as he charged toward the top of the boulder.

Now, though the aura exuding from the massive rock had weakened considerably, it still possessed very strong destructive power, turning into streaks of solid light that covered the huge rock like the spikes of a porcupine. Furthermore, this was not static, but was constantly changing in length.
Ling Han had to circle around. He didn’t want to be stung or cut by these rays of light. Otherwise, it would be too late for regrets.
Yang Yihuan and the others did the same. As they gave chase, they continued to dodge these rays of light.

In this way, Ling Han’s speed was still the fastest. With a leap, he appeared above the huge rock, and was just about to stretch out his hand to pluck it, when he saw a hand actually stretch out at the same time, grabbing out at Iron Ink Flower.
‘Hmm?’
This was not the seven people below, but rather someone who had taken advantage of the chaos to make a move.
Ling Han directly channeled Destructive Energy and threw a punch.
Boom, a black-colored energy also ignited on the other’s hand. It was actually... exactly the same!
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with this person, and felt a massive power rebound back at him. Instantly, his arm went numb.
However, the other party was not much better either, and similarly bared his teeth.
Ling Han didn’t have time to waste. He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower which floated above his head before reaching over again.
His opponent tried to block him, yet their attacks were completely useless against the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

Ling Han took advantage of the opening to pluck the Iron Ink Flower, and directly stored it into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Then, he rapidly retreated, and flew down from the giant rock.
Seeing that the Iron Ink Flower had already been plucked by Ling Han, Yang Yihuan and the others also stopped attacking and turned to look at the ninth person who had suddenly appeared.
This was actually a woman!
She was tall and slender, with a slender waist. She was wearing a tight-fitting dress, which completely outlined her graceful curves.
An exquisite celestial maiden!

When they saw her appearance clearly, everyone thought. However, this woman was not the slightest bit weak. Her exquisitely beautiful face had clear lines, and her heroic spirit was reserved. Furthermore, she had an indescribable dominance, like an empress.
She looked at Ling Han with surprise, as if wondering why Ling Han could also use Destructive Energy.

This kind of prodigy... there were actually as many as five of them?
At the beginning, it was indeed a battle of seven against one, but as the battle continued, the battle situation became chaotic.
They were all prodigies, so they were naturally dissatisfied with each other.
Moreover, the space was limited for a seven against one battle, so it was inevitable that they would collide with each other.
As they collided, it was inevitable that flames of war would erupt.
The scene was a complete mess.
At present, everyone saw everyone else as their enemy, and their battle prowess was fully unleashed.
They had no qualms at all, and barged around recklessly.
‘Hmm?’
They could all be considered top-notch elites among Sect Masters, and immediately discovered that the aura exuded by the Black Ink Stone was weakening.
One could harvest herbs now!
Previously, this aura was filled with killing intent, and even they did not dare approach, or they would definitely be killed.
But now, this aura was rapidly weakening, which meant that the time was ripe, and they could pluck the Iron Ink Flower.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Their battle became even more intense, with each person unleashing their full power.
There were indeed some that were stronger.
It could not be helped.

It was impossible for everyone’s cultivation level to be exactly the same, but no matter how strong you were, if you were targeted by two or three people at the same time, there was still nothing you could do.
Hence, everyone was impeded, and could not break out of the siege to pluck that Celestial medicine.
At this point in the battle, everyone was truly angered.
They were all the strongest prodigies of the present generation, and all of them were filled with confidence in themselves.
They all thought that they could suppress the masses, and stand out from the masses.
Thus, they also set aside their previous agreement.
The value of the Iron Ink Flower was indeed astonishing, but without this kind of treasure, they could still advance.
However, if they could suppress the masses now, that would be an indescribable sense of accomplishment.
In their eyes, this could be seen as a prelude to the competition for the throne.
In future, the eight of them would be the strongest competitors on the path to becoming Emperor.
Hence, none of them were willing to admit defeat, and all wanted to charge out of the siege.
The Eight Immortals Cross the Sea, each showing their Mystical Power1.
As the battle progressed, those like Ding Shu and Heaven Crushing all used Destructive Energy, but Origin and Myriad Dao still didn’t, making Ling Han suspicious.
Though they were the Genesis World’s leaders, it was highly possible that they didn’t obtain the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.
“That should be about it.”
Ling Han was no longer zealous in battle.
With a battle cry, he began to break out of the siege aggressively.
He channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and he charged forward.
Surging flames burst out, forcing those around him to have no choice but to retreat and temporarily avoid his attacks.
This movement technique was an Imperial Technique in the first place, and possessed super strong attack power.
It belonged to the secret technique of the ancient True Phoenix that allowed it to move unhindered in the world, so how could it not be powerful?
Furthermore, it was fast.
Xiu, Ling Han shot out like an arrow of fire, directly breaking through the siege.
Yang Yihuan and the others all gave a loud shout, and chased after Ling Han with all their might.
All of them shot out their strongest techniques, determined to stop Ling Han no matter what.
The Iron Ink Flower was a small matter, but whoever could stand out and pluck this Celestial medicine would have an even more important significance.
However, in terms of speed, what movement technique could compare to Phoenix Wings Divine Flight?
Ling Han left them in the dust as he charged toward the top of the boulder.

Now, though the aura exuding from the massive rock had weakened considerably, it still possessed very strong destructive power, turning into streaks of solid light that covered the huge rock like the spikes of a porcupine.
Furthermore, this was not static, but was constantly changing in length.
Ling Han had to circle around.
He didn’t want to be stung or cut by these rays of light.
Otherwise, it would be too late for regrets.
Yang Yihuan and the others did the same.
As they gave chase, they continued to dodge these rays of light.
In this way, Ling Han’s speed was still the fastest.
With a leap, he appeared above the huge rock, and was just about to stretch out his hand to pluck it, when he saw a hand actually stretch out at the same time, grabbing out at Iron Ink Flower.
‘Hmm?’
This was not the seven people below, but rather someone who had taken advantage of the chaos to make a move.
Ling Han directly channeled Destructive Energy and threw a punch.
Boom, a black-colored energy also ignited on the other’s hand.
It was actually... exactly the same!
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with this person, and felt a massive power rebound back at him.
Instantly, his arm went numb.
However, the other party was not much better either, and similarly bared his teeth.
Ling Han didn’t have time to waste.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower which floated above his head before reaching over again.
His opponent tried to block him, yet their attacks were completely useless against the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to pluck the Iron Ink Flower, and directly stored it into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Then, he rapidly retreated, and flew down from the giant rock.
Seeing that the Iron Ink Flower had already been plucked by Ling Han, Yang Yihuan and the others also stopped attacking and turned to look at the ninth person who had suddenly appeared.
This was actually a woman!
She was tall and slender, with a slender waist.
She was wearing a tight-fitting dress, which completely outlined her graceful curves.
An exquisite celestial maiden!
When they saw her appearance clearly, everyone thought.
However, this woman was not the slightest bit weak.
Her exquisitely beautiful face had clear lines, and her heroic spirit was reserved.
Furthermore, she had an indescribable dominance, like an empress.
She looked at Ling Han with surprise, as if wondering why Ling Han could also use Destructive Energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4470: Seven Rulers
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Beauty, what’s your name?” Ding Shu was the first to speak.
The woman swept an eye over them, parted her red lips slightly, and said, “Shui Qingchang.”
“Yo, so lively. Have I come too late?” A voice that sounded like it was asking for a beating rang out, and Jing Haoran’s figure streaked past, and landed.

From the very beginning, he showed his suicidal nature, throwing coquettish glances at Feng Miaoling and Shui Qingchang. “These two young misses are so beautiful. Are you interested in having dinner with me tonight?”
“Get lost!” Feng Miaoling and Shui Qingchang moved at the same time. Boom, the terrifying attack turned into a turbulent wave.

Jing Haoran hurriedly retreated, dodging this blow. Then, he patted his chest, as if a heavy burden had been lifted from his shoulders, “Fortunately, I have been practicing my escape techniques. Otherwise, I would really be in serious trouble!”
Everyone was speechless. You are so despicable, so why haven’t you died yet?
Good people really didn’t live long, while bad people lived for a thousand years.
“Come, let’s battle again!” He Luo’s heroic spirit soared, and he was the first to launch an attack, blasting towards Ling Han and the others.
Chaotic battles broke out again.
This time, without the Iron Ink Flower, everyone’s purpose of battle had instead become even purer.
I am the strongest!
“Interesting, interesting!” Jing Haoran smiled, and actually leaped into the fray as well.
On the other side, Shui Qingchang also charged in after a moment of hesitation.

Previously, the battle royale of eight people was already chaotic enough, and now, it had become ten people, and what was even more shocking was that whether it was Jing Haoran or Shui Qingchang, they had both walked out on their own paths of cultivation.
Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and Feng Miaoling were all astounded by this. In fact, they even wanted to buy a block of tofu and smack themselves to death.
They called themselves prodigies, and didn’t even take the Golden Generation seriously, but compared with Ling Han and the others, they were like retards.
How could they bring themselves to look down on others?
The more people there were, the more dangerous the battle royale would be, because you didn’t know how many attacks would be directed at you at the same time.
Thus, as they fought, this battle gradually became more conservative. Everyone focused on defense.
In this way, it was no longer interesting.
Ling Han was the first to stop fighting. However, people gradually retreated from the battle, and in the end, everyone stopped.
They exchanged looks, and an alarm bell rang in their hearts.

The ten people here should be the strongest competitors in the future on the Imperial Path. What Golden Generation? They merely had a slight advantage in cultivation level because they had cultivated a few years earlier. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, hoho.
If this kind of assessment was known to outsiders, they would definitely say that they had gone mad.
—Hadn’t the Golden Generation always been synonymous with the strongest? Now, they were actually looked down on like this?
Ling Han looked at Shui Qingchang, and asked with a smile, “Shall we trade?”
“All right,” Shui Qingchang nodded. She naturally knew what Ling Han meant.
“I’m still here!” Jing Haoran raised his hand and said.
What rendered them speechless was the fact that not only was this guy also the Genesis World’s leader, he had even mastered a corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh in emotion. How was such a person able to cultivate to become the strongest of the Genesis World?

Ding Shu, and the others were also eager to give it a try. They already knew that Shui Qingchang and Jing Haoran were the masters of Genesis World, possessing a corner of Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.

However, they didn’t rush it either. Ding Shu traded with Heaven Crushing first, while Origin and Myriad Dao’s gazes were slightly adrift. As the Genesis World’s Masters, they actually didn’t manage to grasp this incomparably powerful high-level energy.
They had fallen behind!
Ling Han exchanged Destructive Energy Spirit Diagrams with Shui Qingchang, and they both started to cultivate on the sidelines.
The Genesis World’s leaders all had outstanding comprehension ability. After all, they were prodigies that had stood out from the infinite dimensions, so how could they not be smart?
In just half a day’s time, they all stood up and traded back the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.
Ling Han went to find Jing Haoran again, and made another trade.
—Just how many chances had there been previously? Unfortunately, neither of them had used their trump card, so neither of them knew that the other’s origins were the same as theirs.
After another half a day, Ling Han left in satisfaction. As for how Shui Qingchang, Ding Shu, and the others were going to trade, that was none of his business.
He now had eight corners of the Spirit Diagram.

Ling Han’s heart burned with desire. As long as he obtained one more corner, he would be able to obtain the complete version of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram. At that time, just how terrifying would the Destructive Energy be?
He swept an eye over them. Those like Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, He Luo, Origin, and Myriad Dao had already left first because it had nothing to do with them.
He was leaving.
He activated his movement technique and found a secluded location. He then started to refine the Celestial medicine.

The battle royale previously allowed him to understand that though his freakish talent was unmatched, he was slightly behind in terms of cultivation level. For example, Heaven Crushing and Shui Qingchang had both reached the level of Four-Star Sect Master.
Thus, he had to raise his cultivation level as soon as possible.

Excluding Feng Miaoling and the other “old monsters”, for those like Ding Shu, Shui Qingchang, and the other Genesis World Masters, the degree of freakishness was only slightly inferior to him. They completely had hopes of becoming Emperor.

And one would know just by looking at history. Some Emperors were not the strongest prodigies of that era. Of course, they were not weak either, and were only slightly inferior. In the end, their fated opportunity defied the heavens, and they surpassed their competition at the last moment.
Thus, he definitely could not be careless. Otherwise, if he missed the imperial throne because of his own negligence, there would really be no room for regret.
He first took out the six-star Celestial medicine that he had obtained from Lin Xuan, and began to refine the Celestial medicine.
A wisp of weak Celestial Qi was extracted by him, nourishing the Dao Fruit Tree.

This thing specialized in eating Celestial Qi. Previously, no matter how Ling Han used mystical power to irrigate it, it did not have the slightest reaction, but once the Celestial Qi entered, it immediately thrived and grew, its speed extremely fast.
However, there was only a sliver of Celestial Qi, and it was immediately used completely.
Eat again.
Ling Han took out the second Celestial medicine, and began chewing on it.
He obtained another wisp of Celestial Qi, which he quickly used up again.
When he refined the last Celestial medicine, aside from the Iron Ink Flower, the Dao Fruit Tree finally matured, blooming a fist-sized flower. Then, it rapidly wilted, bearing a tiny fruit.
This fruit was only the size of a walnut. It was circular in shape, and there was a golden thread on it.
A golden line signified that he was a One Star Sect Master.
Ling Han wanted to cry but had no tears. He had paid such a great price, and he was actually considered a One Star Sect Master now?
Then what was he before?
He sighed, took out the Iron Ink Flower, and began to gnaw on it like a cow chewing on a peony1.
The taste was really not good.
Ling Han evaluated as he ate, but though the taste was not good, he did not waste the slightest bit, and ate the root as well.
“Fortunately, cultivators have strong physiques, or else what if they get a stomachache?”
Ling Han realized that he was showing signs of becoming like Jing Haoran, and hurriedly stopped himself from complaining further.

Boom, this was awesome. The Celestial Qi surged, turning into a silver phoenix that bared its fangs and brandished its claws, as if it was unwilling to be refined by Ling Han, and wanted to charge out.
‘Hehe, you’ve already entered my body, yet you still want to commit violence?’
Ling Han channelled the Imperial Scroll and forcefully suppressed the medicinal effects.
Not long after, this silver phoenix became obedient. Wisps of Celestial Qi seeped out, and was absorbed by him.
