chapters.title: Chapter 4471: Two Star Sect Master
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In his mind, the Dao Fruit Tree did not grow any further, but the fruit of cultivation was rapidly growing in size.
The golden line on the fruit of cultivation became darker and darker, and finally, there was no more change.
Ling Han discovered that there was clearly still Celestial Qi left, but the Dao Fruit Tree was no longer absorbing it.
‘What is it? Disdaining it now?’
No.

Ling Han shook his head. This was because he had already reached the limit of a One Star Sect Master. Thus, he now needed to break through the barrier to Two Star Sect Master, before he could continue to absorb Celestial Qi to increase his cultivation level.
It was fine. In any case, the Celestial Qi was locked inside his body, and could not possibly dissipate for the moment.
Ling Han began to break through to become a Two-Star Sect Master. This was completely his comprehension of the Regulations of heaven and earth, and was also the “fertilizer” for the Dao Fruit Tree.
Speaking of comprehension ability, he naturally did not lack it. His hands pressed down on empty air, and the Regulations actually solidified one after another, which he easily grasped.
Endless enlightenment blossomed in his mind, and he revealed a smile.
Boom!

In his mind, the Dao Fruit Tree suddenly began to grow again. It only stopped when it had grown one third taller, and on the fruit of cultivation, a second golden line appeared, though it appeared much dimmer than the first.
Two Stars.
Because there was still Celestial Qi, Ling Han naturally continued.
With the nourishment of the Celestial Qi, the fruit of cultivation continued to grow, but even when the Celestial Qi was completely exhausted, the second golden thread had not reached its limit.
Which also meant that he was still a bit away from the peak stage of Two Star Sect Master.
This speed was already fast enough.

In the outside world, he could only rely on luck to capture the Celestial Qi that had appeared in the high-level dimension. That would really be a chance that would disappear in a flash. Perhaps, it would take a hundred years, a thousand years, or even longer in fact, before he could take a small step forwards.
Ling Han stood up, then quickly threw a punch.
Fifteen Regulations.

He was surprised. When he had been a One Star Sect Master, he had been able to deliver fourteen flashes of Regulations with a single strike, but after advancing into Two Stars, his improvement was actually so small?
However, when he thought about how ordinary Sect Masters could only fire out nine Regulations with a single strike when they reached Nine Stars, what did he have to complain about?

“My foundations are too good. Hence, the moment I advance into Sect Master-level I would be able to crush an ordinary nine-star Sect Master.” Ling Han nodded. However, the heavens were also just, and could not possibly allow him to be unjustly strong.

“Sigh!” Ling Han shook his head. At first, he had thought that after advancing into Two Stars, he would be able to beat up Yang Yihuan and the others, but in the end, his improvement was only so slight.
Thankfully, the increase in power was very obvious, so he finally felt a sense of accomplishment after breaking through.
“Let’s continue forward.”
He had been delayed for a few days, so he had probably fallen far behind the others again.
Ling Han flew over, using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. He wanted to shorten the distance between him and the people in front of him as much as possible.
Three days later, another palace appeared ahead of him.
Yi, were the people on the Imperial Path so fond of building palaces?
Ling Han arrived at the entrance of the palace hall. He raised his head and saw the words “Fire Tiger Palace” written on it.
He thought back to the Golden Roc Palace. After entering, would there be flaming tigers all over the walls?
As he mocked, he walked into the palace.
Yi?

He was astounded. The walls and ground were quite clean, and there was no graffiti, but in this hall, there was a massive flaming tiger that was napping. With a single exclamation, flames spluttered out of its nostrils, turning into two long fire dragons. Then, with an inhalation, the flames were drawn back.
This feeling was like a child playing with snot, inhaling and exhaling.
“No, I can’t go further and further on this path of mockery.” Ling Han gritted his teeth. Just think about Jing Haoran; he was hated by everyone.
He looked at the flaming tiger again, then assessed its battle prowess in his mind.
“I feel like it’s Nine Star Sect Master, but as for his battle prowess, we’ll only know after a battle.”
Ling Han took another step. Weng, as if something had been triggered, the giant flaming tiger suddenly woke up, opened its eyes, and looked towards Ling Han.
“Little guy, do you also want to challenge me?” the giant flaming tiger said loudly, directly reverberating in Ling Han’s mind, as if it wanted to directly shatter his soul.
This was not a real living being.
Ling Han nodded internally. This was reasonable. Otherwise, how could it be possible to live for tens of millions of years?
“Can I only pass through here if I defeat you?” Ling Han asked.
“Hehe, as long as you can block a single move from me, you can leave,” the fiery giant tiger said. “However, the more moves you can block from me, the shorter the path I’ll arrange for you to take.”
“He, you have to know that there are some passageways that you would not even be able to walk out of in a year and a half.”
Ling Han nodded, and said, “Then please give me some guidance, Lord Tiger King.”

The words ‘Tiger King’ seemed to tickle the fiery tiger, and this fiery tiger enjoyed it very much. It said, “Seeing that you are so sensible, no matter which level you pass, I will increase the specifications another level.”
“Thank you, Lord Tiger King.” Ling Han clasped his fists. In any case, he wouldn’t lose anything by saying a few good words.
“Come,” the fiery giant tiger said.
Ling Han charged out. Boom, Han Fists was used. At the first instant, he unleashed his full battle prowess.
“Yi?” The fiery giant tiger couldn’t help but be startled. It had not thought that Ling Han’s battle prowess would actually be so astonishing.

As the guard here, its abilities were naturally strong. However, against Venerate Tiers and Sect Masters, it couldn’t treat them the same. Its battle prowess would definitely make corresponding adjustments, guaranteeing that it could suppress its opponents, but not render them completely hopeless.
However, the strength of Ling Han’s battle prowess gave it a shock.
“What a little guy!” it exclaimed. Then, it sent out a palm strike, which smashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han brandished his fists to parry. Fifteen flashes of Regulations surged, as dazzling as flowers.
Boom!
In a head-on clash, Ling Han instantly gritted his teeth.
This fiery tiger was unbelievably strong!
He clearly wasn’t a Venerate Tier, yet with a swipe of his claw, 20 flashes of Regulations lit up at the same time.
Whether it was power or Regulations, the fiery tiger had far surpassed the Nine Star Sect Master, and even the strongest Sect Master in history could not possibly reach this kind of height.
Obviously, the fire tiger’s battle prowess limit was definitely Venerate Tier-level. Thus, if it used the six-star Regulations, the number could completely surpass the limits of a Sect Master.
This was too unfair.
Thankfully, he did not have to defeat this opponent. He only had to block a few more moves as much as possible.
He went all out, using the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to dodge and parry the fire tiger’s attacks. He tried his best to drag things out.
After a hundred moves, no matter how freakish Ling Han was, he was still at the end of his rope. He was forced into a dead end by the fire tiger, and there was no more space for him to move.
“Little guy, I’ve finally caught you!” The giant flaming tiger laughed loudly, and waved its claws again, planning to completely defeat Ling Han.
However, right at this moment, Primal Chaos Qi surged. Peng, this claw was actually blocked.
Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!
The fiery tiger was dumbfounded. ‘This, why do you still have trump cards?’
“There’s no rule against using Spirit Tools, right?” Ling Han said with a smile.

The fire tiger subconsciously shook its head. There was indeed no such rule. Furthermore, even if you used a high-level Spirit Tool, its battle prowess would also be adjusted accordingly. Instead, it would only speed up your defeat.
But the problem was, the Spirit Tool in Ling Han’s hands... was only Sect Master-level.

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
In his mind, the Dao Fruit Tree did not grow any further, but the fruit of cultivation was rapidly growing in size.
The golden line on the fruit of cultivation became darker and darker, and finally, there was no more change.
Ling Han discovered that there was clearly still Celestial Qi left, but the Dao Fruit Tree was no longer absorbing it.
‘What is it?
Disdaining it now?’
No.
Ling Han shook his head.
This was because he had already reached the limit of a One Star Sect Master.
Thus, he now needed to break through the barrier to Two Star Sect Master, before he could continue to absorb Celestial Qi to increase his cultivation level.
It was fine.
In any case, the Celestial Qi was locked inside his body, and could not possibly dissipate for the moment.
Ling Han began to break through to become a Two-Star Sect Master.
This was completely his comprehension of the Regulations of heaven and earth, and was also the “fertilizer” for the Dao Fruit Tree.
Speaking of comprehension ability, he naturally did not lack it.
His hands pressed down on empty air, and the Regulations actually solidified one after another, which he easily grasped.
Endless enlightenment blossomed in his mind, and he revealed a smile.
Boom!
In his mind, the Dao Fruit Tree suddenly began to grow again.
It only stopped when it had grown one third taller, and on the fruit of cultivation, a second golden line appeared, though it appeared much dimmer than the first.
Two Stars.
Because there was still Celestial Qi, Ling Han naturally continued.
With the nourishment of the Celestial Qi, the fruit of cultivation continued to grow, but even when the Celestial Qi was completely exhausted, the second golden thread had not reached its limit.
Which also meant that he was still a bit away from the peak stage of Two Star Sect Master.
This speed was already fast enough.
In the outside world, he could only rely on luck to capture the Celestial Qi that had appeared in the high-level dimension.
That would really be a chance that would disappear in a flash.
Perhaps, it would take a hundred years, a thousand years, or even longer in fact, before he could take a small step forwards.
Ling Han stood up, then quickly threw a punch.
Fifteen Regulations.
He was surprised.
When he had been a One Star Sect Master, he had been able to deliver fourteen flashes of Regulations with a single strike, but after advancing into Two Stars, his improvement was actually so small?
However, when he thought about how ordinary Sect Masters could only fire out nine Regulations with a single strike when they reached Nine Stars, what did he have to complain about?
“My foundations are too good.
Hence, the moment I advance into Sect Master-level I would be able to crush an ordinary nine-star Sect Master.” Ling Han nodded.
However, the heavens were also just, and could not possibly allow him to be unjustly strong.
“Sigh!” Ling Han shook his head.
At first, he had thought that after advancing into Two Stars, he would be able to beat up Yang Yihuan and the others, but in the end, his improvement was only so slight.
Thankfully, the increase in power was very obvious, so he finally felt a sense of accomplishment after breaking through.
“Let’s continue forward.”
He had been delayed for a few days, so he had probably fallen far behind the others again.
Ling Han flew over, using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
He wanted to shorten the distance between him and the people in front of him as much as possible.
Three days later, another palace appeared ahead of him.
Yi, were the people on the Imperial Path so fond of building palaces?
Ling Han arrived at the entrance of the palace hall.
He raised his head and saw the words “Fire Tiger Palace” written on it.
He thought back to the Golden Roc Palace.
After entering, would there be flaming tigers all over the walls?
As he mocked, he walked into the palace.
Yi?
He was astounded.
The walls and ground were quite clean, and there was no graffiti, but in this hall, there was a massive flaming tiger that was napping.
With a single exclamation, flames spluttered out of its nostrils, turning into two long fire dragons.
Then, with an inhalation, the flames were drawn back.
This feeling was like a child playing with snot, inhaling and exhaling.
“No, I can’t go further and further on this path of mockery.” Ling Han gritted his teeth.
Just think about Jing Haoran; he was hated by everyone.
He looked at the flaming tiger again, then assessed its battle prowess in his mind.
“I feel like it’s Nine Star Sect Master, but as for his battle prowess, we’ll only know after a battle.”
Ling Han took another step.
Weng, as if something had been triggered, the giant flaming tiger suddenly woke up, opened its eyes, and looked towards Ling Han.
“Little guy, do you also want to challenge me?” the giant flaming tiger said loudly, directly reverberating in Ling Han’s mind, as if it wanted to directly shatter his soul.
This was not a real living being.
Ling Han nodded internally.
This was reasonable.
Otherwise, how could it be possible to live for tens of millions of years?
“Can I only pass through here if I defeat you?” Ling Han asked.
“Hehe, as long as you can block a single move from me, you can leave,” the fiery giant tiger said.
“However, the more moves you can block from me, the shorter the path I’ll arrange for you to take.”
“He, you have to know that there are some passageways that you would not even be able to walk out of in a year and a half.”
Ling Han nodded, and said, “Then please give me some guidance, Lord Tiger King.”
The words ‘Tiger King’ seemed to tickle the fiery tiger, and this fiery tiger enjoyed it very much.
It said, “Seeing that you are so sensible, no matter which level you pass, I will increase the specifications another level.”
“Thank you, Lord Tiger King.” Ling Han clasped his fists.
In any case, he wouldn’t lose anything by saying a few good words.
“Come,” the fiery giant tiger said.
Ling Han charged out.
Boom, Han Fists was used.
At the first instant, he unleashed his full battle prowess.
“Yi?” The fiery giant tiger couldn’t help but be startled.
It had not thought that Ling Han’s battle prowess would actually be so astonishing.
As the guard here, its abilities were naturally strong.
However, against Venerate Tiers and Sect Masters, it couldn’t treat them the same.
Its battle prowess would definitely make corresponding adjustments, guaranteeing that it could suppress its opponents, but not render them completely hopeless.
However, the strength of Ling Han’s battle prowess gave it a shock.
“What a little guy!” it exclaimed.
Then, it sent out a palm strike, which smashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han brandished his fists to parry.
Fifteen flashes of Regulations surged, as dazzling as flowers.
Boom!
In a head-on clash, Ling Han instantly gritted his teeth.
This fiery tiger was unbelievably strong!
He clearly wasn’t a Venerate Tier, yet with a swipe of his claw, 20 flashes of Regulations lit up at the same time.
Whether it was power or Regulations, the fiery tiger had far surpassed the Nine Star Sect Master, and even the strongest Sect Master in history could not possibly reach this kind of height.
Obviously, the fire tiger’s battle prowess limit was definitely Venerate Tier-level.
Thus, if it used the six-star Regulations, the number could completely surpass the limits of a Sect Master.
This was too unfair.
Thankfully, he did not have to defeat this opponent.
He only had to block a few more moves as much as possible.
He went all out, using the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to dodge and parry the fire tiger’s attacks.
He tried his best to drag things out.
After a hundred moves, no matter how freakish Ling Han was, he was still at the end of his rope.
He was forced into a dead end by the fire tiger, and there was no more space for him to move.
“Little guy, I’ve finally caught you!” The giant flaming tiger laughed loudly, and waved its claws again, planning to completely defeat Ling Han.
However, right at this moment, Primal Chaos Qi surged.
Peng, this claw was actually blocked.
Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!
The fiery tiger was dumbfounded.
‘This, why do you still have trump cards?’
“There’s no rule against using Spirit Tools, right?” Ling Han said with a smile.
The fire tiger subconsciously shook its head.
There was indeed no such rule.
Furthermore, even if you used a high-level Spirit Tool, its battle prowess would also be adjusted accordingly.
Instead, it would only speed up your defeat.
But the problem was, the Spirit Tool in Ling Han’s hands... was only Sect Master-level.

chapters.title: Chapter 4472: Alchemy Saint’s Abode
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Since Ling Han was only using a six-star Spirit Tool, how could it possibly use Venerate Tier-level power?
This was inconsistent with the rules.
Even if it was incredibly strong, it did not dare to break the rules. This was the basis for its survival. If it disobeyed the rules, it would immediately die.
The fiery tiger was speechless. How could there be such an opponent?
Helpless, it could only strengthen its attacks begrudgingly to defeat Ling Han as soon as possible.
Its battle prowess actually surpassed the level of Sect Master. Though it was only using six-star Regulations, what Sect Master could deliver twenty Regulations in a single strike?
Hence, within the same cultivation level, no one could defeat it.

The problem was that Ling Han, added with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, was also the strongest existence among Sect Masters. Though he was not as strong as the fire tiger, if it was just delaying time, there was no problem at all.
Two hundred moves, three hundred moves, five hundred moves.
The fiery tiger didn’t even want to fight anymore. At this time, even if it defeated Ling Han, it wouldn’t make much difference. He would definitely be given the shortest path.
Boom!
However, for the sake of its pride, the giant flaming tiger still attacked aggressively, and finally defeated Ling Han.
“Lord Tiger King is truly impressive!” Ling Han praised. “Among those at the same cultivation level, you’re the first to defeat me.”
‘Holy f*ck! Is this a compliment?’

The fire tiger couldn’t laugh at all. It actually the strength of a supreme Venerate Tier elite. This was the result of having its battle prowess suppressed. However, it still used more than 500 moves to defeat Ling Han. This was practically a humiliation to the tiger.
“You can leave.” It waved a paw, and instantly, a ray of light wrapped around Ling Han, instantly sending him away.
What the eye doesn’t see, the heart doesn’t grieve over. It felt tired.
Xiu, Ling Han entered a passageway. This place was empty, and there was no other person.
He strode forwards, and in only a day’s time, he had walked out. Ahead of him was a stretch of rolling hills.
So fast, it had only been a day.
Ling Han recalled what the fire tiger had said before. The longest passage would take about a year and a half. In comparison, he practically hadn’t wasted any time.
He smiled confidently. In terms of endurance, he himself, added with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, could really be considered the number one in the world.
By now, he should have regained his first place, right?
Unfortunately, he was clearly the first person to pass, so why wasn’t there any reward?
Ling Han thought for a moment. Perhaps the shortest amount of time would be the reward.
Would there be any great fortune on this path?
There was a glimmer in his eyes as he continued to scan the surroundings.
After walking for a while, he couldn’t help but be startled, because he saw an ancient battlefield.
In this place, corpses lay everywhere, bones were everywhere, and broken armor was everywhere.
Strange, why was there an ancient battlefield here?
Ling Han walked in, wanting to see if this battlefield really existed, and not just an illusion.
The wind blew past lightly, causing the sand to flutter. In some places, even the bones buried underground could be seen.

Ling Han bent down and picked up a piece of Battle Armor. It had been too long, and it had also suffered a very heavy blow. It had long since turned into ordinary metal, and was shattered with a light squeeze, fluttering in the wind.
However, Ling Han was certain that a long time ago, this was at least a Six Star Divine Metal.

He had seen a great many broken pieces of armour, and discovered that the majority of their raw materials were Six or Seven Star-level, which also meant that the level of the battle at that time was considerably high.

Furthermore, Sect Masters and Venerate Tiers generally wouldn’t wear Battle Armors. This would affect their flexibility to a certain extent. Only during large-scale battles would they wear Battle Armors to avoid attacks going off-course.
In the past, just how large would the scale of this battle have been?
Ling Han looked around as he walked, searching for anything valuable that had been left behind.
Unfortunately, even if it was a high-level Divine Metal, it had still turned into ordinary metal due to the corrosion of time, and its divinity was gone.

What a waste. This was too much of a waste. How many Six Stars and Seven Stars Divine Metal were there here? If he sold them, he would be able to exchange them for a considerable number of high-level Celestial medicines.
After walking for half a day, he suddenly saw a broken stone tablet.
There were words on it.

Ling Han walked over, and with a sweep of his gaze, he saw that it was written in the oldest characters. The unique trait of the words of that era was their simplicity. One word could express a very deep meaning.
However, it was also because of this that it would be extremely difficult for future generations to read it.
Ling Han read with great difficulty, and after quite a while, he finally understood what was written here.
As it turned out, there was an Alchemy Saint buried here!
And the reason why a war had broken out here was also because there were four forces fighting over the supreme alchemical pill that the Alchemy Saint had left behind.
However, the stone tablet had broken off, so the contents recorded here were not complete either.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his heart skip a beat.
Alchemy Saint!
He could now concoct Seven Star alchemical pills. In fact, with the strength of his divine sense, he could even just barely attempt concocting a Saint Pill.
What Ling Han lacked was pill recipes. After all, every pill recipe was finally confirmed after a flash of inspiration from predecessors, after countless attempts of experimentation.

At present, he did not have the time to make such an attempt. Thus, with the recipes for the alchemical pill that was readily available, he naturally could concoct a Six Star, Seven Star, or even Saint Grade alchemical pill.
Let’s go and take a look at the abode of that Alchemy Saint.
Ling Han set off in a flash, and following the instructions of the stone tablet, he soon arrived at his destination.
The abode had already been opened. Only one of the two great doors was open, while the other had already been beaten to the point that only half was left. Looking inside, it was a complete mess.
It was clear that this place had already been visited many years ago.
Could there still be any gains?
Ling Han held onto a sliver of hope, and walked in.
Main hall, empty, bedroom, empty, alchemy storage, empty... Ling Han walked around, and finally arrived at the alchemy chamber. In other places, he had zero gains.
After stepping in, Ling Han suddenly discovered that the originally chaotic alchemy chamber had miraculously recovered.

—Originally, the alchemy cauldron had been lying on the ground, and now it was standing erect, completely unscathed. The shelf that had originally held the medicinal ingredients had already collapsed, but was now as good as new.
Just as Ling Han was feeling surprised, a white-bearded old man walked in. Without waiting for him to react, he passed through Ling Han’s body, as if he did not have a physical body.
Ling Han instantly came to a realization. This should have been a remnant scene from who knew how many years ago, and now, like an image, it was repeating itself.
Then, this was the Alchemy Saint?
At first, Ling Han had already given up hope, but now, hope was burning again.

As the Alchemy Saint walked, he was picking medicinal ingredients from the shelves. At the same time, he mumbled, “The pill recipe for the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill should be completed today! I’ve been thinking hard for ninety-three years, and as long as I trade the Black Leaf Grass for the Hard Yellow Root, there won’t be any problem.”
As he spoke, he took out medicinal ingredients and began to concoct.
If it was another person, they would definitely be wearing a dumbfounded expression.
That was because even if he looked, it would be useless. If he did not know how to concoct alchemical pills, it would be useless no matter how closely he looked.
But for Ling Han, this was very useful.
—How could he not understand with the Alchemy Saint demonstrating right on the spot?

chapters.title: Chapter 4473: Receiving pill recipes
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Three days later, the Alchemy Saint successfully concocted the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
Ling Han broke into a grin. He had also successfully grasped the method to concoct this alchemical pill.
“Seven Star Venerate Tier-level!”

Ling Han murmured to himself. Though he had indeed grasped a few Seven Star pill recipes, they did not improve his cultivation level, and in the case of this Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, it could refine the Celestial Qi in the Celestial medicine, and improve its grade.
This was astonishing, and its value could not be any greater.
“However, I’ve never heard of such alchemical pills. They’ve either been lost, or they’re in the hands of a limited number of forces. It’s impossible for them to be taught to outsiders.”
Just for the sake of this pill recipe, Ling Han felt like he had made a huge profit.
Celestial Qi was too rare, and there were pitifully few high-level Celestial Qi. Being able to improve its grade through alchemy, how many people would go crazy for it?
Right at this moment, the illusion disappeared. Ling Han was just about to leave, but he didn’t expect that Alchemy Saint to appear again.
He was still concocting alchemical pills, but in a different manner.
This time, it was directly a Saint Pill.

In the case of Saint Pills, every Saint could theoretically refine their own pills. However, they would need to use their own blood essence as a medium, and that would consume too much of their own blood essence. Furthermore, the types of Saint Pills that could be refined were extremely limited.
Thus, it was naturally still more convenient for an alchemist to do the concoction. Furthermore, there were a wide variety of them, and they could be custom-made.

Ling Han didn’t care whether he could refine Saint Pills or not. Even if he could, he didn’t have the ability to obtain the ingredients. He only needed to memorize it now, and it would definitely be useful in the future.
Five days later, the Saint Pill was completed.
The illusion disappeared, and then came back again. This time, it had become a Six Star Celestial pill.
Ling Han’s interest was piqued. This was because he was only at the Sect Master level right now. What he needed was precisely the Six Stars Celestial Pill.

He did not know the name of the alchemical pill that the Alchemy Saint had concocted, because it was not every time that the Alchemy Saint would speak to himself, but with his understanding of alchemy, he was sure that this alchemical pill was more or less the same as the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill. It could elevate the level of Celestial Qi.
That was because the ingredients used to concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill were more or less the same, and the technique was exactly the same.
Then let’s call it Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
In terms of naming, Ling Han had always been incompetent. Thus, it was naturally just so-so and casually named.
He was immersed in it, and continued to study it. He memorized pill recipe after pill recipe, and his heart was filled with satisfaction.
He was indeed a prodigy-level martial artist, but in his bones, he was also an alchemist!
“It’s a shame that I ingested all of the Celestial medicines before. Otherwise, if I refine them now and increase the quality of the Celestial Qi, perhaps I’ll already be a Three Star Sect Master!”
The quality of the Celestial Qi had too great an influence on the fruit of cultivation. It not only determined the rate of growth of the fruit of cultivation, but also its quality.
Ling Han felt extreme regret. Unfortunately, who would have thought that he would relive the experience of an Alchemy Saint here?
He soon let go of his thoughts of loss and gain, and continued to observe.
However, a month later, the images he saw were repeated. Furthermore, when it was the second time, the images were clearly slightly blurred.
In other words, not everyone could obtain this kind of good fortune.
Ling Han smiled sheepishly. Out of those that could come here, how many of them were alchemists?
He gritted his teeth. Unknowingly, he had stayed here for another month. He probably wouldn’t be able to keep his first place again.
Hurry up.
He walked out of the abode and continued to advance.

After leaving the area of the ancient battlefield, there was a great ocean ahead of him, but flying over it was completely no problem. Another seven days later, he discovered an island, and searched around the island. He actually found a Six Star Celestial medicine. Unfortunately, it did not contain Celestial Qi.
This made Ling Han a little disappointed, but he still put away the Celestial medicine, and continued onwards.

Since he had gained something, it was very likely that he was still in the lead. Of course, it was also possible that he had still fallen behind. However, the people in front of him were completely focused on rushing, and had no thought of searching this island at all.

He hoped that this kind of gain would be more. It would be best if he could get him a few Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi. He wanted to try concocting the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
Another few days later, Ling Han discovered the second island. However, this time, after searching once, he discovered that there were traces of excavation on the ground, and it was very new.
Obviously, there was indeed someone in front of him. Previously, he had not made a move, but when he saw the second island, the other party could not hold himself back.
Ling Han activated his movement technique. He didn’t advance in a straight line, but rather slightly changed his direction.
Another four days later, he reached the third island.
After a round of searching, he had a small harvest. He had obtained a Six Star Celestial medicine, but similarly, it did not contain any Celestial Qi.
Sigh, this kind of Celestial medicine was really too rare. How could he expect to always be overwhelmingly lucky?
Ling Han continued onwards, traversing the seas. One island after another was searched by him, and time passed quietly.
Two months later, Ling Han discovered that a pillar of light that soared into the sky had appeared ahead of him.
Yi?

This pillar of light wasn’t on his path of advancement, but rather slightly off course. However, Ling Han didn’t have an accurate direction in the first place, and now that he saw this pillar of light, he immediately sensed something.
That should be the guiding light.
He adjusted his course and headed in the direction of the pillar of light.
After a whole seven days, he finally arrived in front of the pillar of light.
This was still an island, but it was not very big. There was no vegetation on the island, only multiple jagged rocks.

Ling Han wanted to reach the island, yet he discovered a repulsive force. At first, it was negligible, but as he advanced, it rapidly strengthened, like a spring. When it had been compressed to a certain extent, it began to bounce back.
With a bang, Ling Han was sent flying.
“Haha, Brother Ling has also arrived.” Origin’s voice was heard.
Ling Han looked to the side, and sure enough, Origin was standing in midair, nodding at him.
Previously, though they had had a great battle, they were all the masters of Genesis World, and had a sense of familiarity that was incomprehensible to ordinary people.
Ling Han also nodded at Origin, “Who else has arrived?”
“Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and He Luo,” Origin said. “They’ve come here more than once, so they’re obviously heading straight here.”
“What the hell is this pillar of light?” Ling Han pointed ahead, “Looks like the opportunities here are not small, so Yang Yihuan and the others rushed here directly.”
Origin nodded, “I have probed them a few times, and according to them, this may be related to the Great Emperor.”
Ling Han looked ahead. The pillar of light was still there. The light was clearly very gentle, but who would have thought that it would produce an incredibly powerful rebound?
“Aren’t we going to this island?” he asked.
“It’s difficult,” Origin said. “The further we go, the greater the obstruction. Thus, everyone is waiting. When the obstruction is slightly weaker, we’ll go to the island.”
Everyone’s strength was different, so whoever had outstanding abilities would be able to take the lead and be the first to reach the island, snatching that fated opportunity.
—Related to the Great Emperor? Then what was it?
Ling Han strode forwards, and began another attempt.

The force of the rebound began to strengthen, and Ling Han’s progress instantly slowed down. When he was about 1.5 km away from the island, Ling Han stopped, unable to advance the slightest bit further.

Three days later, the Alchemy Saint successfully concocted the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
Ling Han broke into a grin.
He had also successfully grasped the method to concoct this alchemical pill.
“Seven Star Venerate Tier-level!”
Ling Han murmured to himself.

Though he had indeed grasped a few Seven Star pill recipes, they did not improve his cultivation level, and in the case of this Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, it could refine the Celestial Qi in the Celestial medicine, and improve its grade.
This was astonishing, and its value could not be any greater.
“However, I’ve never heard of such alchemical pills.
They’ve either been lost, or they’re in the hands of a limited number of forces.
It’s impossible for them to be taught to outsiders.”
Just for the sake of this pill recipe, Ling Han felt like he had made a huge profit.
Celestial Qi was too rare, and there were pitifully few high-level Celestial Qi.
Being able to improve its grade through alchemy, how many people would go crazy for it?
Right at this moment, the illusion disappeared.
Ling Han was just about to leave, but he didn’t expect that Alchemy Saint to appear again.
He was still concocting alchemical pills, but in a different manner.
This time, it was directly a Saint Pill.
In the case of Saint Pills, every Saint could theoretically refine their own pills.
However, they would need to use their own blood essence as a medium, and that would consume too much of their own blood essence.
Furthermore, the types of Saint Pills that could be refined were extremely limited.
Thus, it was naturally still more convenient for an alchemist to do the concoction.
Furthermore, there were a wide variety of them, and they could be custom-made.
Ling Han didn’t care whether he could refine Saint Pills or not.
Even if he could, he didn’t have the ability to obtain the ingredients.
He only needed to memorize it now, and it would definitely be useful in the future.
Five days later, the Saint Pill was completed.
The illusion disappeared, and then came back again.
This time, it had become a Six Star Celestial pill.
Ling Han’s interest was piqued.
This was because he was only at the Sect Master level right now.
What he needed was precisely the Six Stars Celestial Pill.

He did not know the name of the alchemical pill that the Alchemy Saint had concocted, because it was not every time that the Alchemy Saint would speak to himself, but with his understanding of alchemy, he was sure that this alchemical pill was more or less the same as the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
It could elevate the level of Celestial Qi.
That was because the ingredients used to concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill were more or less the same, and the technique was exactly the same.
Then let’s call it Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
In terms of naming, Ling Han had always been incompetent.
Thus, it was naturally just so-so and casually named.
He was immersed in it, and continued to study it.
He memorized pill recipe after pill recipe, and his heart was filled with satisfaction.
He was indeed a prodigy-level martial artist, but in his bones, he was also an alchemist!
“It’s a shame that I ingested all of the Celestial medicines before.
Otherwise, if I refine them now and increase the quality of the Celestial Qi, perhaps I’ll already be a Three Star Sect Master!”
The quality of the Celestial Qi had too great an influence on the fruit of cultivation.
It not only determined the rate of growth of the fruit of cultivation, but also its quality.
Ling Han felt extreme regret.
Unfortunately, who would have thought that he would relive the experience of an Alchemy Saint here?
He soon let go of his thoughts of loss and gain, and continued to observe.
However, a month later, the images he saw were repeated.
Furthermore, when it was the second time, the images were clearly slightly blurred.
In other words, not everyone could obtain this kind of good fortune.
Ling Han smiled sheepishly.
Out of those that could come here, how many of them were alchemists?
He gritted his teeth.
Unknowingly, he had stayed here for another month.
He probably wouldn’t be able to keep his first place again.
Hurry up.
He walked out of the abode and continued to advance.
After leaving the area of the ancient battlefield, there was a great ocean ahead of him, but flying over it was completely no problem.
Another seven days later, he discovered an island, and searched around the island.
He actually found a Six Star Celestial medicine.
Unfortunately, it did not contain Celestial Qi.
This made Ling Han a little disappointed, but he still put away the Celestial medicine, and continued onwards.
Since he had gained something, it was very likely that he was still in the lead.
Of course, it was also possible that he had still fallen behind.
However, the people in front of him were completely focused on rushing, and had no thought of searching this island at all.
He hoped that this kind of gain would be more.
It would be best if he could get him a few Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi.
He wanted to try concocting the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
Another few days later, Ling Han discovered the second island.
However, this time, after searching once, he discovered that there were traces of excavation on the ground, and it was very new.
Obviously, there was indeed someone in front of him.
Previously, he had not made a move, but when he saw the second island, the other party could not hold himself back.
Ling Han activated his movement technique.
He didn’t advance in a straight line, but rather slightly changed his direction.
Another four days later, he reached the third island.
After a round of searching, he had a small harvest.
He had obtained a Six Star Celestial medicine, but similarly, it did not contain any Celestial Qi.
Sigh, this kind of Celestial medicine was really too rare.
How could he expect to always be overwhelmingly lucky?
Ling Han continued onwards, traversing the seas.
One island after another was searched by him, and time passed quietly.
Two months later, Ling Han discovered that a pillar of light that soared into the sky had appeared ahead of him.
Yi?
This pillar of light wasn’t on his path of advancement, but rather slightly off course.
However, Ling Han didn’t have an accurate direction in the first place, and now that he saw this pillar of light, he immediately sensed something.
That should be the guiding light.
He adjusted his course and headed in the direction of the pillar of light.
After a whole seven days, he finally arrived in front of the pillar of light.
This was still an island, but it was not very big.
There was no vegetation on the island, only multiple jagged rocks.
Ling Han wanted to reach the island, yet he discovered a repulsive force.
At first, it was negligible, but as he advanced, it rapidly strengthened, like a spring.
When it had been compressed to a certain extent, it began to bounce back.
With a bang, Ling Han was sent flying.
“Haha, Brother Ling has also arrived.” Origin’s voice was heard.
Ling Han looked to the side, and sure enough, Origin was standing in midair, nodding at him.
Previously, though they had had a great battle, they were all the masters of Genesis World, and had a sense of familiarity that was incomprehensible to ordinary people.
Ling Han also nodded at Origin, “Who else has arrived?”
“Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and He Luo,” Origin said.
“They’ve come here more than once, so they’re obviously heading straight here.”
“What the hell is this pillar of light?” Ling Han pointed ahead, “Looks like the opportunities here are not small, so Yang Yihuan and the others rushed here directly.”
Origin nodded, “I have probed them a few times, and according to them, this may be related to the Great Emperor.”
Ling Han looked ahead.
The pillar of light was still there.
The light was clearly very gentle, but who would have thought that it would produce an incredibly powerful rebound?
“Aren’t we going to this island?” he asked.
“It’s difficult,” Origin said.
“The further we go, the greater the obstruction.
Thus, everyone is waiting.
When the obstruction is slightly weaker, we’ll go to the island.”
Everyone’s strength was different, so whoever had outstanding abilities would be able to take the lead and be the first to reach the island, snatching that fated opportunity.
—Related to the Great Emperor?
Then what was it?
Ling Han strode forwards, and began another attempt.
The force of the rebound began to strengthen, and Ling Han’s progress instantly slowed down.
When he was about 1.5 km away from the island, Ling Han stopped, unable to advance the slightest bit further.

chapters.title: Chapter 4474: Imperial Origin
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Origin also walked over, and stood in a similar position to Ling Han.
“If I don’t use my secret technique, I can only walk here,” he said.
Ling Han nodded. He gave a loud shout, and shot out a punch. Just like there was an enemy in front of him, he was going to carve out a path of blood.
This was effective. He overcame all obstacles and continued to advance.
However, when he was about 500 meters away from the island, Ling Han was once again blocked.
The resistance was already so great that he could not advance any further.
Were they really unable to advance any further?
Ling Han channelled the Destructive Energy, raised his fist and waved it again. Instantly, he began to advance again.
Destructive Energy was indeed awesome, especially now that he had obtained as many as eight corners of the Spirit Diagram, and was only a step away from completion.
However, after advancing another 250m, he was unable to advance any further.
The resistance was so great that no matter how high the level of Destructive Energy was, nothing could be done.
It was just like how a sharp blade could easily slice a clay sword, but if this clay sword was as big as a small mountain, how would it be able to cut it?
Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!
Ling Han used his trump card again. The Pseudo-Imperial Weapon floated above his head, dispersing a portion of the obstructive power, allowing him to advance further.
Finally, he set foot on the island, but now that he had reached this step, he really could not advance the slightest bit further. The resistance on the island was extraordinarily strong.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, and a hint of surprise appeared on his face. That was because what he saw from here was different from what he saw from outside.
There were streaks of golden veined patterns here, as if they were some kind of trajectory. However, Ling Han merely swept an eye over them, and he was forced backwards by the resistance.
Peng, he was like a rock thrown from a catapult, smashing out at an incredibly fast speed.
In this manner, those golden veined patterns instantly disappeared.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. The resistance on this island was indeed incredibly strong, but it was still possible to get onto the island, and what did those golden veined patterns mean?
Some kind of cultivation technique?
It didn’t seem like it.
Ling Han quickly shook his head. Could it be a path?
Could one enter the island with this kind of path without being affected by the resistance?
Ling Han pulled himself together, and once again headed towards the island.
Everything went on as usual. He forged onwards with all his might, unleashing all his trump cards. He once again set foot on the island, and saw the golden veined patterns reappear.
He hurriedly memorized it, but it was only an instant, and he was once again sent flying.
Again, again.
Ling Han was in high spirits, and charged back.
Not long after, peng, he was sent flying again.
Origin watched him come and go, and couldn’t help but be speechless.
What do you think this is, a game? Is it really that fun?
Again and again, Ling Han was indomitable. Every time he was sent flying, he would see the golden veined patterns a little clearer. Though the progress was very slow, it was steadily progressing.

A few days later, Yang Yihuan and the others also ran over. Because this island was not very big, they could still catch a glimpse of Ling Han from where they were standing — it was mainly because he was sent flying too far every time, and there were practically no blind spots.
“What’s he doing?” Seeing how Ling Han was “playing” so happily, Yang Yihuan and the others were all very confused.
“Er!” Origin shrugged, expressing that he too was completely confused about the situation.
Xiu, Ling Han was sent flying again.
“Brother Ling, is this fun?” Yang Yihuan couldn’t help but ask with a smile.
Ling Han flew over from the distance, and nodded, “It’s fun.” After saying this, he headed back to the island.

Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and Feng Miaoling all shook their heads. They had already walked through the Imperial Path quite a few times, so they naturally knew that it was impossible to set foot on this island by force. They had to wait patiently until the resistance weakened and subsided by itself.
However, when Ling Han squeezed into the barrier of resistance this time, they all looked shocked.
That was because not only had Ling Han stepped onto the island, he had even taken a step forwards.
What!
Yang Yihuan and the others were all astounded. Even though it was only a small step, its significance was too great.
With this step, would there be a second step?
In front of their stunned eyes, Ling Han indeed took his second step. It was steady and stable.
Heavens!
“No way, this guy can really reach the island?” Origin inhaled sharply.
“I know that this guy is freakish, but he can’t be freakish like this, right?” Yang Yihuan gritted his teeth.
With such a comparison, would they still have any face left?

They didn’t know that there would be golden veined patterns on the island, and these veined patterns were the path to reach the island. If they followed this path, the resistance would decrease greatly.
However, the first step was to set foot on the island. Even as freakish as Yang Yihuan and Origin were, they couldn’t do this.
Just ask the people of the world, how many of them could possess Origin Gold?
“Not good, if that’s the case, then Imperial Origin...” He Luo immediately said.
Yang Yihuan and Feng Miaoling didn’t speak, but their expressions became very ugly.
“Imperial Origin? What Imperial Origin?” Origin asked from the side.
Yang Yihuan hesitated slightly, then said, “Alright, looks like that guy is going to get the Imperial Origin first, so there’s no need to keep it a secret anymore.”
He paused for a moment before continuing, “Imperial Origin is a part of the Great Emperor’s power after his death. Even heaven and earth can’t assimilate it.”

He Luo continued, “If we can refine the Imperial Origin, we would be able to glimpse the experiences of the Great Emperor when he achieved Dao. It would be of great help to us in our attempt to break through to become Emperor.”

Origin gave an ‘oh’. No wonder Yang Yihuan and the others had been standing guard here all this while. They had entered the Imperial Path more than once, so they naturally knew this place like the back of their hands. In fact, they had even obtained Imperial Origin before.
He did not take it to heart, because he had already walked his own path. He only had to walk this path to the end, and the position of Emperor would be right in front of his eyes.
“Imperial Origin can help you open up your own path of martial arts, and also allow you to take fewer wrong paths,” Feng Miaoling added.
Only now did Origin reveal an expression of shock. He could take fewer wrong paths; this help was really too great.
He set his eyes on Ling Han. This guy had already walked further than him on the path of martial arts, and now that he would be able to obtain Imperial Origin, he had further left him behind.
A sense of urgency rose up in his heart, and he even felt a sense of hesitation. This was something that he had never experienced in his long life.

Being able to ascend to the pinnacle in the Genesis World, he had naturally experienced countless trials and tribulations. In the end, he had successfully walked out and entered into a new world. Similarly, he had also risen proudly. Even the Golden Generation was no match for him at the same cultivation level.
However, now that he had met his match, it seemed like he was no match for Ling Han in any way.
He had to work twice as hard. Otherwise, it was really possible that the imperial throne would fall into Ling Han’s hands.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in an era!

Speaking of Ling Han, after countless attempts, he finally grasped the pattern of the golden veined patterns. Taking the first step was precisely where the resistance was the least. Though it was still very shocking, it was within the range that he could bear.
Lightning flashed in his mind, and golden veined patterns appeared in his mind. He resolutely took the second step, then the third, and the fourth.

In the eyes of ordinary people, this island of obstruction was completely invincible, but under Ling Han’s feet, though this could not be considered a smooth path, it was still not enough to become an obstacle.
What exactly was hidden here that Yang Yihuan and the others were so determined to obtain?

chapters.title: Chapter 4475: Secret of Regulations
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han advanced slowly, but every step was extremely steady.
Every step he took was extremely precise and was paid great attention to.
Only at these nodes would the resistance on the island decrease to the lowest, allowing him to advance. Otherwise, if he took a wrong step, he would be immediately sent flying.
Behind him, Yang Yihuan and the others also began to make attempts. How could prodigies like them submit to others? Since Ling Han could do it, they naturally thought that they could as well.
Unfortunately, they didn’t have any Origin Gold, and without such a powerful weapon, how could they compare to Ling Han?
Peng, peng, peng! They tried repeatedly, yet were sent flying time and time again.
Ling Han ignored them. His concentration was currently on high alert.

When he took the second step, the golden veined patterns that his eyes had seen disappeared, and he could only depend on his own memories. Thus, on one hand, he had to resist the still very frightening resistance, and on the other, he still had to rack his brains to remember. He definitely could not allow the mistake of a single step.
This was a twofold test. Whichever one it was, he would not be able to advance any further.
That was close. Whether it was in terms of abilities or comprehension ability, Ling Han was at the top of the world, and there was not the slightest bit of error.
He continued to advance. This island was very flat, and there were no mountains. In fact, there weren’t even any larger rocks. It was a flat stretch of land, and his vision was completely unaffected.

Slightly less than half a day later, Ling Han was already covered in sweat. Because of his high concentration, he even felt a little dizzy and vision blurring. However, he was finally close to the heart of the island.
Ahead of him, a rock protruded, and it should be the only rock on the island that would protrude so high.

On top of the rock, there were three crystalline pearls, and they were all milky white in colour. Upon a closer look, the aura of Primal Chaos was rolling within the pearls, but it did not seem to be solid, but rather gaseous.
Ling Han did not relax his spirit. He was cautious and conscientious, and continued onwards.
Another ten minutes later, he arrived in front of the rock. He stretched out his hand to grab the three pearls.
This should be what Yang Yihuan and the others wanted.

When his fingers touched these three pearls, he had not even grabbed them, when the three pearls actually shattered one after another, turning into three streaks of gas that fused into the palm of his hand.
‘Yi, what the hell was this?’
Ling Han only felt his mind tremble, and his thoughts began to rapidly evolve. The path of martial arts spread out beneath his feet, and he continuously simulated the direction of his advance.
This had the same effect as the Time Wine!
Hold on!
In Ling Han’s eyes, Regulations materialized, from one star to nine stars.

Theoretically speaking, he wouldn’t be able to touch the Seven Star Regulations unless he reached the peak stage of Sect Master, but now, it wasn’t just the Seven Star Regulations. Even the Eight Star Regulations and Nine Star Regulations appeared in front of him one after another, easily within reach.
Unlike in the Mountain Sea Heaven, where Regulations were only as simple as materializing. This was presenting even the secret of Regulations, allowing him to easily comprehend it.
Hiss, this was shocking.
What was the greatest difficulty of blocking a cultivator?
His comprehension of the Dao of Heaven and Earth, and what was the Dao of Heaven and Earth? Wasn’t it Regulations?
Now that the secret of Regulations had been analyzed, did the barrier of cultivation level still exist?

Having glimpsed this kind of secret of heaven and earth, to say nothing of the fact that it would be no problem for him to break through to Saint Tier all the way, it was even possible for him to become Emperor!
However, in just the time for a single breath, the boundless Regulations began to dim, and very soon, they would never be seen again.

Ling Han knew that this must be the effect of the three pearls, allowing him to temporarily see the secrets of Regulations, but this was too nature-defying, and could not possibly be maintained for long. It was only the time for a single breath.
Could he possibly memorize all the Regulations in such a short amount of time?
Impossible!
Every Regulation was incredibly complex. If one was greedy, there was only one possibility that he would not be able to remember even a single one.
Ling Han was very practical, and thus set his eyes on a Seven Star Regulation.
Remember, remember, remember. His eyes widened, wanting to memorize all the profound secrets of this Regulation.
However, it was really just the blink of an eye, and all the Regulations had disappeared.
Ling Han only managed to memorize a quarter of it.

“Though that is the case, I think that when I have thoroughly grasped this portion of Regulations, I should be able to mobilize it to a limited extent.” Ling Han looked excited. He was a Sect Master, and if he suddenly shot out a Seven Star Regulations, even if it was just a portion, just how terrifying would that be?
Seven Star Regulations naturally overwhelmed Six Star Regulations. This was Venerate Tier-level Regulations!
Why didn’t he choose the eight-star Regulations or even nine-star Regulations?
F***, he was a Sect Master. Even if he had memorized a portion of the Saint-level Regulations, or even the Imperial Regulations, would he have the ability to use them?
Thus, instead of being greedy and ruining things, it was better to be practical.
Ling Han was a very practical person. He would do as much as he could.
Furthermore, he was very confident in himself. As long as his cultivation level was high enough, would the secret of Regulations be able to stump him?
Thus, he only chose those that would be of greatest help to him now, and not those that might be of help to him in future.
He discovered that the resistance on the island was already ineffective against him.
After obtaining the three pearls, it was as if he had gained the approval of this island. Thus, he could come and go as he pleased.
Ling Han did not leave at the first instant. Though he could no longer see the Regulations of heaven and earth, the path of cultivation was still evolving.
After half a day, this effect finally disappeared, and the island no longer glowed. The obstructive force had completely disappeared.
Xiu, xiu, xiu. Yang Yihuan and the others all flew over.
“Brother Ling, congratulations!” they all clasped their hands and said. There was a smile on their faces, but it couldn’t hide their disappointment.
Ling Han nodded, then asked, “Do you guys know the origins of that bead-like object?”

“Imperial Origin,” Feng Miaoling said. When she looked at Ling Han, the despondence in her eyes had already disappeared, and what replaced it was admiration. This was awesome. They had stepped onto the Imperial Path again and again, and when had they not waited until the resistance was more or less decreased to be able to reach the island to retrieve the treasure?
But what about Ling Han? Compared to him, they were on two completely different levels.
This gaze terrified Ling Han. ‘You’re not going to be infatuated again, are you?’
Thankfully, Feng Miaoling quickly explained the origins and uses of Imperial Origin.

Ling Han was surprised. That was because from Feng Miaoling’s mouth, the use of Imperial Origin was only to help cultivators open up their own path of cultivation, or speed up the progress of their path of cultivation. They had not seen the effects of the secret of Regulations.
What was going on here?
“In the past, how many Imperial Origins did you guys usually obtain?” Ling Han asked.
“How could there be a few? Of course, there’s only one,” Yang Yihuan said with a smile.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Looks like this was the reason.

He had reached the island against the resistance, so the heaven and earth’s reward for him would be much more generous. There were as many as three Imperial Origins! And with the combined effects of three Imperial Origins, he could glimpse the secrets of Regulations.
Yi, could this be the true meaning of Imperial Origin?

After all, the path of martial arts was something that one had walked on their own. They could walk it out without any help. If they couldn’t, it would be useless no matter how much help and hints they were given.

Just look, how many times had Yang Yihuan and the others walked the Imperial Path, and how many times had they obtained Imperial Origin? Yet, they were still unable to open their own paths of cultivation.

Only at these nodes would the resistance on the island decrease to the lowest, allowing him to advance.

Behind him, Yang Yihuan and the others also began to make attempts.
How could prodigies like them submit to others?
Since Ling Han could do it, they naturally thought that they could as well.
Unfortunately, they didn’t have any Origin Gold, and without such a powerful weapon, how could they compare to Ling Han?
Peng, peng, peng!

This was a twofold test.

chapters.title: Chapter 4476: Stone turtle
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t say this.
Otherwise, who knew how jealous Yang Yihuan and the others would be.
“Let’s go. Since the Imperial Origin has already been taken, there is no meaning to continue staying on this island,” He Luo said.
“Is there still Imperial Origin ahead of us?” Ling Han asked.
Yang Yihuan and the others all smiled, but did not answer.
There must be, but they didn’t want Ling Han to get any more information, so they weren’t willing to leak out any more information.
After all, if Ling Han participated, that would truly be an unfair competition. No one would be able to do anything but stand by and watch.
Humans were naturally selfish, what more when this involved the only qualification to become Emperor.
The five of them split up, but the general direction was the same, and they continued onwards.
Ling Han analysed the secrets of Regulations he had seen as he sped forward.
Previously, it had only been an instant, and he had completely committed it to memory. Now, he was truly beginning to comprehend it.
He multitasked, and while maintaining his high speed of flight, his comprehension was also gradually entering an optimal state.
“This... No, that way!” he murmured continuously. Occasionally, he would frown, and at other times, he would smile, his expression extremely colourful.
He was only a Sect Master, yet he was comprehending a Seven Star Regulation. This was too difficult.

If he went to the Mountain Sea Heaven, even if the Seven Star Regulations manifested in front of him, he would only be able to stare blankly. Without reaching the peak stage of Sect Master, there was no way he could comprehend it.
No one said that if they went to the Mountain Sea Heaven, they would definitely be able to break through. It would only decrease the difficulty of breaking through slightly.

Previously, when the Mountain Sea Heaven opened, those people whose lifespans were close to drying up all left with the awareness that they would die of old age there. No one dared to say that when the next time the Mountain Sea Heaven opened, they themselves would be able to successfully break through.
However, Imperial Origin was different. It directly displayed the secret of Regulations, and this gave Ling Han the chance to grasp high-level Regulations in advance.
Though this was still very, very difficult.
“As expected of the power of a Great Emperor!”
“No, according to my deduction, this should be a tiny bit of martial intent from the Great Emperor.”

“They all say that the Great Emperor is too strong. After death, his soul would not enter into the Netherworld, and would be directly absorbed and assimilated by the heaven and earth. Hence, since this is a Mystery Realm that was naturally formed by the heaven and earth, and is called the Imperial Path, then wouldn’t it be very normal for it to leave behind a sliver of the martial intent of the Great Emperor?”
Thoughts streaked through Ling Han’s mind, but he immediately dismissed them, and concentrated on deducing the secrets of Regulations.
If he could use the Seven Star Regulation at the level of Sect Master, his awesomeness would definitely increase greatly.
A whole half month later, a large island appeared ahead of him.
Ling Han flew down, a sliver of a smile appearing at the corners of his lips.

He stretched out a hand and swiped in front of him. Immediately, a ray of light that was thinner than even a spider’s thread appeared in front of him. It was as black as ink, but exuded an incredibly terrifying aura.
This was the silk of Regulations, Seven Star Regulation!

He could finally use the Seven Star Regulation, but he could only mobilize a sliver of it. Furthermore, he was unable to move it with a single thought. The Regulation would appear, but he would need some time to accumulate it.
“Though that is the case, it still has great practical value.”

Ling Han nodded. After all, this was a Seven Star Regulation. Logically speaking, it should have been impossible for a Sect Master to use. Only when he had reached the peak stage of Sect Master, would he be able to glimpse a sliver of its profound secrets, and use it as a trigger for his breakthrough.
Now that he could use it in battle, how heaven-defying was that?
He first roamed around the island, but did not find any Celestial Herb, nor did he encounter any obstruction. Obviously, there was no way that there was any Imperial Origin hidden here.
“He Luo.”
His eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw that He Luo had also appeared on the island. However, the latter did not greet him. Instead, he went directly to the other side of the island.

This island was very narrow and long. When He Luo reached the other end, he actually stepped on a rock by the coast. A strange scene appeared. This rock actually moved, turning into a sea turtle that carried him out to sea.
Yi?
Ling Han was surprised. Could it be that the use of this island was only a crossing point?
He secretly rejoiced. Thankfully, He Luo had appeared in time. Otherwise, he would not have known what to do at all.
After all, he had walked the Imperial Path quite a number of times, so he naturally knew how he should proceed in the next stage.

The other party ignored him. Ling Han could understand this, because there was definitely still Imperial Origin ahead of him. He had to try his best to stop Ling Han here, so that he would have a chance of obtaining it.
Ling Han smiled. He also arrived at the other side of the island, and began his search.
The beach here was covered with rocks, and they were all shaped like turtles. There were also veined patterns on the back of the turtle, which was extremely complicated.
How should he choose?

Ling Han was at a loss, so he randomly jumped onto a rock. Instantly, this rock moved, and four limbs actually stretched out of the rock, turning into a sea turtle. Then, it slowly turned around and headed towards the ocean.
The stone turtle gradually sped up, not the slightest bit slow.
Ling Han was slightly confused. Why did he have to use the stone turtle as a vessel to cross the sea? Even if its speed wasn’t slow, it wasn’t as fast as a cultivator flying over directly.
However, he soon found out the reason.
Not long after entering the sea, flashes of sword light shot out from the sea from time to time.
Ling Han merely glanced at it, and already knew that he would not be able to block this sword light. Probably, it could even insta-kill Venerate Tiers.
However, though the stone turtle had no battle prowess, it could block the sword light, making the back of the turtle a safe place.
So that was the case.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. It was no wonder that he had to use the stone turtle to cross the sea.
Yi, hold on.
Ling Han shockingly discovered that after swimming for a while, this stone turtle actually turned around and returned.
Ahead of him, the island that he had previously left very quickly reappeared before his eyes.
‘Why have you come back?’
The stone turtle swam to the beach, then stopped. It retracted its limbs, and turned back into a giant rock.
Ling Han was slightly dumbfounded. Was this considered a day trip?
‘What on earth is going on?
He jumped onto another rock, and immediately, four limbs stretched out of the rock, turning once more into a sea turtle, which carried Ling Han out to sea.
This time, the turtle journeyed for three days, yet slowly brought Ling Han back again.
‘Holy f*ck!’

Ling Han did not jump blindly onto the third rock again. He believed that if he wanted to cross the sea, he would definitely have to ride on these stone turtles. However, if he were to try them one by one like this, it was possible that he would have to spend a few months, or even a few years, or even a few decades, before he would be lucky enough to encounter the right rock.
There must be a trick to it.
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and his gaze landed on the veined patterns on the stone.
Could it be related to this?
Ling Han found the first and second stone, and carefully compared the veined patterns on them.
After a while, he broke into a smile.
The veined patterns on every stone were a labyrinth, and the correct route to walk out of the labyrinth was exactly the same as the route that the stone turtle had taken him on.
He could be considered to have solved half of the dilemma, and the remaining half was how was he supposed to find the correct route?
“Simple. The wrong path would ultimately lead one back.”
“Thus, the correct route would definitely not end on this island.”
With this in mind, Ling Han started to search again.
Multiple rocks were eliminated by him, and his progress was very fast.
‘Hmm?’
Another person had come.
Guan Xinghan.

chapters.title: Chapter 4477: Seven Star Regulation!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A smile involuntarily appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips.
He just happened to have found the right rock, and was in a good mood. Furthermore, Guan Xinghan had coincidentally delivered himself to his doorstep at this moment, which made him overjoyed.
“Ling Han!” Though the island was very big, with his eyesight, Guan Xinghan naturally discovered Ling Han at the first instant.
Wariness flickered in his eyes. After all, even the combined forces of the many Golden Generations hadn’t been able to apprehend Ling Han. This lowly commoner was overwhelmingly powerful.
“Thank you,” Ling Han said seriously.
Yi, what was going on?
Guan Xinghan frowned. This ‘thank you’ was too dumbfounding for him. He didn’t seem to have done anything that could make the other party feel grateful.
He knew that Ling Han was not the type to be predictable, but this was really too baffling to him.
“What for?” he couldn’t help but ask.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Thank you for coming so far to seek death. It’s said that gifts are light, but friendship is heavy. Thus, I’ll accept your life.”
‘Holy f*ck!’

Guan Xinghan finally realized that Ling Han was teasing him. He couldn’t help but fly into a thunderous rage, and his expression was as dark as could be. He balefully said, “What you can rely on is merely movement techniques. In a head-on clash, I can destroy you at any moment.”
“Come on then!” Ling Han crooked a finger, “If you don’t come, then you’re a b@stard.”

Guan Xinghan couldn’t hold back any longer, and charged towards Ling Han. His hands slashed out, like they were heavy axes. Regulations wrapped around his palms, and there were a total of sixteen of them.
Yi, he had broken through, and advanced into nine stars.
This was normal. There were too many opportunities here. In the first place, he was an eight-star Sect Master, so it wouldn’t be strange for him to take another step forward.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and greeted the incoming attack fearlessly. As he threw a punch, fifteen Regulations bloomed at the same time.
Peng!

In the exchange of a single blow, Guan Xinghan’s figure swayed, and he took a few steps back. Ling Han, on the other hand, had only retreated slightly more than him, and there was no overwhelming difference in battle prowess.
This!
He was a nine-star Sect Master, and judging by the aura that Ling Han was exuding, he was only a Two-Star Sect Master.
Thus, there was still a gap of seven minor levels between him and Ling Han. However, he surprisingly didn’t have a crushing advantage. At most, he only had a slight advantage.
No, Ling Han hadn’t been injured at all in this exchange. In fact, he hadn’t suffered any setbacks at all. He had immediately charged back, and this could only be considered a tie.
Heavens, with an advantage of seven stars, a dignified Golden Generation was actually only able to fight someone equally?
He really wanted to die.
“Hehe, what Golden Generation?” Ling Han said in disdain. “If you hadn’t cultivated for a few more years, I would have been able to smack you to death with a single hand.”
These words were far too sarcastic, yet Guan Xinghan was still unable to refute them.
If Ling Han was also a Nine Star Sect Master... he knew himself well. He was definitely no match for a single move.
“Damn it!” he cursed softly, and took the initiative to slow down the rhythm of the battle.

He knew that this kind of rapid barrage would not be able to kill Ling Han. In fact, it would not be able to penetrate Ling Han’s defenses. Thus, he needed some time to accumulate Regulations. By then, eighteen or even twenty Regulations would be unleashed at the same time. He did not believe that he would not be able to kill Ling Han.

However, reality once again slapped him across the face.

A sixteenth Regulation!

No!
His eyes suddenly widened. F***, this was Seven Star Regulation!
In this instant, Guan Xinghan felt his head go numb, and a coldness enshroud his entire body.
‘What kind of f*cking monster are you? A Two Star Sect Master can actually use Seven Star Regulations?
How were the other Sect Masters going to live if he was like this?

A Venerate Tier elite could crush a Sect Master. This was the truth. Thus, even if Ling Han had only grasped a sliver of a Seven Star Regulation, he could use it unexpectedly, and it would have extraordinary effects.
How could he play around with him like that?
Heavenly Dao, you are really too unfair, aren’t you?
A Sect Master has used a Seven Star Regulation, which had completely destroyed the truth of cultivation!

In an instant, countless thoughts flashed through his mind, but he could do nothing. He could only watch helplessly as this punch approached. Boom, black-colored energy pulsated, making him feel a coldness that came from facing death directly.
Previously, though he was stunned, he was still calm, because he had the Substitution Seal.
But now, this kind of chill seeped directly into his bones, causing his pupils to involuntarily constrict.
