chapters.title: Chapter 4478: Black Gauze Palace
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Peng!
With a single punch, Guan Xinghan’s mind was shattered. What use could Substitution Seal have against Destructive Energy?
Another Golden Generation died.
Ling Han retracted his fist, neither angry nor happy.
Right now, his target wasn’t a Sect Master like Guan Xinghan anymore. Instead, his target was the remaining two Venerate Tier elites, Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian.

“If I fight them now, I am still far from being their match, and can only use the Energy Jade to trick them,” Ling Han mumbled to himself. He was only a Two-Star Sect Master, after all. Even if he had formed a sliver of Seven Star Regulation, if he fought with the Golden Generation that had already grasped Seven Star Regulations, that would only be courting death.
“However, among Sect Masters, I should already have no one that is my match.”
Just ask, what Sect Master could withstand the barrage of Seven Star Regulations? Even if it was just a sliver.

Ling Han searched Guan Xinghan’s corpse, but he didn’t find anything valuable. If there were any Celestial medicines, they would definitely have been refined. Otherwise, how could Guan Xinghan have possibly advanced into nine stars?
He returned to the beach, found the rock that he had already confirmed, and stepped on it. Instantly, the rock stretched out its limbs, turning into a sea turtle, and swam towards the deep sea.
This time, there was no return for the stone turtle.
A whole half month later, a coastline appeared ahead of him.
He had finally crossed the great ocean.
Seeing that there were no more light swords shooting out from the sea, Ling Han leaped, and flew towards land.
This was a vast plain that stretched as far as the eye could see.
Which direction should he take?
Ling Han only swept an eye over it, and a smile appeared on his face.
In the distance, there was presently a pillar of light soaring into the skies.
He activated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, speeding toward that direction.
Half an hour later, Ling Han arrived at the place where the pillar of light had shot out.
Yi, it was another palace.
“Black Gauze Palace.” Ling Han swept an eye over it. There was a plaque hanging on the doors of the palace, and the words were written on it.
“Sigh, Brother Ling, I really don’t want to see you!” Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and Feng Miaoling walked over.
They had set foot on the Imperial Path many times, and would not be delayed on their journey. They knew where they should go, and their goal was also very clear.
But though they had come early, they were unable to enter into the palace hall, because just like before, the resistance here was extraordinarily strong.
Ling Han smiled, “Apologies, I’ll take my leave first.”
He strode forward.

Multiple layers of resistance assaulted him, and as he went deeper and deeper, they rapidly strengthened, causing his steps to slow down very quickly. Ling Han gave a loud shout, and unleashed his battle prowess fully, blasting forwards.

This time, not only did he use the Destructive Energy, he also used that sliver of Seven Star Regulations. However, it was sandwiched between the Regulations, and if one didn’t carefully observe it from a close distance, it would be impossible to discover it.
Thus, Ling Han wasn’t afraid of Yang Yihuan and the others discovering that he had another trump card.
With this forceful push, he charged all the way until he was only ten steps away from the entrance of the palace before stopping.
He really could not advance any further.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and his figure moved again. He walked the last ten steps and stood at the entrance of the palace.
What surprised him was that there was no golden route map here, and the pressure had also disappeared.
Ling Han paused, and stretched out both hands to push open the doors.
With a creak, the doors of the palace opened. Ling Han did not hesitate, and immediately walked in.
Seeing Ling Han disappear into the palace, Yang Yihuan and the others all frowned.
“We can’t go on like this!”
“M-hm, otherwise, we would be unable to obtain another portion of Imperial Origin.”
“We can only break through to Venerate Tier.”

The three of them nodded. Sect Master-level strength was already no longer capable of stopping Ling Han. Thus, they had to return to Venerate Tier-level. Only then would they be able to forcefully detain Ling Han, and wait for the resistance to disappear on its own. In that way, how could Ling Han possibly win over them?

Every time they re-cultivated, it was a rare experience. However, only people with their backgrounds could allow them to repeatedly sever their cultivation level and regain it. If it was another person, their foundations would have long since been damaged. To say nothing of becoming stronger, it would be difficult for them to even return to the peak stage.
The three of them bounced back, each wanting to find a place to quickly break through to Venerate Tier.
For them, this was not a very difficult task.
Ling Han walked into the palace hall. The inside wasn’t as dark as it looked from the outside. Multiple pieces of jade were glowing, like bright lamps.
In the depths of the great hall, there was presently a person seated, his back facing him.
“Hehe, in these millions and millions of years, you are the ninth person to be able to walk in and see me,” this person said. His voice rang out directly in Ling Han’s mind.
Only nine?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. Presumably, when the resistance disappeared on its own, it should be impossible to see this person.
“Who were the eight people before?” Ling Han couldn’t help but feel curious.
“I don’t remember.” This person shook his head. Then, he stood up, turned around, and faced Ling Han.
This was a middle-aged man. He was dressed in a long white robe, and had an otherworldly bearing.

Ling Han pondered for a moment. These eight people were most likely the Great Emperors that had come later. Moreover, they were the extremely fortunate ones. Before becoming Emperor, they had already obtained Origin Gold, or a treasure that could rival it. Otherwise, this place truly wasn’t a place that one could enter with their abilities and natural talent.
Luck has always been a part of strength. Being able to become an elite, at least, there were a great many times when one’s luck was not too bad.
“If you can withstand a hundred moves from me, the Imperial Origin here will belong to you,” the middle-aged man said calmly.
Ling Han hurriedly said, “If I could take 200 moves, or even more, would senior give me some more Imperial Origin?”

The middle-aged man faltered for a moment. He had never seen such a greedy competitor before. You haven’t even exchanged a hundred moves, and you’re already thinking about what to do after two hundred moves?
“Hehe, even if you can defeat me, you won’t be able to obtain much Imperial Origin either,” he said calmly.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed, and said, “Please provide guidance, senior.”
What kind of expression was that? Could it be that he really thought that he could win?
The middle-aged man shook his head, speechless.
He strode forwards, walking towards Ling Han.
Peng, he stepped down, and the Regulations responded, turning into sharp swords that appeared behind him.
One, two, five, ten, twenty!
He was slowly accumulating Regulations, because even twenty Regulations was not his limit.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be careless. He also began to accumulate Regulations, and he also wanted to know where his limits were.
“Go!” The middle-aged man pointed at Ling Han, and instantly, the swords of Regulations behind him appeared at the same time. There were a total of 23 of them.
This was extremely shocking. Even if it had not been formed in an instant, it was still boundlessly powerful.

Ling Han had also accumulated 20 Regulations, and could not take another step further. That would surpass his limits. Either Regulations would disperse, or he himself would explode from the Regulations.
He roared loudly, and charged forwards with these 20 streaks of Regulations.
The middle-aged man shook his head. Ling Han’s confidence was a mystery. He was clearly three Regulations short, yet he still dared to face the attack head-on.
It should be known that in a battle on Sect Master-level, one could not afford the difference of even a single Regulation.
However, reality caused him to gape in shock.

The 25 God Tools instantly crumbled. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s punch continued to fly over.
How, how was this possible!
The middle-aged man also wore an expression of disbelief, just like Guan Xinghan.
‘F*ck! My 25 flashes of Regulations are actually no match for your 20 flashes. Is there any law in this world? Is there any justice in this world?’
That’s not right. I am manifested from Heavenly Dao, so don’t I represent the justice of heaven and earth?
Boom! Ling Han unleashed a powerful punch.

Since the middle-aged man said that he wanted Ling Han to block 100 of his strikes, he naturally couldn’t dodge at this moment. Thus, he threw a punch in response. Because he didn’t have time to accumulate power, this punch was only entwined with 20 Regulations.

The two fists collided, and power instantly surged out. Regulations crashed into each other.
The middle-aged man shockingly discovered that Ling Han’s punch had actually broken through his Regulations!

Even if his power was actually stronger than Ling Han’s, and the latter was already beginning to be sent flying backwards from the impact, the Regulations that Ling Han unleashed had turned into a divine blade that was still blasting towards him.
At this moment, he finally discovered the reason.
‘Holy f*ck! Seven Star Regulation!’
No wonder he was no match for the other even though he had the advantage in number of Regulations. As it turned out, this brat could actually channel Seven Star Regulations.
Peng!
A shield immediately materialized in front of him, blocking Ling Han’s divine blade of Regulations.
In this exchange, there was no clear victor.
However, the middle-aged man didn’t attack again. Instead, he sighed and said, “You passed.”
Previously, though he had blocked Ling Han’s attack, he had also used the Seven Star Regulation.

—Ling Han could use the Seven Star Regulation. That was because Ling Han was awesome, capable of doing so at Sect Master-level. He was heaven-defyingly powerful, but it was different in his case. He was a guard, and would definitely follow the rules.
If he used the Seven Star Regulation, that could only be used against Venerate Tier.
Ling Han wasn’t a Venerate Tier elite, yet he had used the Seven Star Regulations. Was there still any need to fight?

The middle-aged man was extremely depressed. It wasn’t easy for him to meet someone. Although he could only play for a hundred moves, it could still relieve his boredom. But now? He had only used one move, and the battle was over.
“If you can become Emperor, who knows, you may be the Number One Emperor of All Eternity,” he said. Then, his figure suddenly disappeared, and there were three Imperial Origins on the ground.
The Number One Emperor of All Eternity?
Ling Han smiled knowingly. He was very fond of this title.
En, when he became Emperor, he would become the Number One Emperor of All Eternity.
He walked over, and with a touch of his hand, three Imperial Origins immediately turned into gas, surging into his body.
Instantly, his mind channelled, and began to predict the path of cultivation on his own, and the secret of Regulations appeared once more in front of him.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. He chose the Seven Star Regulation that he had been cultivating before, and then committed it to memory with all his might.
Previously, he had memorized about a quarter of it, and now, he would try to remember it completely.
In just a single breath, the secret of Regulations disappeared.
More or less, he had just memorized a quarter of it, and added together with what he had previously memorized, he had memorized half of it.
Ling Han began to fully deduce the path of cultivation, and gained endless enlightenment.
Half a day later, this effect also disappeared, which meant that the effects of the Imperial Origin had been completely exhausted.
He stood up and walked out of the palace.
Yi, this time, he didn’t see Yang Yihuan and the other two.
Forget it, let’s continue forward.
Ling Han activated his movement technique and rapidly advanced.
The boundless distance was left behind him, and he was also comprehending the Seven Star Regulation, striving for further improvement.
After about ten days, he broke into a smile, and waved his hand. The Seven Star Regulation appeared once more, but this time, it had reached the width of two hairs.
“More importantly, the speed at which I channel the Seven Star Regulation has also doubled.”
This was the best part.

In a battle at Sect Master-level, there was actually not much difference between one or two shreds of Seven Star Regulations. In any case, they could crush the Six Star Regulations, but if the speed of channelling the Seven Star Regulation was doubled, that would be of great significance.
“If I can fully grasp this Seven Star Regulation, then when I use it, the speed should be the same as the Six Star Regulations.”
In that case, he would really be able to do as he liked among Sect Masters. No one would be able to withstand a single blow from him.
After walking for another two days, a very large mound appeared ahead of him. From afar, it exuded a powerful pressure.

This mound was filled with holes, densely packed, and what was harrowing was the fact that there would be large black ants crawling in and out of the holes from time to time. Every single one of them was the size of a dog.
So, this mound was actually an ant’s nest?
Ling Han hesitated. Should he barge in?
There was no useless place in the Imperial Path. Thus, since there was an ant’s nest here, it either hindered his advance, or contained great fortune.
In that case, Ling Han would have to venture in no matter what.
He strode forwards, heading towards the ant nest.
When he had come close enough, a great many ants immediately stopped, and looked towards him. Their antennas moved rhythmically, as if they were communicating.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Come!”

Instantly, over a hundred giant ants rushed towards him. Hong, hong, hong, hong! They were obviously only the size of dogs, but their bodies were extraordinarily heavy, causing the whole hill to tremble greatly.

Even though these ants were all ferocious beasts, and had not developed intelligence, they were communicating endlessly with each other through the movement of their antennas. They were actually incredibly coordinated. It was as if over a hundred ants were one, and their coordination was incredibly smooth.
Ling Han laughed loudly as he unleashed his murderous aura. Weng! Like a divine blade, his Spiritual Power instantly pierced into the minds of the ants and started to wreak havoc.
Pa, pa, pa! In just an instant, at least 70% of the ants had their stomachs turn over, and died facing the sky.
However, the remaining 20 or so ants were extremely ferocious as they continued to charge at Ling Han.
They were all Eight Stars and Nine Stars Sect Masters, and that was why they could resist the barrage of murderous aura without dying. In fact, they could even continue to launch offensives.
“Come battle!” Ling Han brandished his fists, and charged into the swarm of ants.

With how strong he was now, there was absolutely no need for him to channel the Seven Star Regulations. An ordinary Nine Star Sect Master was no match for him at all. As he shot out punch after punch, the giant ants were all blasted into smithereens.
In just a few minutes, the remaining 20 or so ants were all killed.
However, this pierced a hornet’s nest, and even more ants rushed out of the ant’s nest, charging towards Ling Han.
This wouldn’t be in the hundreds, but in the thousands, or even tens of thousands.

Ling Han was still unafraid. As the barrage of murderous aura blasted out, those below the level of Five Star Sect Master were not even qualified to approach him. They could only be insta-killed on the spot.

However, the swarm of ants were fearless of death, and there were extraordinarily many of them. After battling for a day and a night, Ling Han did not take another step forwards at all. Instead, it was his divine sense that had been expended too much, and was gradually showing signs of exhaustion.
F***, you guys are awesome.
Ling Han turned around, and decided to temporarily avoid this attack. He would first recover, and when he had reached his prime condition, he would come back for another battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 4480: Stealing while you’re at it
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After the swarm of ants chased for a while, they gave up and turned back.
It couldn’t be helped. With Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, how fast was Ling Han’s speed?
“Since the swarm of ants is so troublesome, there should be treasures in the nest,” Ling Han murmured. “If I had known, I should have used the Strange Shadow Steps to sneak in.”
He found a secluded place to recover.

It was mainly because he had expended a little too much Spiritual Power. He didn’t have to worry about mystical power. With the millions and millions of dimensions in his body as his source, it wouldn’t be a problem for him to battle continuously for a year and a half.
Three days later, he had already recovered to his prime condition.
Fine, he would go to the ant nest again, but this time, he was going to sneak in quietly.

He arrived near the ant’s nest, then switched to channeling the Strange Shadow Steps. Combined with some Regulations, he instantly fled into the shadows. Even if he was walking behind a Sect Master, the latter may not be able to sense his presence.
Yi?
Ling Han was startled. Previously, when he had come here, he could see ants entering and exiting the caves, but now, he did not see even a single one.

“Though I had a great battle here three days ago, I don’t remember that I blasted such a large hole in this place.” Ling Han looked towards a corner of the ant nest, where a large piece had been blasted off.
“Unless... there’s someone before me!”

This wasn’t strange. There were still many people who could reach this level, and in the case of Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian, they were Venerate Tier elites, and could practically do as they liked in this place.
“I think that there must be Venerate Tier-level existences in the ant nest. They would not allow Imperial Son Ming and the others to succeed so easily.”
He pressed his hand on the ant’s nest, and sensed quietly.
After a while, he broke into a smile.
He could sense the tremors. It should be that there was a battle going on in the depths of the ant nest, and that was why there was such a tremor.
“Since they’re still fighting, no matter what treasures there are in the ant nest, they definitely haven’t been taken yet.”
“I have to hurry.”
Ling Han moved, entering into the ant nest. Then, he advanced rapidly.

The Strange Shadow Steps focused on concealing his tracks, but this did not mean that his progress would slow down. Though it could not compare to Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, it was slightly faster than ordinary Saint-level movement techniques.
This ant nest was very big, really very big. Ling Han had already walked for almost half an hour, yet he still did not see the battle that was taking place ahead of him.

Though the ants were big, they were only the size of ordinary dogs, and were far from reaching the height of humans when they were standing on their hind legs. Thus, the passage here had been forcefully enlarged, and there were corpses of giant ants everywhere.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and he nodded internally. Judging by the injuries on the ants, there were at least thirty people who had barged into the ant’s nest.
It should be the Golden Generation.

These people were all descendants of the Imperial Clans, so it was very easy for them to join forces. Because they all cared about their pride, as well as the honour of the Imperial Clans, it was very unlikely that someone would suddenly change their mind.
Ling Han continued to advance. After walking for another ten minutes, the shockwaves from the battle became incredibly obvious.
He was almost there.
He slowed down a little to avoid being discovered by the ripples caused by his movement.
After a few steps, the path ahead suddenly opened up, revealing a massive underground cave. It was spherical in shape, and had a radius of at least more than 5km.
In the centre of this underground cave lay a colossal white-coloured giant insect. It was surrounded and protected by innumerable black-coloured giant ants, preventing anyone from approaching.
There were about 30 people battling with the ants.
As expected, they were all Imperial Sons, and most of them were Golden Generations. From the Silver Generation, there were only those few that had advanced into Sect Master-level.
The leaders were Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian. The two Venerable Tier elites were the main force, while the other Sect Masters were responsible for impeding the enemy forces.

The swarm of ants was also very powerful. There were as many as seven Venerate Tier-level male ants, and they were the size of calves, possessing boundless strength. In terms of power, they actually suppressed Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian.

However, the strength of martial artists was in the fact that they possessed martial arts techniques and divine sense, which allowed them to use Regulations. Moreover, starting from the True Self Tier, divine sense became more and more important, gradually occupying a major position in battle prowess.

Thus, even though it was clearly a two-on-seven battle, and even though they didn’t have an advantage in terms of power, Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian still managed to hold back the seven Venerate Tier-level male ants.

On the other side, the other Imperial Sons were on a killing spree, endlessly killing the swarm of ants. Though there were still large numbers of giant ants charging out from various passageways, the line of defense was continuously retreating.
This drove the swarm of ants crazy. Their queen was behind this line of defense, and that was the foundation of their entire race. They definitely could not lose her.
Hence, though there were heavy casualties, the retaliation of the swarm of ants was even more intense.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them. What kind of treasure was there here?
It can’t be this queen ant, right?
En, what was that?

Ling Han glanced over. There was a black-colored blade of grass by the side of the queen ant. It was only as long as a finger, and at its tip, there were multiple grass seeds that were only the size of sesame seeds.
What was that thing?
Ling Han had never seen any illustrated handbook of Celestial medicines before. However, he could vaguely sense a Celestial Qi fluctuation.
These grass seeds actually contained Celestial Qi?

Ling Han was startled. This was really beyond his expectations, because this thing looked too terrible. No matter what, it could not be connected to Celestial medicine, what more being able to nurture Celestial Qi.
However, since he had seen it, what reason was there for him to miss it?
Ling Han moved quietly, snuck through the battle, passed through the line of ants, and approached the queen ant.

During this time, he was almost forced to reveal himself by the shockwaves of the battle. Fortunately, his grasp of the Strange Shadow Steps was probably comparable to the Killing Saint of the Battle God Palace, allowing him to stabilize his movements.
He had already arrived in front of the queen ant. In this place, those black-coloured blades of grass could be plucked.
However, if he made a move to pluck it, he would definitely reveal himself.

Ling Han smiled. He would pluck all the black grass in an instant, and by then, so what if he was discovered? Phoenix Wings Divine Flight would be activated, and he would immediately flee into the distance.
Right at this moment, the queen ant suddenly moved and turned to look in his direction.
What a sensitive guy.

Only now did Ling Han realize that the queen ant was at the Venerate Tier. Because they were too close, even if he was extremely proficient in grasping the Strange Shadow Steps, the queen ant still sensed it.
Instantly, a dozen over large ants rushed towards Ling Han. Though they had not discovered Ling Han, each of them would dutifully carry out the command of the queen ant.
There was no time to waste.
Ling Han hurriedly moved, and with a grab, those black blades of grass all fell into his hands.
Naturally, he also revealed himself.
Yi!
Imperial Son Ming and the other Golden Generations faltered upon this. Why had one of them snuck into the center of the swarm of ants and successfully plucked the Celestial medicine?
Good one!
They were all delighted. There was really not the slightest benefit to be gained from tangling with the swarm of ants. Now that they had gathered the Celestial medicine, they naturally could retreat.
However, they soon revealed furious expressions, all of them almost dying from fury.
This was not one of them at all, but rather Ling Han!
“Ling Han!”
“How dare you!”
“Put down the Celestial medicine!”
These Golden Generations all shouted loudly, wanting nothing more than to tear Ling Han into pieces.
— New chapter is coming soon —

chapters.title: Chapter 4481: Fury
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The members of the Golden Generation had every reason to be enraged.

They fought to the death, fighting hard for more than two days. How many giant ants had they killed on their way? All of them were drenched in blood and covered with wounds. Just when it looked like they were about to reap the fruits of their labour, Ling Han suddenly charged out, easily taking away what they yearned for.
How could they tolerate this?
“Ling Han, do you really want to die?”
“How detestable!”
“Ah!”
It was as if they had all gone mad, as they charged towards Ling Han.

However, vicious beasts didn’t have much intelligence. In the eyes of the giant ants, Ling Han was clearly in cahoots with these invaders. Seeing the Imperial Sons charge at the front lines, they all resisted with all their might, fearing that they would harm the queen ant.
How could this kind of front line be so easily broken through?

All the Imperial Sons were instantly blocked. Previously, they had not been able to break through the line of defense, and could only advance bit by bit. Now, no matter how furious they were, the battle prowess they could unleash was not enough to destroy the line of defense.
They were mad with fury. It was clearly Ling Han who had snatched what belonged to you, so why are you stupid ants still stopping them?

In truth, Ling Han had also been attacked by the giant ants. After all, he was the closest to the queen ant, so it was absolutely normal for him to be attacked madly by the giant ants. Thus, he immediately retreated, drawing out the distance between himself and the queen ant.
As expected, though there was still a large number of giant ants attacking him, the strength of their attacks had decreased considerably.
After all, he was only one person, so the threat he posed couldn’t be compared to the Golden Generation elites. They had the advantage in numbers, and there were also Venerate Tier elites among them.

Ling Han was very relaxed. On one side, he was only parrying, and did not deliver a fatal strike. He maintained a balance with the giant ants, then looked towards the Imperial Sons, “Everyone, thank you.”
These words were really vexing. The Imperial Sons were already incredibly furious in the first place, and when they heard these words, they naturally wanted even more to tear Ling Han into mush.
“Ling Han, you have offended so many members of the Imperial Clans. Once you leave, you would be hunted down by all the members of the Imperial Clans!”
“This time, it’s useless no matter what background you have!”
“You are already a dead man!”
The Imperial Sons all declared coldly. Ling Han was too freakish, suppressing them to the point that they could barely breathe. How could they possibly contend for the throne with such a person?
Thus, this kind of opponent could only be erased.
After all, Buddha Doga had never said that Ling Han couldn’t be targeted, after all. This gave them an opening.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Come!”
How had he come all the way here?
He had been hunted down and attacked, but when had he ever been overwhelmed?

The more this was the case, the more his fighting spirit soared. By now, he was already a Sect Master, and could be called a great elite. In the whole world, those whose strength were superior to him, how many Venerate Tiers and Saints were there in total?
Let the storm come even fiercer!
The Imperial Sons also calmed down, knowing that a verbal battle could not possibly defeat Ling Han. They merely stared menacingly at Ling Han, killing intent in their eyes.
“Let’s go!”
They stopped fighting. Without the Celestial medicine, what meaning was there left?
The Imperial Sons quickly retreated. They had another idea, and that was to intercept Ling Han and kill him outside the ant nest.
Once they retreated, though a large number of ants pursued them, a Venerate Tier-level giant ant charged towards Ling Han.
He couldn’t win against this.

Ling Han hurriedly broke into a run. At this moment, he exploded with a powerful battle prowess. As he shot out a punch, Regulations and power boiled at the same time, instantly clearing out the area of nearly three hundred meters in front of him.
With a battle cry, he advanced rapidly.
Behind him, the Venerate Tier-level giant ant pursued him relentlessly.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The giant ant waved its antennas, and endless black light shot out. This was filled with corrosion, and when it hit the walls of the passageway, it forcibly corroded a large hole.
And this was still because everything in the Imperial Path was very special. Otherwise, how could the attack of a Venerate Tier possibly cause such little damage?
This giant ant seemed to have gone mad. As the black light continued to shoot out, even the giant ants that had rushed over to provide reinforcements and stop him were implicated.
Thinking about it, it made sense. Having been invaded, and even the queen ant had almost been destroyed, how could these male ants not go crazy?
Ling Han didn’t even turn his head. Weng! A murderous aura burst forth.

Instantly, a field of giant ants in the surroundings collapsed, and even that Venerate Tier-level giant ant was affected for a moment, which made it even more furious, spewing out black light at a higher frequency.

Ling Han didn’t dare to be careless either. The ant path was too narrow, and he needed to shrink his body, which greatly affected the use of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. It was impossible for him to escape the pursuit of a Venerate Tier elite.
He unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which hovered above his head. This was forged from Origin Gold, and it could be big or small. Everything could be done as he willed.
In this way, he didn’t care anymore. No matter how the black light shot over, there would naturally be a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon blocking it.
As he fled, an exit finally appeared ahead of him.

With a battle cry, Ling Han’s figure sped up, and suddenly shot out. At this time, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his figure sped up again. Xiu, he quickly drew out the distance between himself and the giant ant.
That Venerate Tier-level giant ant chased a few more steps, yet could only watch helplessly as Ling Han fled into the distance, and finally disappeared.
After Ling Han tossed the giant ant aside, he immediately stopped using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
This movement technique was indeed awesome, but it was too eye-catching. From afar, one could see the raging flames.
Thus, he immediately switched to channeling the Strange Shadow Steps.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! In just an instant, two figures stepped into the sky and arrived.
Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian, two Venerate Tier-level Golden Generation elites.
As expected!
Ling Han smirked coldly. There was nothing wrong with his caution. Those Imperial Sons were presently searching madly for him.
However, even if Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian were Venerate Tiers, under the circumstances that they were not too close, they were still unable to find Ling Han from the shadows.
—Unless Ling Han was especially unlucky, and these two Imperial Sons had just happened to land right next to him, Ling Han would have no choice but to accept it.

Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian exchanged a glance. They had both noticed the commotion caused by Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and had thus rushed over. In the end, they had still been a step too slow.
“This boy must be nearby.”
“Find him!”
The two Golden Generations said darkly, each searching a different direction.
F***, you guys are still getting excited?
Ling Han drew out two Energy Jades, one in each hand, and aimed them respectively at Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian.
‘Throw!’
Xiu, xiu, the two Energy Jades were thrown out at an extraordinarily fast speed.
“Hmm?”
This kind of commotion naturally could not be hidden from the two Imperial Sons. They had both discovered the sneak attack at the first instant, and had naturally seen Ling Han as well.
Imperial Son Ming was just about to parry, but Imperial Son Tian sent a message through divine sense, “Dodge!”

Imperial Son Ming pondered for a moment. Ling Han was a scheming person, and he had clearly not been discovered yet. However, he had actively charged over to attack them, so how could this be an ordinary attack?
With this thought, his heart immediately shivered, and he hurriedly dodged.
The two jade stones didn’t hit anyone, but instead crashed into rocks and tree roots. These things were extremely unstable, and they immediately exploded upon impact.
Boom!
Terrifying energy surged, turning into two mushroom-shaped balls of energy that pushed out in all directions at an astonishing speed.
This was pure energy, without a shred of Regulations, but because it was too strong, it was still boundlessly terrifying, enough to kill Venerate Tier elites.
C

chapters.title: Chapter 4482: Deterrence
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian were both astonished.

It was true that they were Venerate Tier elites, but after all, they had only just stepped into this cultivation level. Even if it was Golden Generation, their battle prowess would only be four or five stars. Among Venerate Tiers, they could only be considered mid-level.
Yet this energy storm was enough to kill peak stage Venerate Tier elites.
Boom!

The energy storm surged violently. Thankfully, they did not directly rush towards the Energy Jade, but rather chose to dodge. As a result, they managed to dodge the front, and were not directly hit by the energy storm.
The two Imperial Sons both retreated, dodging the energy storm. Though they had still been scraped a little, they were completely fine.
Ling Han also retreated to a very far location. He had already used this thing to trick people once, so he naturally knew where the safe zone was.
In the distance, Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian both revealed baleful killing intent.

This was especially the case for Imperial Son Ming. If it weren’t for Imperial Son Tian’s warning, perhaps he would have directly sent the Energy Jade flying with a palm strike. If that were the case, he would have been in deep trouble. Even if he didn’t die, he would have been severely wounded.

At the Venerate Tier, the Substitution Seal was no longer useful, and this energy storm was comparable to a strike from a Saint. Even if the Substitution Seal could be used by a Venerate Tier, he would still die.
Thus, it could be said that he had just barely escaped death’s door.
“Ling Han!” he spat out word by word, wanting nothing more than to devour Ling Han’s flesh and blood.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and his hands lit up. Shockingly, an Energy Jade appeared in each of his hands.
He had picked up quite a number of these things at the bottom of the dried up lake.
“Want to play?” Ling Han asked with a smile that was filled with provocation.
This enraged Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian.
By now, they naturally knew how terrifying this seemingly insignificant jade was. They definitely could not allow it to hit them head-on. Otherwise, even they would be severely wounded.

“Humph, this thing is extremely unstable. It will explode if it is the slightest bit shaken!” Imperial Son Ming said calmly, “As long as we draw out the distance, and attack from afar, and detonate the jade in your hand, you would be the first to be unlucky.”
As expected of the Imperial Son, being able to see through the crux of the matter with a single glance.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s right. However, won’t I seize the opportunity to use it?”
Oh, you delivered a strike, and I still foolishly threw it out?

He would definitely take advantage of the time between your attacks to make a move. In that way, even if the two Imperial Sons made another move, their counterattack would definitely be slightly later. The center of that energy storm could possibly be closer to the Imperial Sons.
This caused the two Imperial Sons to frown.
How could a mere Minor Advanced Tier be so difficult to kill?
“I don’t believe that!” Imperial Son Tian sneered. He sent out a palm strike, which turned into a massive dark cloud that enshrouded Ling Han.
The area covered by this attack was too large, and under the shockwave of power, it was enough to detonate the Energy Jade.
Ling Han laughed loudly and put away the Energy Jade. Then, he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to take this attack head-on.
Peng!
With this strike, Ling Han couldn’t help but flush red, and a mouthful of blood was stuck in his throat.

This was a Venerate Tier elite, after all. Even if he attacked from such a far distance, and Ling Han had also unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it still dealt a considerable blow to him.
However, Imperial Son Tian and Imperial Son Ming were even more stunned.
What? If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, shouldn’t he have easily crushed the Sect Master?
But now? Ling Han actually didn’t even spit out a mouthful of blood!

“Die!” Imperial Son Ming also moved. With a punch, his attack turned into a fierce tiger, using power as bones, Regulations as blood and flesh, roaring as it charged towards Ling Han. Its speed was astonishingly fast.

Ling Han didn’t linger in battle. These two people were Venerate Tier elites, and even if he could rival them, he iwould probably have to be a Nine Star Sect Master. In fact, it would have to be after he had broken through the limits of the Minor Advanced Tier.
Now was not the time for battle.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unleashed as he rapidly retreated.
“You want to flee?” Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian both set off in pursuit.
However, an Energy Jade suddenly smashed over.
The two Imperial Sons had no choice but to dodge.
Boom!
The energy storm surged again, forcing the two Imperial Sons to be unable to pursue him at all.
When the energy storm subsided, where was Ling Han?
The two Imperial Sons exchanged a look, and both felt a strong sense of defeat.
Yet, Ling Han had still managed to escape?

In the future, this brat would only become stronger and stronger, and even if they were Imperial Sons, because they had already reached the level of Venerate Tier, the help that the Imperial Clan could give them would also become lesser and lesser. Their advancement would definitely slow down, or even stagnate for a very long time.
Then, when Ling Han’s cultivation level caught up...
“Not only Ling Han, but also Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and the others!”
“Let’s take advantage of their weak cultivation levels to kill them!”
“En!”
The two Imperial Sons nodded in agreement. This was a rare opportunity, and it was also possible that this was their only chance.
After Ling Han shrugged off the two Imperial Sons, he immediately found a secluded place, and began to study those black grass.
He still didn’t know what this thing was, but it didn’t matter.
Concocting the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill required only Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi. As for what specific type they were, there was no restriction.
“I have the main ingredient, and now it is the supplementary ingredient.”
Ling Han murmured. Though he had obtained a few Six Star Celestial medicines, if they were used to concoct alchemical pills, this was still not enough.
“I wonder if I can find all of them here.”
Ling Han also continued onwards, as he searched. Was it possible that he would discover Celestial medicines on the way?

It had to be said that his luck was not too bad. In the following seven days, he had repeatedly made gains. Though he had not obtained any Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi, there was still a considerable number of ordinary Six Star Celestial medicines.
“I’m still missing three.”
A look of delight appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had not thought that everything would progress so smoothly.

With another three Celestial medicines, he would be able to concoct the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill. Then, once it was concocted, the quality of the Celestial Qi that he would obtain would be greatly improved.

He continued to search, but his luck seemed to have taken a sharp turn for the worse. In the next two days, he actually did not manage to find another Celestial medicine. To say nothing of Six Stars, he would not even be able to find a One Star Celestial medicine.
Yi?
He searched thoroughly, but did not find any Celestial medicine. Instead, another palace appeared ahead of him.
Purple Wind Palace.
Ling Han walked over, only to see a person standing at the door.
Her bearing was captivating, Shui Qingchang.
Although her back was facing Ling Han, her divine sense was extremely sensitive. She immediately turned around and looked at Ling Han.
As the Genesis World’s rulers, the seven of them had an indescribable good impression of each other. Shui Qingchang nodded at Ling Han as a form of greeting.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, “Beauty Shui, do you have any Six Star Celestial medicine?”
Shui Qingchang was astonished. “What are you trying to do?”
“If you have these three Celestial medicines, I can give you something good.” Ling Han recited the names of the three Celestial medicines, “It can help you increase your cultivation level.”
“Yes.” Shui Qingchang did not hesitate, and directly threw out three Celestial medicines for Ling Han.
She was very straightforward, and also showed her trust in Ling Han.
“Wait for me for three days.” Ling Han picked up the Celestial medicine, and immediately turned to leave.
He wanted to find a place to concoct alchemical pills.

Ling Han also continued onwards, as he searched.
Was it possible that he would discover Celestial medicines on the way?
It had to be said that his luck was not too bad.
In the following seven days, he had repeatedly made gains.
Though he had not obtained any Celestial medicines that contained Celestial Qi, there was still a considerable number of ordinary Six Star Celestial medicines.
“I’m still missing three.”
A look of delight appeared on Ling Han’s face.
He had not thought that everything would progress so smoothly.
With another three Celestial medicines, he would be able to concoct the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill.
Then, once it was concocted, the quality of the Celestial Qi that he would obtain would be greatly improved.
He continued to search, but his luck seemed to have taken a sharp turn for the worse.
In the next two days, he actually did not manage to find another Celestial medicine.
To say nothing of Six Stars, he would not even be able to find a One Star Celestial medicine.
Yi?
He searched thoroughly, but did not find any Celestial medicine.
Instead, another palace appeared ahead of him.
Purple Wind Palace.
Ling Han walked over, only to see a person standing at the door.
Her bearing was captivating, Shui Qingchang.
Although her back was facing Ling Han, her divine sense was extremely sensitive.
She immediately turned around and looked at Ling Han.
As the Genesis World’s rulers, the seven of them had an indescribable good impression of each other.
Shui Qingchang nodded at Ling Han as a form of greeting.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, “Beauty Shui, do you have any Six Star Celestial medicine?”
Shui Qingchang was astonished.
“What are you trying to do?”
“If you have these three Celestial medicines, I can give you something good.” Ling Han recited the names of the three Celestial medicines, “It can help you increase your cultivation level.”
“Yes.” Shui Qingchang did not hesitate, and directly threw out three Celestial medicines for Ling Han.
She was very straightforward, and also showed her trust in Ling Han.
“Wait for me for three days.” Ling Han picked up the Celestial medicine, and immediately turned to leave.
He wanted to find a place to concoct alchemical pills.

chapters.title: Chapter 4483: Brother Monkey is the Most Handsome
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Shui Qingchang did not stop him.
Though Ling Han had taken away three precious Six Star Celestial medicines, he had only given her a verbal promise.

Firstly, because they were both masters of Genesis World, she still had some trust in Ling Han. Secondly, though these three Celestial medicines were Six Stars, they didn’t contain Celestial Qi, so she didn’t especially treasure them.
If Ling Han had really screwed her over, then she would not have any further contact with Ling Han in future. That was all.
Ling Han left the palace far away. He was sure that those who came here would definitely go and fight to death over this palace, so he decided not to join in on the excitement first.
He took out the alchemy cauldron and made all the preparations. Then, he replayed the process of the Alchemy Saint concocting the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill in his mind.
All right, that was enough.
He was filled with confidence. In terms of alchemy, he was even steadier in that than cultivation.
Boom, the cauldron’s fire blazed fiercely. He threw out medicinal ingredients, and truly began concocting.

Everything was as smooth as flowing water. Although this was Ling Han’s first time refining, he had already simulated it many times in his mind. With his strength as the Alchemy Emperor, he was completely capable of succeeding in a single attempt.
It should be known that long ago, he had already been able to concoct a Venerate Tier-level alchemical pill.
Three days later, he successfully finished his work. There were a total of eleven alchemical pills in the cauldron.
It was unknown how much Celestial Qi was contained in each alchemical pill. The quality must have increased greatly, and if it could still be maintained in quantity, that would be amazing.
However, no matter how he thought about it, this was impossible.
Ling Han took one out and consumed it. Instantly, Celestial Qi diffused throughout his body, and the fruit of cultivation rapidly grew.
Wu, what a strong Celestial Qi!
Ling Han was stunned. The quality of this Celestial Qi was really high, causing waves to rise in his mind, as if it was about to explode.
Half a day later, peace returned to his mind.
The fruit of cultivation had enlarged again, and the second golden thread had also become slightly denser.
That’s right. Going by this deduction, these alchemical pills were enough to push him up to Three Stars.
Ling Han did not continue to refine the alchemical pills. Since he had promised Shui Qingchang to wait three day for him, he would definitely have to return once the three days were over.

When he returned once more to the Purple Wind Palace, Shui Qingchang was not the only one here. There was also Jing Haoran, Origin and the other rulers of the Genesis World. He did not see anyone from the Imperial Clans.
Ling Han walked over and handed an alchemical pill to Shui Qingchang. “Here, it’s what I promised you.”
Shui Qingchang didn’t ask what it was, and simply put it away.
“Yi, the two of you?” Jing Haoran began to seek death again. His eyes swept over Ling Han and Shui Qingchang, his expression filled with suspicion, “Is there some kind of adulterous relationship?”
Did you have to say the word ‘adulterous love’?
Shui Qingchang’s eyes instantly became sharp, shooting out a strong killing intent.
Ling Han sighed, “If you don’t seek death, you won’t die. Why can’t you remember the lesson?”

Jing Haoran wore a solemn expression as he pointed at Ling Han and said, “If there’s no problem, why do you have to immediately explain? There’s a saying that an explanation is equivalent to a cover-up!” He pounded his chest and stomped his feet. “My goddess, I finally fell in love with a goddess, yet a good cabbage has been stolen by a pig!1”
These words successfully provoked Ling Han and Shui Qingchang into killing intent.
“What part of me looks like cabbages?” Ling Han questioned.
Shui Qingchang had initially been filled with killing intent, but when she heard these words, she almost stumbled.
F***, you are really too shameless. Could it be that I am the pig here?
In this way, the atmosphere immediately turned awry.
“What is it? Can’t you enter?” Ling Han asked. Three days ago, he had seen Shui Qingchang standing here, and it was still the same now.
“We can’t.” Origin shook his head, “This stage... is too unique.”
“How is it special?” Ling Han asked.

“The main doors of the palace are guarded by an ancient Tool Spirit, and one can only enter the palace through its approval,” Myriad Dao explained. “But the problem is that its approval isn’t targeted at strength, comprehension ability, and so on. Instead, it’s completely because you’re not pleasing to the eye.”
“Yi?” Ling Han gritted his teeth. This was weird.
“Neither of you... passed?” he asked, a smile curling up the corners of his lips.
This caused Ding Shu to grit his teeth, and asked, “What is the meaning of this? Are you complaining that we are ugly?”
Ling Han laughed loudly. That was what he meant. Of course, he was only teasing him.
“If you can, then go ahead!” Ding Shu Ding Shu provoked.

Ling Han strode forwards, and arrived at the entrance of the palace. At this moment, a figure appeared. It was an old geezer who looked to be in his sixties. He had a sharp mouth and monkey-like cheeks, and his appearance could only be described as extraordinary.
“Shoo, shoo, shoo. If you’re too ugly, don’t come and embarrass yourself!” The old geezer waved his hand the moment he saw Ling Han, a look of disdain on his face.
Pu!
Behind him, Ding Shu and the others were already laughing madly.
‘How about it? You’ve also suffered a blow, right?’
Ling Han also mocked internally. Though he could not be considered world-shakingly handsome, he could still be considered a handsome man, no matter what. What kind of f eyes did he have?
But to argue with the Tool Spirit?
Hehe, he could sense that this place was densely covered with killing intent. As long as the Tool Spirit moved, it would be able to awaken a certain deadly weapon, and give him a fatal blow.
Yi?
He suddenly realized that the old geezer’s sharp mouth and monkey-like cheeks looked very familiar.
Brother Monkey?
Indeed, though this old man was in human form, from a certain angle, he was more like a monkey. It was just that he did not have any fur or tail.
Ling Han turned around and transformed into Brother Monkey.
Ding Shu and the others all shook their heads and smiled upon seeing this.

How could they not see that the old geezer looked like a monkey? Thus, in order to suit his tastes, they had long since transformed into monkeys, but so what? No matter how much they looked like monkeys, they were all considered ugly by the old geezer.
It was useless!
Ling Han turned around, and said to the old man with a smile, “If that’s the case, then wouldn’t I be handsome?”

“Handsome, you are world-shakingly handsome!” the old man exclaimed, his face filled with stars. “There’s actually such a handsome person in this world. You are practically blessed by the heaven and earth, exuding the beauty of heaven and earth!”
‘Holy f*ck!’
Ding Shu and the others almost collapsed into a heap. They had been laughing just then, but this time, they were shocked.
F***, why was it that Ling Han was handsome when he was pretending to be a monkey, but they were ugly?
This didn’t make sense. This didn’t make sense!

Meanwhile, Ling Han nodded internally. Brother Monkey was a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor, and in terms of the most handsome monkey, it was definitely the Battle Saint Emperor. Thus, if he imitated Brother Monkey, he had a 90% chance of passing the test.
The truth was indeed so.
‘Brother Monkey, thanks.’
Ling Han smiled faintly, turned around and winked at Ding Shu and the others. Then, he walked into the palace.
Ding Shu and the others were all enraged upon hearing this. Sure enough, ugly people would be blocked from entering.
They were naturally dissatisfied. They also transformed into Brother Monkey and walked forward.
“No, no. Though you all have become handsome now, but since the first person has entered, you all have to wait for a day.” The old man stopped them.
Waiting for a day?
Ding Shu and the others all sighed. No matter how many treasures there were in that palace, Ling Han would definitely have taken all of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4484: Golden Generation leaves the stage
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Right at this moment, another person came over.
Though Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and He Luo had come from different directions, they had arrived at practically the same time.
“Yi, where is Ling Han?” Their eyes swept over them, and asked at the first instant.
In their eyes, Ling Han was their strongest competitor. Thus, their hearts jolted when they didn’t see Ling Han at all.
Ding Shu and the others all pointed at the palace.
As expected!
Yang Yihuan and the others all sighed. They had spent some time to break through to the Venerate Tier, but in the end, they still couldn’t catch up to Ling Han even if they tried their best.
‘Hmm?’
In the distant skies, a great many people were presently rushing over.
One, two, three, four... there were about thirty of them.
Imperial Son Ming, Imperial Son Tian, Golden Generations, and a few Silver Generations.
They soon arrived, and as their eyes swept over Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu and the others, killing intent surged from their bodies.
These people were too freakish, posing a serious threat to the Imperial Sons. If they were not killed, then the imperial throne would really have nothing to do with the Imperial Sons.
Just in time. This was a Mystery Realm, and there were really too many people that had died in the Imperial Path, so even if they were killed, so what?
This was a rare opportunity, so they definitely couldn’t miss it.
“Very good, all of you are here,” Imperial Son Ming said balefully, contempt flickering in his eyes.

Even it was suspected that there was a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind Yang Yihuan and the others, they still felt a sense of disdain. This was the feeling of superiority of the Imperial Clans. Otherwise, even if you were a Pseudo-Emperor, so what?
A Pseudo-Emperor could not forge an Imperial Weapon, or create the Imperial Scroll. They could only lead the brilliance for a while. How could they compare to the eternally glorious Imperial Clans?
“So what?” He Luo asked calmly.
“Since you’re together, we can kill all of you in one go, so we can save some effort!” Imperial Son Tian said.

“Oh?” Yang Yihuan couldn’t help but shake his head, saying, “I was just thinking that the Imperial Sons of your generation didn’t have much ability, but from the look of things now, even your minds are so weak! Do you think that the imperial throne could be achieved by cutting out weak opponents? Then you guys are really too naive!”
“Only the strongest clash can establish the position of Emperor!”
Imperial Son Ming smirked coldly, “If you talk too much, I’ll start with you!”
He stretched out a hand to grab Yang Yihuan.
Boom, a large hand stretched out, covering the skies and covering the sun. Regulations appeared, which was incredibly terrifying.
Yang Yihuan was unafraid. His eyes widened slightly, and two God Tools fell out of his hands, slashing towards Imperial Son Ming.

These two God Tools had been forged by the Regulations, and they had been fused with the power of a Venerate Tier elite. In an instant, they had transformed into giant blades. The two swords slashed over, and the massive palm was instantly sliced into three parts. The Regulations had also been forcefully severed.
Yi! En? Ya?
Everyone was shocked, including Ding Shu and the others.
F***, how did Yang Yihuan suddenly become so powerful?
Previously, he was only a Four-Star or Five-Star Sect Master, so why had he suddenly exploded with battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier?
“Venerate Tier!”
“He is indeed a Venerate Tier elite!”
“In such a short amount of time, how did he become a Venerate Tier elite?”
This caused everyone to be completely stunned. This had completely defied the iron rules of cultivation. No matter how awesome the Celestial medicine was, it should not be as awesome as this.

Only Feng Miaoling and He Luo wore calm expressions. They naturally knew that Yang Yihuan had reached the Venerate Tier countless times. However, he had severed his own cultivation level and started from the beginning again, so it would be extremely easy for him to return to the peak stage now.
It was not just Yang Yihuan. The two of them were the same as well. In fact, they had already returned to Venerate Tier-level.

In reality, the lower one’s cultivation level, the greater their gains would be if they walked the Imperial Path. This was something that they had concluded from their many experiences, but this time, they were really forced into a corner by Ling Han and could only break through ahead of time.
Yang Yihuan smiled faintly and said, “You still want to use your cultivation level to suppress others?”
He charged out, launching a counterattack at Imperial Son Ming.
“Now, I’ll let you suffer the consequences of your own actions!”
Boom, he struck out with both palms, and as the blow was delivered, there were actually nine Seven Star Regulations.
Imperial Son Ming was astonished by this.
This was because he was also a Two Star Venerate Tier elite like Yang Yihuan. However, he could only unleash eight Seven Star Regulations with a single strike.
This was an instant ability, and it depended on the strength of one’s divine sense.
Even though there was only one additional Regulations, that was a difference of a single star!
From the Sect Master-level onwards, the gap of a single star was like a gulf.
Imperial Son Ming shouted loudly as he charged forward.
As the Imperial Son, and as the flag of the Golden Generation, there was naturally no way he would cower from battle.

He had still been dreaming, relying on the Imperial Scroll to compensate for his shortcomings in Regulations. However, the moment they exchanged blows, he discovered that his opponent was stronger than him!
Hiss, could it be that you too have cultivated the Imperial Scroll?
Otherwise, it could not be explained that the other’s power was stronger than his own. That power was incredibly pure, and could only be tempered by the Imperial Scroll.

This Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan. It was a secret that was not taught to others, because it also involved the control of the Imperial Weapon. What Imperial Clan would dare teach the Imperial Scroll to another? Even among the Imperial Clans, there were very few that could cultivate the Imperial Scroll.
Ling Han had cultivated the Imperial Scroll, and that was because he had obtained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. However, what was Yang Yihuanrelying on?
Wasn’t there a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind him?
How could a Pseudo-Emperor create an Imperial Scroll?
That was the Great Emperor’s summary of appreciation of heaven and earth. Only the Great Emperor could create it, and it was passed down through the generations.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely. In just a dozen over moves, it could be clearly seen that Imperial Son Ming was at a disadvantage.
This caused everyone to sigh. The Golden Generation was really about to bow out.

First, it was Brother Monkey that had appeared out of nowhere, battling three great Imperial Sons all by himself. Alright, it could still be claimed that Brother Monkey had the advantage in terms of cultivation level at the time. After all, it was a battle of two Stars against one Star.
But now?
Their cultivation levels were completely the same, yet Yang Yihuan had forcefully suppressed Imperial Son Ming. What else could he say?
The Golden Generation was truly about to dejectedly leave the stage.
“No!” Imperial Son Mingroared. He didn’t accept this!

He was the descendant of Ancestral King Wen Tian, and had grown up with a halo around him. He was called the person closest to Ancestral King Wen Tian. He was defiant, and could not accept defeat in a battle of equal cultivation levels, especially such a terrible defeat.
He used all his ultimate moves, Imperial Techniques activated, Regulations shone brilliantly, and stimulated heaven and earth.
However, in front of Yang Yihuan, this was completely useless.
Suppress, suppress, suppress, suppress... It was only a hundred moves, and Imperial Son Ming had no choice but to accept such a terrible defeat.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he was outmatched!

The expressions of the Imperial Sons all changed drastically, and they were rendered speechless. Even the strongest Golden Generation had been defeated, which was equivalent to pushing all of the Imperial Sons off the high altar. All of them had landed solidly on the ground.

Yang Yihuan had initially been calm and composed, as if he didn’t take anything to heart. Now, however, he was showing a baleful killing intent as he chased after Imperial Son Ming and attacked him relentlessly. He was actually trying to kill him.
This stunned everyone. Did Yang Yihuan really dare to kill the Imperial Son?

However, with so many witnesses, could it be that he wanted to kill everyone to keep the secret? Otherwise, even if there was a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind you, how could the Wentian Imperial Clan be willing to give up the matter? They would definitely take out the Imperial Weapon to seek an accounting.
Imperial Son Ming fought back with all his might, yet he was only falling further and further into a disadvantage. If this continued, he would definitely die.
He did not dare continue the battle, and hurriedly turned around to flee for his life.

Previously, he was only a Four-Star or Five-Star Sect Master, so why had he suddenly exploded with battle prowess on the level of Venerate Tier?
“Venerate Tier!”
“He is indeed a Venerate Tier elite!”
“In such a short amount of time, how did he become a Venerate Tier elite?”
This caused everyone to be completely stunned.
This had completely defied the iron rules of cultivation.
No matter how awesome the Celestial medicine was, it should not be as awesome as this.
Only Feng Miaoling and He Luo wore calm expressions.
They naturally knew that Yang Yihuan had reached the Venerate Tier countless times.
However, he had severed his own cultivation level and started from the beginning again, so it would be extremely easy for him to return to the peak stage now.
It was not just Yang Yihuan.
The two of them were the same as well.
In fact, they had already returned to Venerate Tier-level.
In reality, the lower one’s cultivation level, the greater their gains would be if they walked the Imperial Path.
This was something that they had concluded from their many experiences, but this time, they were really forced into a corner by Ling Han and could only break through ahead of time.
Yang Yihuan smiled faintly and said, “You still want to use your cultivation level to suppress others?”
He charged out, launching a counterattack at Imperial Son Ming.
“Now, I’ll let you suffer the consequences of your own actions!”
Boom, he struck out with both palms, and as the blow was delivered, there were actually nine Seven Star Regulations.
Imperial Son Ming was astonished by this.
This was because he was also a Two Star Venerate Tier elite like Yang Yihuan.
However, he could only unleash eight Seven Star Regulations with a single strike.
This was an instant ability, and it depended on the strength of one’s divine sense.
Even though there was only one additional Regulations, that was a difference of a single star!
From the Sect Master-level onwards, the gap of a single star was like a gulf.
Imperial Son Ming shouted loudly as he charged forward.
As the Imperial Son, and as the flag of the Golden Generation, there was naturally no way he would cower from battle.
He had still been dreaming, relying on the Imperial Scroll to compensate for his shortcomings in Regulations.
However, the moment they exchanged blows, he discovered that his opponent was stronger than him!
Hiss, could it be that you too have cultivated the Imperial Scroll?
Otherwise, it could not be explained that the other’s power was stronger than his own.
That power was incredibly pure, and could only be tempered by the Imperial Scroll.
This Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan.
It was a secret that was not taught to others, because it also involved the control of the Imperial Weapon.
What Imperial Clan would dare teach the Imperial Scroll to another?
Even among the Imperial Clans, there were very few that could cultivate the Imperial Scroll.
Ling Han had cultivated the Imperial Scroll, and that was because he had obtained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
However, what was Yang Yihuanrelying on?
Wasn’t there a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind him?
How could a Pseudo-Emperor create an Imperial Scroll?
That was the Great Emperor’s summary of appreciation of heaven and earth.
Only the Great Emperor could create it, and it was passed down through the generations.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely.
In just a dozen over moves, it could be clearly seen that Imperial Son Ming was at a disadvantage.
This caused everyone to sigh.
The Golden Generation was really about to bow out.
First, it was Brother Monkey that had appeared out of nowhere, battling three great Imperial Sons all by himself.
Alright, it could still be claimed that Brother Monkey had the advantage in terms of cultivation level at the time.
After all, it was a battle of two Stars against one Star.
But now?
Their cultivation levels were completely the same, yet Yang Yihuan had forcefully suppressed Imperial Son Ming.
What else could he say?
The Golden Generation was truly about to dejectedly leave the stage.
“No!” Imperial Son Mingroared.
He didn’t accept this!
He was the descendant of Ancestral King Wen Tian, and had grown up with a halo around him.
He was called the person closest to Ancestral King Wen Tian.
He was defiant, and could not accept defeat in a battle of equal cultivation levels, especially such a terrible defeat.
He used all his ultimate moves, Imperial Techniques activated, Regulations shone brilliantly, and stimulated heaven and earth.
However, in front of Yang Yihuan, this was completely useless.
Suppress, suppress, suppress, suppress...
It was only a hundred moves, and Imperial Son Ming had no choice but to accept such a terrible defeat.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he was outmatched!
The expressions of the Imperial Sons all changed drastically, and they were rendered speechless.
Even the strongest Golden Generation had been defeated, which was equivalent to pushing all of the Imperial Sons off the high altar.
All of them had landed solidly on the ground.
Yang Yihuan had initially been calm and composed, as if he didn’t take anything to heart.
Now, however, he was showing a baleful killing intent as he chased after Imperial Son Ming and attacked him relentlessly.
He was actually trying to kill him.
This stunned everyone.
Did Yang Yihuan really dare to kill the Imperial Son?
However, with so many witnesses, could it be that he wanted to kill everyone to keep the secret?
Otherwise, even if there was a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind you, how could the Wentian Imperial Clan be willing to give up the matter?
They would definitely take out the Imperial Weapon to seek an accounting.
Imperial Son Ming fought back with all his might, yet he was only falling further and further into a disadvantage.
If this continued, he would definitely die.
He did not dare continue the battle, and hurriedly turned around to flee for his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 4485: Purple Calamity Grains
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Speaking of which, after Ling Han entered the palace, he discovered that there were strong winds howling here, and they were tangible at that.
Purple-colored wind.
How could the wind have any color?
Ling Han was surprised. He looked closely. The reason why this wind was purple was because there was a kind of purple substance in the wind.
However, this substance also seemed to be a gas, and when it hit the skin, he did not feel anything at all.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and carefully observed the surroundings.
No, this purple substance was a very small material, and there was an extremely large amount of it. Thus, if it floated in the air, it would form a purple-coloured wind.
When these substances hit the body, they adhered to the skin, and were actually slowly absorbed.
Yi?
Ling Han was surprised. After this purple substance entered his body, it was hidden under his skin, forming a thin film.
It was as if this was a second layer of skin.
Ling Han sensed for a while, and felt that this purple film was extremely sturdy.
“It’ll only shatter if it can withstand the full-power attack of a Sect Master above six stars,” he murmured, his eyes filled with shock.
Most importantly, the purple substance was still endlessly surging into his body, causing that membrane to become thicker and thicker.
Hiss, at this rate, wouldn’t he be able to withstand the attack of a Venerate Tier or even Saint?
Then wouldn’t he be able to do as he liked?
So exaggerated?
Ling Han walked forwards. In any case, the wind was constantly blowing, and he was also constantly absorbing the purple substance.
His speed was extremely fast, and the purple-colored substance continuously surged into his body, causing this film to become thicker and thicker.
No, it wasn’t thick, but concentrated.
For example, if there were 100 purple substances on the fingernail-sized membrane previously, it had now become 120, 150, and it was still continuously increasing.
He walked to the end of the palace hall, and saw that there was a jade board here. It was very thin, and there were some words written on it.
Ling Han studied it carefully. This was the description of the purple substance.
This was called Purple Calamity Grain. When it was fully absorbed, the defense it formed could even block the full-power attack of a Saint below Five Stars.

However, every time it absorbed the impact force, the Purple Calamity Grains would lose a portion of its vitality, and when all its vitality had been lost, this would lose its effects, and would automatically be expelled from the body.

Theoretically speaking, he could withstand five attacks from a Saint. Of course, the upper limit was from a Four-Star Saint to a Five-Star Saint. If he had to sustain an attack from a Nine-Star Saint, then even Purple Calamity Grains would probably not be able to protect Ling Han. He would definitely die.
If it was a Venerate Tier, he could sustain as many as 80 attacks, and the upper limit was Nine-Star Venerate Tier.

“When you don’t need to use it, you can store it in the depths of your body. Otherwise, a portion of your vitality would be expended every time you battle. Even if you battle with a Sect Master, you would still cause the Purple Calamity Grains to completely lose its vitality.”
Ling Han murmured to himself.
Half a day later, the depth of the purple wind in the palace clearly weakened by more than half, and about half of the Purple Calamity Grains had been absorbed by him.
However, this also reached the extreme, and he couldn’t take another step further.

Ling Han felt slightly regretful that he hadn’t been able to absorb all the Purple Calamity Grains, which would have benefited the others. However, he alone had taken more than half of it, and the others could only share the remaining. The gap between them was not just a little bit.
With this in mind, his thoughts cleared up.
Ling Han searched around for a while. There was a Transference Portal here that allowed one to leave.
He was leaving.
Without hesitation, he took a step forward.
Space changed, and the environment immediately changed.
Ling Han looked again, and he had already arrived in a glacier. A chill assaulted him, causing him to shudder.
“F***, why is it so cold?” Ling Han gritted his teeth, the chill seeping into his bones.

He took a step forward, and the moment he moved, the chill became even stronger. It was as if the air had turned into blades that continuously slashed at his body. His clothes did not have the slightest effect of keeping out the cold.
“It can’t be that I have to use Purple Calamity Grains here, right?” Ling Han thought.
With a thought, he drew out the Saint Grade staff, and activated the bead within. Instantly, a shield of light enveloped him.
The wind blew over, but it did not break through.
Haha, this works.
Ling Han nodded, raised the staff in his right hand, and strode forwards.

After walking for half a day, he discovered that the temperature had actually risen again. Though it was still very cold, even without the protection of the natural treasure, he was completely unafraid.
Er, could it be that according to the normal method, he should have waited until now to take action?
Forget it. In any case, I have a treasure to protect me, so why should I follow the rules?
After walking for a while, he smelt a refreshing fragrance.
His nose twitched, and he hurriedly followed the fragrance. Soon, he discovered a cave.

The cave wasn’t deep, and he arrived at the end after taking a few steps. There was a pit on the ground, and it was filled with a milky white liquid. It was this thing that was exuding a refreshing fragrance.
“What Spiritual Milk is this?”
“Uh, I’ll taste it first.”
Ling Han took a small sip, and instantly, his whole body felt warm, his vitality burning fiercely.
“This is... treasure fluid that stimulates and strengthens one’s life force!”
A look of delight appeared on his face.
This was great profit!

Though he was very young now, filled with vigor and vitality, some people had been stuck at a certain cultivation level for innumerable years. They clearly had hopes of breaking through, but because they were not energetic enough, their vitality was deficient, which led to them being unable to break through. Otherwise, their vitality would definitely be burnt to nothing, and they would directly die.

Hence, if this kind of treasure fluid was sold to those old Venerate Tier elites that were stuck at the cultivation level barrier, it was believed that a great many people would be willing to pay a great price in exchange for it.
He carefully stored this treasure fluid into a jade bottle, and just at this moment, a drop of liquid dropped down from the upper wall of the cave.
Ling Han hurriedly stretched out a hand to capture it, and put away this drop of treasure fluid as well.
En, this treasure fluid fluid wasn’t seeping out of an underground spring, but rather dripping from above.
Ling Han looked up, only to see that the cave walls were slightly damp. A drop of treasure fluid was slowly forming.
“By the looks of it, it would take half a day to form a drop.”
He tried to dig, searching for the source of the treasure fluid, but he did not succeed.
The stone wall was too sturdy, and when he used Destructive Energy, he actually felt an extremely dangerous pressure.
Perhaps, when he broke open the rock, there would be great killing intent.
Forget it. His gains were already not small, and he did not have the time to wait slowly here either. Who knows, there may still be some good stuff ahead of him.
He exited the cave, and instantly shivered. It was so cold.
Taking a step back, he returned to the cave, and instantly, the temperature rose rapidly.

Ling Han nodded. Actually, even without that natural pearl, he could still pass through here. He only had to travel when the temperature rose, and find a hole to avoid the cold when the temperature dropped.
Who cares!
Ling Han strode forward. He had a natural treasure, so he could do as he liked.
After walking for another half a day, he discovered a second hole, but there was no refreshing fragrance wafting from here. He could see it directly with the naked eye.
In any case, he would enter the cave to take a look.
Ling Han entered and searched for a while. There was definitely no treasure fluid, and the other items... were also nowhere to be seen.
This was an empty hole that could only be used to avoid the cold.
Ling Han sighed and continued to walk forward.
