chapters.title: Chapter 4486: Path of Regulations
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han walked all the way. On the way, he discovered a considerable number of caves that he could use to avoid the cold, but whether it was the treasure fluid or Celestial medicine, there wasn’t any, and he did not have the slightest bit of gain.
Thinking about it, it was fine. The treasure fluid was really very precious. If it was used well, it could completely be traded for a large amount of Seven Star Celestial medicine for him.
One should be contented with what one had.
After walking for three days, Ling Han finally walked out of the icy plains, and a canyon appeared ahead of him.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to refine the Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill first. He would increase his strength as much as possible.
He found a quiet place, took out the alchemical pills and began to refine them.
One pill, two pills, three pills. He had concocted a total of eleven pills. Previously, he had eaten one, and given another to Shui Qingchang. Now, there were still nine pills left.

With each pill, the rich Celestial Qi would strengthen the fruit of cultivation. When he ate the eighth pill, the second golden thread on the fruit of cultivation finally reached the consummate state.
Two-star Sect Master, peak stage.

He spent some time trying to break through to the level of Three Star Sect Master. He was only advancing his minor level, so there was no need for him to accumulate too much energy. He could completely advance his cultivation level first, and then slowly stabilize it.
The Dao Fruit Tree naturally grew as well, swaying in his mind with a strange rhythm.
Ling Han ingested the last Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, and the third golden thread of the fruit of cultivation, from lighter, became deeper.
This breakthrough took him about six days.
Ling Han returned to the canyon, only to discover that many people had already arrived.

There were regulars like Yang Yihuan, and Feng Miaoling, as well as rulers of the Genesis World like Ding Shu, Origin, and so on. In addition, Imperial Son Ming, Imperial Son Tian, and the other Golden Generations had also arrived, but these two most powerful Imperial Sons wore expressions of disappointment, as if they had suffered some great blow.
Furthermore, in terms of conduct, the Imperial Sons were also extraordinarily timid, like children that had done something wrong.
He, this was rare.
In addition, Brother Monkey had also arrived. He was presently crossing the canyon.

They were not at the entrance to the canyon, but rather on the cliff on one side. Connecting these two cliffs were threads. Upon a closer look, one would discover that these threads were actually formed from Regulations.

When one walked on it, the threads of Regulations would tremble, and one could be easily overturned. Thus, those walking on it had to resonate with the Regulations, and move with the Regulations, becoming one with the Regulations.

Ling Han saw a Silver Generation elite exclaim in surprise as he walked, falling down from the silk of Regulations. He was like a large rock that had fallen into the water. He didn’t soar up at all, and directly fell to the bottom of the valley.
As expected, flying was not allowed here?
Ling Han walked over. He didn’t greet Brother Monkey. At this moment, Brother Monkey was focused on resonating with the Regulations. He definitely couldn’t distract him.
“Hey, Ling Han!” Ding Shu and the others had not even begun their journey, when they all greeted Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, and asked them some questions.

Though this was the first time Ding Shu and the others had come here, they had watched for a long time, hadn’t they? Furthermore, Yang Yihuan and the others had already come many times, so they could investigate the situation from them.

The truth was more or less as Ling Han had guessed. One could only pass through here by treading on the threads of Regulations. Flight was not possible, as one would be directly pressed to the bottom of the valley. This had the same result as failing to pass on the threads of Regulations, and that was one would no longer be able to see the threads of Regulations, and would not be able to touch the threads of Regulations.
This meant that the possibility of crossing the canyon had been lost, and they could only wait for Imperial Path to close, and be thrown out of this Mystery Realm.
Hence, for everyone, there was only one chance.
In fact, there were many threads of Regulations here, and there were only about 40 people here. It was completely enough for everyone to try.
“What are you guys waiting for?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Waiting for you,” Shui Qingchang said.
“Waiting for me?” Ling Han was surprised. Don’t be so ambiguous. There was nothing going on between us.
“We are waiting to compete with you,” Heaven Crushing said. “Let’s see who can pass first.”
“En!” Jing Haoran and the others nodded.
F***, you guys are very free, is that really necessary?

Upon further thought, the extent of his freakish talent was already number one in the world. Thus, every prodigy wanted to defeat him, so that their claim of first place would be justified. Otherwise, they would always feel that something was off.
Ling Han wiped away the cold sweat on his forehead. Everyone was fixated on him now?
“Alright, let’s compete,” he said with a smile. In terms of natural talent and comprehension ability, what did he have to fear?
The seven of them each chose a silk thread, and then stepped out with one foot at the same time.
The threads of Regulations instantly rebounded. This was a manifestation of the willpower of heaven and earth, so how could it be allowed to be touched by others?
Thus, one had to resonate with it.

Now, though everyone’s feet were stepping on the threads of Regulations, they were actually all stepping on empty air. They were completely relying on the other foot that was standing on the cliff to maintain their balance.

The seven Genesis World rulers had all surpassed the Golden Generation. Even such people like Yang Yihuan and Feng Miaoling were slightly inferior. Their divine sense surged, presently rapidly analyzing the Regulations.
It would depend on who would be the first to take the other step. This would allow them to gain the first opportunity.
Merely half a minute later, seven people stepped out with their second foot at practically the same time.
In terms of comprehension ability, none of them was inferior to others.

Ling Han nodded internally. As expected of the Genesis World’s leaders. Being able to stand out from millions and millions of living beings, their comprehension ability was definitely impressive, and there was nothing to say about it.
Thus, it was actually a matter of fate that allowed them to cultivate to a higher level after coming to the new world.

And fateful encounters were also related to luck, personality, and even the way one handled matters. For example, if Ling Han could obtain the Origin Gold, that would be a burst of luck for him. If it really had to be claimed that he was more outstanding than Ding Shu and the others, that might not be the case either.
After taking the second step, their speed became faster, and they quickly took the third and fourth steps.
However, when they had just reached the tenth step, the threads of Regulations began to tremble greatly, causing everyone to stop.
They couldn’t walk any further, or they would definitely fall in.
Yang Yihuan and the others, including the Golden Generations, simply waited. They would wait for the shreds of Regulations to stabilize, and then walk on it.
However, Ling Han and the others didn’t think this way.
If that was the case, how could one possibly emerge victorious?
If one wanted to fight for first place, he would have to do something that others could not.
Thus, the seven of them were all deducing in their minds how they could continue to resonate with the Regulations when the threads of Regulations were trembling violently.
The difficulty level instantly increased by more than a dozen times, or even a hundred times.
After a long time, Ling Han finally took a step forward.
Just as his foot landed, Myriad Dao and the others also raised their feet at almost the same time.
Ling Han was still in the lead!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and took a second step.
This was obviously faster than the others, because though Ding Shu and the others had raised their feet, they were moving very slowly.

The third step, the fourth step, Ling Han’s speed became faster and faster. His divine sense had been tempered too perfectly, and this naturally caused his resonance with Regulations to become even faster.
He left them in the dust, and no one could compare to him.
Sigh!
Ding Shu and the others all saw this. Aside from feeling gloomy, they could only admit defeat.

The Dao Fruit Tree naturally grew as well, swaying in his mind with a strange rhythm.
Ling Han ingested the last Little Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, and the third golden thread of the fruit of cultivation, from lighter, became deeper.
This breakthrough took him about six days.
Ling Han returned to the canyon, only to discover that many people had already arrived.
There were regulars like Yang Yihuan, and Feng Miaoling, as well as rulers of the Genesis World like Ding Shu, Origin, and so on.

In addition, Imperial Son Ming, Imperial Son Tian, and the other Golden Generations had also arrived, but these two most powerful Imperial Sons wore expressions of disappointment, as if they had suffered some great blow.
Furthermore, in terms of conduct, the Imperial Sons were also extraordinarily timid, like children that had done something wrong.
He, this was rare.
In addition, Brother Monkey had also arrived.
He was presently crossing the canyon.
They were not at the entrance to the canyon, but rather on the cliff on one side.
Connecting these two cliffs were threads.
Upon a closer look, one would discover that these threads were actually formed from Regulations.
When one walked on it, the threads of Regulations would tremble, and one could be easily overturned.
Thus, those walking on it had to resonate with the Regulations, and move with the Regulations, becoming one with the Regulations.
Ling Han saw a Silver Generation elite exclaim in surprise as he walked, falling down from the silk of Regulations.
He was like a large rock that had fallen into the water.
He didn’t soar up at all, and directly fell to the bottom of the valley.
As expected, flying was not allowed here?
Ling Han walked over.
He didn’t greet Brother Monkey.
At this moment, Brother Monkey was focused on resonating with the Regulations.
He definitely couldn’t distract him.
“Hey, Ling Han!” Ding Shu and the others had not even begun their journey, when they all greeted Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, and asked them some questions.
Though this was the first time Ding Shu and the others had come here, they had watched for a long time, hadn’t they?
Furthermore, Yang Yihuan and the others had already come many times, so they could investigate the situation from them.
The truth was more or less as Ling Han had guessed.
One could only pass through here by treading on the threads of Regulations.
Flight was not possible, as one would be directly pressed to the bottom of the valley.

This had the same result as failing to pass on the threads of Regulations, and that was one would no longer be able to see the threads of Regulations, and would not be able to touch the threads of Regulations.
This meant that the possibility of crossing the canyon had been lost, and they could only wait for Imperial Path to close, and be thrown out of this Mystery Realm.
Hence, for everyone, there was only one chance.
In fact, there were many threads of Regulations here, and there were only about 40 people here.
It was completely enough for everyone to try.
“What are you guys waiting for?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Waiting for you,” Shui Qingchang said.
“Waiting for me?” Ling Han was surprised.
Don’t be so ambiguous.
There was nothing going on between us.
“We are waiting to compete with you,” Heaven Crushing said.
“Let’s see who can pass first.”
“En!” Jing Haoran and the others nodded.
F***, you guys are very free, is that really necessary?
Upon further thought, the extent of his freakish talent was already number one in the world.
Thus, every prodigy wanted to defeat him, so that their claim of first place would be justified.
Otherwise, they would always feel that something was off.
Ling Han wiped away the cold sweat on his forehead.
Everyone was fixated on him now?
“Alright, let’s compete,” he said with a smile.
In terms of natural talent and comprehension ability, what did he have to fear?
The seven of them each chose a silk thread, and then stepped out with one foot at the same time.
The threads of Regulations instantly rebounded.
This was a manifestation of the willpower of heaven and earth, so how could it be allowed to be touched by others?
Thus, one had to resonate with it.
Now, though everyone’s feet were stepping on the threads of Regulations, they were actually all stepping on empty air.
They were completely relying on the other foot that was standing on the cliff to maintain their balance.
The seven Genesis World rulers had all surpassed the Golden Generation.
Even such people like Yang Yihuan and Feng Miaoling were slightly inferior.
Their divine sense surged, presently rapidly analyzing the Regulations.
It would depend on who would be the first to take the other step.
This would allow them to gain the first opportunity.
Merely half a minute later, seven people stepped out with their second foot at practically the same time.
In terms of comprehension ability, none of them was inferior to others.
Ling Han nodded internally.
As expected of the Genesis World’s leaders.
Being able to stand out from millions and millions of living beings, their comprehension ability was definitely impressive, and there was nothing to say about it.
Thus, it was actually a matter of fate that allowed them to cultivate to a higher level after coming to the new world.
And fateful encounters were also related to luck, personality, and even the way one handled matters.
For example, if Ling Han could obtain the Origin Gold, that would be a burst of luck for him.
If it really had to be claimed that he was more outstanding than Ding Shu and the others, that might not be the case either.
After taking the second step, their speed became faster, and they quickly took the third and fourth steps.
However, when they had just reached the tenth step, the threads of Regulations began to tremble greatly, causing everyone to stop.
They couldn’t walk any further, or they would definitely fall in.
Yang Yihuan and the others, including the Golden Generations, simply waited.
They would wait for the shreds of Regulations to stabilize, and then walk on it.
However, Ling Han and the others didn’t think this way.
If that was the case, how could one possibly emerge victorious?
If one wanted to fight for first place, he would have to do something that others could not.
Thus, the seven of them were all deducing in their minds how they could continue to resonate with the Regulations when the threads of Regulations were trembling violently.
The difficulty level instantly increased by more than a dozen times, or even a hundred times.
After a long time, Ling Han finally took a step forward.
Just as his foot landed, Myriad Dao and the others also raised their feet at almost the same time.
Ling Han was still in the lead!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and took a second step.
This was obviously faster than the others, because though Ding Shu and the others had raised their feet, they were moving very slowly.
The third step, the fourth step, Ling Han’s speed became faster and faster.
His divine sense had been tempered too perfectly, and this naturally caused his resonance with Regulations to become even faster.
He left them in the dust, and no one could compare to him.
Sigh!
Ding Shu and the others all saw this.
Aside from feeling gloomy, they could only admit defeat.

chapters.title: Chapter 4487: Tomb of the Heavenly Emperor
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
One could not help but be dissatisfied. The speed of passing this stage had nothing to do with strength. It was completely based on one’s comprehension of Regulations.
And this was closely related to the strength of one’s divine sense.
In other words, even Ling Han’s divine sense was more perfect than theirs!
This caused a great blow to Ding Shu and the others. Why were they inferior to Ling Han in every aspect?
They were all masters of Genesis World, so why was there such a huge gap between them?
It wasn’t long before Ling Han surpassed the Golden Generations that were walking ahead of him. He then caught up to Brother Monkey, Yang Yihuan and the others.

Even if Yang Yihuan and the others hadn’t walked the threads of Regulations for the first time, the Regulations they walked every time were different. They only knew what to do, and aside from that, they actually didn’t have any other advantage.
Thus, Ling Han surpassed them.
After more than an hour, Ling Han finally arrived at the other side of the canyon.
At this time, Yang Yihuan, who was walking in front, had only walked three-quarters of the way, and was still quite far from the finishing line.

Furthermore, because of his extreme speed, the Imperial Sons’ Dao Hearts became unstable, and they instantly lost the resonance of Regulations, falling directly. Though they would not die, they had also lost the possibility of advancing further.
Ling Han decided to wait for Brother Monkey. The two brothers had lost contact since entering the first palace, and it was only now that they met again. Of course, they had to advance together.
—After ending the Imperial Path adventure, they still had to return to Celestial Sea Planet together to see old acquaintances, family and friends.

The second person to pass was Yang Yihuan, and then the third, fourth, and fifth places were all very close. They were Feng Miaoling, He Luo, and Brother Monkey. In truth, the sixth place had also arrived very quickly. It was Ding Shu and the others that had arrived. Instead, it was those Imperial Sons that had fallen behind.
Yang Yihuan and He Luo stared at Ling Han for a while before saying, “If we can obtain the imperial throne by killing you, then we really won’t be able to resist this kind of temptation.”

“Then you all would have to get through Old Sun!” Brother Monkey slung the staff forged from Saintly Material on his shoulder, looking disdainfully at Yang Yihuan and He Luo, his fighting spirit soaring.
“Hehe, so you’re a descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor!” Yang Yihuan said with a smile. “Apologies! Apologies!”
Brother Monkey ignored him, and only said to Ling Han, “Brother, let’s go!”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, and waved at Ding Shu and the others, “Everyone, I’ll take my leave first.”
Actually, no one was interested in staying here, and there were no natural treasures or incomparable opportunities, so they naturally left as well.
“Yi, Brother Ling, what a coincidence. We meet again,” Jing Haoran teased Ling Han, with the spirit that it would definitely kill him if he didn’t seek death.
“Brother Jing, how have you lived for so long?” Ling Han asked curiously.
Jing Haoran propped up his chin in thought. After a while, he said, “It’s mainly because of my bearing.”
Ling Han was rendered speechless. He really wanted to kick him over.
Everyone descended from the mountain, and could vaguely see that there was another tall mountain ahead of them.
However, when they passed through a massive plain and arrived at the foot of a high mountain, they shockingly discovered that this was not a high mountain, but rather a large tomb.
—There was a massive stone tablet erected on it, and it was clearly written: Tomb of the Heavenly Emperor.
Everyone inhaled sharply. an Emperor’s tomb!
Was there a Great Emperor buried here?
Furthermore, which Great Emperor actually dared to claim that he was a Heavenly Emperor? This sounded even more awesome than a Great Emperor.
Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and He Luo exchanged a glance. Their pupils contracted, and this was a sign that they felt an indescribable shock.
“Brother Yang, do you guys know the origins of the tomb of the Heavenly Emperor?” Jing Haoran couldn’t help but ask.
Aside from courting death, his curiosity was also overwhelmingly great.
Yang Yihuan was still relatively amiable. He pondered for a moment before saying, “The last time I came, there was no Heavenly Emperor’s tomb here.”
What!
“Neither have I seen it before,” He Luo replied with a shake of his head.
Although Feng Miaoling didn’t speak, she also shook her head.

These three people had all come to the Imperial Path many times, and could be considered regulars, but there was actually a change in the Imperial Path, and even they were not sure about it. How could this not be shocking?
The willpower of heaven and earth created Imperial Path, and it could evolve continuously?
True, if that was not the case, how could the stone carvings of the past Great Emperors have appeared on that door on the sea?

Because there were a great many Great Emperors that had only achieved Dao after walking through Imperial Path. This was contrary to the flow of time. Thus, the only explanation was that Imperial Path itself had evolved.
“So, we have to enter and explore by ourselves,” Origin said after a moment of thought.
“Haha, since we are already here, we will take things as they come. What would we need to fear?” Jing Haoran appeared very heroic.
Brother Monkey was the most decisive. He directly set off, “Let’s go!”
Ling Han nodded, and walked side by side with Brother Monkey.
During this process, none of the Imperial Sons said a word. Even Imperial Son Ming and Imperial Son Tian were like roosters that had lost a cockfight, completely losing their temper.

It could not be helped. Previously, Imperial Son Ming had been horribly defeated by Yang Yihuan, and been pursued by Yang Yihuan for countless miles. In the end, he managed to fortunately escape with his life. The shadow in his heart was indescribably heavy, so how could he still dare to seek his own humiliation?

However, they all thought to themselves that once they left the Imperial Path, they would definitely ask the Saints of their clans to move, and kill all these people. Otherwise, the position of Emperor would definitely have nothing to do with them.

Brother Monkey’s race all had a firm and domineering personality. They would rather break than bend. Even if they encountered danger, they would only face it head-on. He walked into a dark passageway ahead of him, and strode forwards, unafraid.
Ling Han followed closely behind. Meanwhile, he spread out his divine sense, and sensed everything in his surroundings. He was extremely careful.
If both of them forged ahead stubbornly, that was definitely not a good thing.
After walking for a while in the passageway, the path ahead suddenly opened up.

The entire mountainside had been hollowed out, and the space was huge. There were seven-coloured flames rising, waterfalls soaring into the skies, and magnificent Divine Metal was glowing, making it seem a strange and peculiar scene.
“Be careful!” Brother Monkey suddenly said. Then, he suddenly raised his staff and pointed it straight ahead. “Who goest there? Show yourself!”
Ling Han focused his gaze, and saw a hazy shadow ahead of him. However, he couldn’t see clearly whether it was a human or a demon at all.
“Little monkey, you are quite hot-tempered.” An old voice rang out, and that shadow also walked out. When it came close enough, that layer of haziness gradually faded, revealing an old man.
Ling Han couldn’t help but give a ‘yi’, and said, “Senior, it’s you!”
It was the old man who had given him the Time Wine at the cemetery. When he woke up, there was no sign of the old man. He had not thought that he would appear here again.
The elder chuckled, and said, “Young man, you’re truly fortunate!”
Brother Monkey scratched his head, then shouted again, “Hey, who exactly are you?”
“As for me...” A look of reminiscence appeared on the elder’s face, and he said, “My name is Han Yun, the tomb keeper.”
It really was him. Previously, they had seen him in the Tomb of Time, and now it was the tomb of the Heavenly Emperor.
“Senior Han.” Ling Han clasped his hands in greeting, “You should have come here long ago. May I know what you can teach us?”
At this moment, Ding Shu, Origin, and the others also walked over from behind. When they discovered that there was actually an elder here, they were all shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 4488: Summoned
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
It should be known that there was a relative age limit for entering into the Imperial Path. It was not just anyone that could enter.
Thus, this old geezer looked to be quite old, and whether it was in absolute or relative terms of age, how could he possibly appear in this space?
Could it be that this was a native?
Han Yun smiled, and said, “Don’t worry, don’t worry. I do not belong here. I can only see everything, and cannot take anything. Otherwise, the heavens would not spare me!”
Hiss!
What did that mean?

Could it be that he was not a native of this place, but rather an outsider? However, he did not conform to the rules of entry into the Imperial Path for relatively young people. Instead, he had used some unknown method to enter. Thus, he could not break the rules, and snatch the fated opportunity from the “young people”.
“Senior, is there really a Great Emperor buried here?” Ling Han asked.

Han Yun shook his head, “There is no corpse of a Great Emperor here. However, there really is an opportunity related to the Great Emperor here. I just don’t know which of you would be able to obtain it.”
His words sent a wave of commotion through the masses.
As long as it was related to the Great Emperor, then no matter what kind of great opportunity it was, it was still astonishing.

“Go on, I’m also waiting for you guys to open the Imperial Path to follow youout,” Han Yun said with a smile. “After all, I’ve deceived the damn heavens for so long. If I break the rules again, it’s really possible that I will be struck to death.”
These words sounded frightening, because how many people were qualified to be struck to death by the heavens?
Even if he broke through to become a Saint, the heaven and earth would only cause internal demons to descend on him!
Unless he had done something unforgivable, then only would Heavenly Dao send down a lightning punishment to erase him.
Thus, a person that could be erased by Heavenly Dao must be overwhelmingly powerful.
Han Yun fell silent after saying this, and his figure became hazy again. No one could see through him.
Even Venerate Tier elites couldn’t see through, so just how powerful was the old geezer?
A Saint?
No one dared to disturb him. In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, Saints were naturally respected. Who dared to disrespect them?
They circled around Han Yun, one after another, and continued onwards.
There were no mechanisms or restrictions here. Everything was very calm, as if it was just an ordinary cave.
However, after walking for a while, the situation changed.
The resistance came again.

This resistance was not absolute, but rather differed based on cultivation level. For example, though Brother Monkey was a Venerate Tier, he did not have an easier time compared to Ling Han. The pressure he endured was a hundred times stronger, or even a thousand times stronger.
However, after advancing 300 meters, even someone as strong as Brother Monkey had no choice but to stop.
This resistance was already so strong that even he could not advance any further. However, with Brother Monkey’s domineering nature, how could he be willing to stop just like that?
He gave a loud shout, and channelled the metal rod in his hand, forcibly slicing through the obstructive force, and advanced once more.

His ferocity was unreasonable, and he actually forcibly advanced another 30 meters. However, this time, he had really reached his limit. No matter how fast Brother Monkey brandished the metal rod, he could not advance the slightest bit further.
This made Brother Monkey cry out in anger. He opened his mouth and bared his sharp teeth, as if he wanted to bite an invisible opponent to death.
With a thought, Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, planning to protect him and Brother Monkey as they continued to advance.
However, this time, even the Pseudo Imperial Weapon was useless. It was not effective against the resistance at all.
Yi, then what should he do?
Ling Han hurriedly shook his hands. Boom! Destructive Energy surged, and the obstructive force instantly disappeared.
He couldn’t help but feel surprised. He had only channeled the Destructive Energy in a gamble, but the effects were far better than he had imagined. He had actually pushed back all the resistance.
Unfortunately, this Destructive Energy could only protect him. It itself was a deadly weapon, and could not possibly protect Brother Monkey as well.
Seeing that Ling Han was advancing without any hindrance, Brother Monkey nodded, “Brother, you go first.”
Ling Han hesitated for a moment, then replied, “All right!”
No matter what he gained, he would share it with Brother Monkey.

He strode forwards, and behind him, Ding Shu, Heaven Crushing, and the others also channelled the Destructive Energy, moving freely under this resistance. On the other hand, Myriad Dao, Origin, and the others, though they too were masters of the Genesis World, but because they had not cultivated the Destructive Energy, they could only sigh helplessly.
After walking for over ten minutes, the obstructive force suddenly disappeared.

A forest of stone pillars appeared ahead of them. They were densely packed together, and there were indescribably many of them. Furthermore, every single stone pillar was still glowing, and their colour varied.
Where exactly was the great opportunity that Han Yun spoke of that was related to the Great Emperor?
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly faltered. He had a feeling that something was summoning him.
It was hard to say whether this was a human or something else. In short, he had established a connection with him, which also provided him with a vague direction.
He looked towards Ding Shu, and the others, and saw that these four people were also looking towards the others.
By the looks of it, everyone was being summoned by that being.
A treasure left behind by a Great Emperor?
But why them?

It should be known that this tomb of the Heavenly Emperor had not even existed the last time it was opened. This was proven by Yang Yihuan and the others. Then, from this deduction, it was very possible that this so-called Heavenly Emperor was referring to the previous Great Emperor.
Who was this Great Emperor? There were no historical records, and they only knew that there was indeed such an existence.
The problem was, what relation did this Great Emperor have with the Destructive Energy?
What did this have to do with the Genesis World?
If it was unrelated, then why was it that only the Genesis World’s Masters could cultivate Destructive Energy, and only they could walk here?
If they found the treasures left behind by this Great Emperor, would they be able to unravel all the secrets?
Everyone moved, heading towards the depths of the stone forest.
After walking for a while, they gradually stopped.
That was because that kind of feeling was intermittent, and incredibly weak.

During this process, Ling Han discovered that everyone’s perception of that unknown existence was different. He should be the strongest, because that connection had not been severed all this while, and the next strongest was Ding Shu.
Was this determined by the strength of the Destructive Energy that one had mastered?
See, Ling Han had mastered eight corners of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and next was Ding Shu. This sensitivity was completely proportional to this.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. By the looks of it, this treasure left behind by the Great Emperor was most likely his.
He sped up, shuttling through the stone forest. After turning left and right, he soon threw everyone off his tail.

In this place, the stone forest was densely packed, which greatly affected visibility. One couldn’t see very far at all, and the light rays they emitted had the effect of obstructing divine sense. Thus, one could throw others off their tail with a few steps.
Ling Han walked faster and faster. His position in the lead might not be secure, so he had to hurry.

He walked here and there, circled here and there. This stone forest was astonishingly huge. Furthermore, though Ling Han’s sense of that mysterious existence was slightly stronger, that was only in relative terms. There were a great many times that he still had to stop, and distinguish the direction.
Hence, his speed actually could not be considered very fast, but he was definitely ahead of the others.
Three days later, Ling Han discovered that the feeling of connection was strengthening.
Did this mean that he was already very close to the treasure that the Great Emperor had left behind?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited, and sped up.

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
It should be known that there was a relative age limit for entering into the Imperial Path.
It was not just anyone that could enter.
Thus, this old geezer looked to be quite old, and whether it was in absolute or relative terms of age, how could he possibly appear in this space?
Could it be that this was a native?
Han Yun smiled, and said, “Don’t worry, don’t worry.
I do not belong here.
I can only see everything, and cannot take anything.
Otherwise, the heavens would not spare me!”
Hiss!
What did that mean?
Could it be that he was not a native of this place, but rather an outsider?
However, he did not conform to the rules of entry into the Imperial Path for relatively young people.
Instead, he had used some unknown method to enter.
Thus, he could not break the rules, and snatch the fated opportunity from the “young people”.
“Senior, is there really a Great Emperor buried here?” Ling Han asked.
Han Yun shook his head, “There is no corpse of a Great Emperor here.
However, there really is an opportunity related to the Great Emperor here.
I just don’t know which of you would be able to obtain it.”
His words sent a wave of commotion through the masses.
As long as it was related to the Great Emperor, then no matter what kind of great opportunity it was, it was still astonishing.
“Go on, I’m also waiting for you guys to open the Imperial Path to follow youout,” Han Yun said with a smile.
“After all, I’ve deceived the damn heavens for so long.
If I break the rules again, it’s really possible that I will be struck to death.”
These words sounded frightening, because how many people were qualified to be struck to death by the heavens?
Even if he broke through to become a Saint, the heaven and earth would only cause internal demons to descend on him!
Unless he had done something unforgivable, then only would Heavenly Dao send down a lightning punishment to erase him.
Thus, a person that could be erased by Heavenly Dao must be overwhelmingly powerful.
Han Yun fell silent after saying this, and his figure became hazy again.
No one could see through him.
Even Venerate Tier elites couldn’t see through, so just how powerful was the old geezer?
A Saint?
No one dared to disturb him.
In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, Saints were naturally respected.
Who dared to disrespect them?
They circled around Han Yun, one after another, and continued onwards.
There were no mechanisms or restrictions here.
Everything was very calm, as if it was just an ordinary cave.
However, after walking for a while, the situation changed.
The resistance came again.
This resistance was not absolute, but rather differed based on cultivation level.
For example, though Brother Monkey was a Venerate Tier, he did not have an easier time compared to Ling Han.
The pressure he endured was a hundred times stronger, or even a thousand times stronger.
However, after advancing 300 meters, even someone as strong as Brother Monkey had no choice but to stop.
This resistance was already so strong that even he could not advance any further.
However, with Brother Monkey’s domineering nature, how could he be willing to stop just like that?
He gave a loud shout, and channelled the metal rod in his hand, forcibly slicing through the obstructive force, and advanced once more.
His ferocity was unreasonable, and he actually forcibly advanced another 30 meters.
However, this time, he had really reached his limit.
No matter how fast Brother Monkey brandished the metal rod, he could not advance the slightest bit further.
This made Brother Monkey cry out in anger.
He opened his mouth and bared his sharp teeth, as if he wanted to bite an invisible opponent to death.
With a thought, Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, planning to protect him and Brother Monkey as they continued to advance.
However, this time, even the Pseudo Imperial Weapon was useless.
It was not effective against the resistance at all.
Yi, then what should he do?
Ling Han hurriedly shook his hands.
Boom!
Destructive Energy surged, and the obstructive force instantly disappeared.
He couldn’t help but feel surprised.
He had only channeled the Destructive Energy in a gamble, but the effects were far better than he had imagined.
He had actually pushed back all the resistance.
Unfortunately, this Destructive Energy could only protect him.
It itself was a deadly weapon, and could not possibly protect Brother Monkey as well.
Seeing that Ling Han was advancing without any hindrance, Brother Monkey nodded, “Brother, you go first.”
Ling Han hesitated for a moment, then replied, “All right!”
No matter what he gained, he would share it with Brother Monkey.
He strode forwards, and behind him, Ding Shu, Heaven Crushing, and the others also channelled the Destructive Energy, moving freely under this resistance.
On the other hand, Myriad Dao, Origin, and the others, though they too were masters of the Genesis World, but because they had not cultivated the Destructive Energy, they could only sigh helplessly.
After walking for over ten minutes, the obstructive force suddenly disappeared.
A forest of stone pillars appeared ahead of them.
They were densely packed together, and there were indescribably many of them.
Furthermore, every single stone pillar was still glowing, and their colour varied.
Where exactly was the great opportunity that Han Yun spoke of that was related to the Great Emperor?
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly faltered.
He had a feeling that something was summoning him.
It was hard to say whether this was a human or something else.
In short, he had established a connection with him, which also provided him with a vague direction.
He looked towards Ding Shu, and the others, and saw that these four people were also looking towards the others.
By the looks of it, everyone was being summoned by that being.
A treasure left behind by a Great Emperor?
But why them?
It should be known that this tomb of the Heavenly Emperor had not even existed the last time it was opened.
This was proven by Yang Yihuan and the others.
Then, from this deduction, it was very possible that this so-called Heavenly Emperor was referring to the previous Great Emperor.
Who was this Great Emperor?
There were no historical records, and they only knew that there was indeed such an existence.
The problem was, what relation did this Great Emperor have with the Destructive Energy?
What did this have to do with the Genesis World?
If it was unrelated, then why was it that only the Genesis World’s Masters could cultivate Destructive Energy, and only they could walk here?
If they found the treasures left behind by this Great Emperor, would they be able to unravel all the secrets?
Everyone moved, heading towards the depths of the stone forest.
After walking for a while, they gradually stopped.
That was because that kind of feeling was intermittent, and incredibly weak.
During this process, Ling Han discovered that everyone’s perception of that unknown existence was different.
He should be the strongest, because that connection had not been severed all this while, and the next strongest was Ding Shu.
Was this determined by the strength of the Destructive Energy that one had mastered?
See, Ling Han had mastered eight corners of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and next was Ding Shu.
This sensitivity was completely proportional to this.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face.
By the looks of it, this treasure left behind by the Great Emperor was most likely his.
He sped up, shuttling through the stone forest.
After turning left and right, he soon threw everyone off his tail.
In this place, the stone forest was densely packed, which greatly affected visibility.
One couldn’t see very far at all, and the light rays they emitted had the effect of obstructing divine sense.
Thus, one could throw others off their tail with a few steps.
Ling Han walked faster and faster.
His position in the lead might not be secure, so he had to hurry.
He walked here and there, circled here and there.
This stone forest was astonishingly huge.
Furthermore, though Ling Han’s sense of that mysterious existence was slightly stronger, that was only in relative terms.
There were a great many times that he still had to stop, and distinguish the direction.
Hence, his speed actually could not be considered very fast, but he was definitely ahead of the others.
Three days later, Ling Han discovered that the feeling of connection was strengthening.
Did this mean that he was already very close to the treasure that the Great Emperor had left behind?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited, and sped up.
After about half a day, he walked out of the stone forest.
In front of him stood a massive stone tablet.

chapters.title: Chapter 4489: Complete Destructive Energy
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han swept his gaze over the surroundings, and only then did he discover that he hadn’t actually walked out of the stone forest. The only reason for this misconception was because the area around the stone tablet had become empty.
In truth, he was still inside the stone forest, but in some unknown corner.
This stone tablet was extraordinary?
Ling Han walked over. His eyes swept over the surroundings, and his heart suddenly beat wildly.
This was actually the ninth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram!

It should be known that the eight corners of the Spirit Diagram had been written on some unknown beast hide, but now? The ninth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram had been inscribed on the stone tablet!
No wonder he felt a resonance. So that was the case.
Hiss, could it be that the Destructive Energy was created by the Great Emperor of the last era?
This was too shocking.
Destructive Energy had surpassed nine stars, and even the Great Emperors of the past had never come into contact with it before.
No wonder this place could be called the tomb of the Heavenly Emperor. The previous Great Emperor was indeed awesome, stunning all eternity!
The problem was, what did this have to do with him?
There was definitely a link between the Genesis World and the Great Emperor of the last era, but what exactly was it?
Ling Han was curious, but he couldn’t figure it out.

However, he immediately pushed this question back into his mind. The most important thing now was not to know the reason, but rather to cultivate this ninth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, reaching consummate level.
He immediately began to read.

Weng, the millions and millions of dimensions in his body immediately vibrated as well, as if they were resonating, but also seemed to be cheering. Something that he clearly could not understand was forcefully absorbed by him, and he actually knew what to do.
This feeling was really strange.
However, he had already experienced it eight times, so it didn’t matter if he experienced it again.
In just half a day, Ling Han had already mastered this ninth corner of the Spirit Diagram.
Hong, Destructive Energy surged, burning all over Ling Han’s body. Energy that was even denser than darkness exuded an indescribable pressure.
Kuang!
A sudden clap of thunder rang out in the heaven and earth. Endless tribulation clouds appeared above Ling Han’s head, layering on top of each other.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his scalp go numb. Previously, the heaven’s calamity had only caused an internal demon to descend, but now, it seemed like there really was divine lightning that was about to strike down.
This was no joke.
If Heavenly Dao was going to kill, even a Saint’s only path would be death.
The problem was that Heavenly Dao had its own rules to play by, so it definitely couldn’t act recklessly—unless one did something super great that destroyed the Regulations of heaven and earth.
‘I’ve only mastered the complete Destructive Energy. Is there any need for you to be so furious?’
Er, Destructive Energy was really no joke. This was an existence that surpassed all high-level energies!
However, he was actually going to be struck by lightning?
This was too much, wasn’t it!
Kuang, a bolt of lightning struck down, indescribably fast.
So what if it was Ling Han? He was completely unable to dodge.
This was comparable to the attack of a Saint, or perhaps even stronger!
However, Ling Han discovered that he wasn’t injured at all.
Yi, Heavenly Dao would also mess around with people, playing around?
Kuang, kuang, kuang! One bolt of lightning followed another, striking madly at Ling Han.
No, it wasn’t just Ling Han. Even the stone tablet was targeted, forcibly disintegrating and vanishing without a trace.
Ling Han was curious. Why was it that when it struck a rock, the rock would suffer a destructive blow, but when it struck him, he was completely unscathed?
Furthermore, wasn’t Imperial Path formed by heaven and earth? Since you don’t want others to cultivate Destructive Energy, why have you left it here?
It had established the tomb of the Heavenly Emperor, and now it was sending down a heaven’s calamity to destroy it. Wasn’t that an unnecessary action?
Hong, hong, hong! The divine lightning struck madly. It came and went quickly, and in less than two minutes, the lightning had stopped striking down, and the thunderclouds had also dispersed.
Er, was it just destroying the stone tablet to destroy evidence?
Ling Han looked inside himself. After being struck so many times by the heaven’s calamity, though he was unscathed, he kept feeling that something was strange.
This investigation gave him a shock, and his expression also became strange.
He really hadn’t suffered any injuries, but it didn’t mean that nothing had changed.
That was because on the fruit of cultivation in his mind, there shockingly appeared multiple black chains.
F***, what the hell was this?
Ling Han waved his hands and feet, and a terrifying power surged. Regulations surged, and his battle prowess was not affected in the slightest.
Yi, what exactly was the use of these black chains?
This was caused by the heaven’s calamity striking him. Ling Han didn’t think that it was just for show.
“It must have some use that I don’t know about. It’s just that it hasn’t been shown yet.”
“However, the Heavenly Dao was angered because of this, and sent down lightning to strike me. From this, it is clear that this should not be anything good, right?”
Ling Han rubbed his nose. Cultivating Destructive Energy to its full state was a great thing, but it also seemed to have planted a hidden danger for him.
“Whatever, I’ll cross that bridge when I get there. It’s useless even if I think about it now.”
He stood up, and just as he was about to leave, he felt the ground beneath his feet tremble loudly.
What was going on?
With a loud bang, the whole space cracked open. Ling Han was instantly swept out by an irresistible force, and in this process, he even saw others.
For example, Ding Shu, Brother Monkey, the Golden Generation, and even Song Lan, who had stayed in North Prosperity City.
Could it be that Imperial Path had already ended?

Ling Han saw that Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and Feng Miaoling all looked confused. From this, it could be seen that Imperial Path definitely did not end here in the past, but now, some kind of change had taken place, and it had come to an abrupt stop.
Space split apart again, and everyone fell out, one after another.
This place... was the Same Moon Planet.
That massive stone door was slowly closing. It was too eye-catching, and no one would be able to see wrongly.
All of a sudden, the Saints and Venerate Tiers that had stayed behind all moved, searching for their descendants and heirs.
Now that he was here, Ling Han could control the ley lines again. He used the Earth Qi as his eyes and ears, and after sensing for a while, he discovered that the Nine Mountains Saint wasn’t here.
True, the old man didn’t know that he had entered the Imperial Path from the Netherworld. This passageway was too hidden, and there should be very few people who knew about it.
Hence, it was really normal that the old man did not wait for him here.

“Ling Han!” An earth-shattering voice rang out. A Saint flew into a rage, and directly turned into a giant that was millions and millions of meters tall. His head was the size of a planet, and looked directly at Ling Han.
“Damn it!” Another Saint manifested a projection, which also transformed into an indomitable giant.

There was also a third, a fourth, and one after another, the Saints used their great power to turn into beings millions and millions of meters tall. In this way, no matter which corner of Same Moon Planet Ling Han was hiding in, they would be able to kill him with a light grab.

These were all Saints of the Imperial Clans. They had already found out through the divine sense transmission of their Imperial Sons that Ling Han had killed a few more Imperial Sons. Furthermore, his freakishness was enough to threaten the Golden Generation.
This boy definitely could not be allowed to live!
Boom! A Saint was far too domineering, and they didn’t even give Ling Han a chance to defend himself. A large hand descended from the sky, slamming down at Ling Han.

When the Saint moved, the Venerate Tier could only dodge. Furthermore, he had to tear a rip into space and flee at the first instant. If he was slightly slower, the Void would also be implicated, and he would still die.
The Saint was the embodiment of the Regulations of heaven and earth. He was indescribably powerful.
Ling Han was only a Three Star Sect Master, and didn’t even have the chance to dodge.
He delivered a palm strike, and the entire Same Moon Planet trembled violently. One third of the planet caved in.

chapters.title: Chapter 4490: Deception
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Had Ling Han died?
He had definitely died. A Saint had moved, and directly hit him. If he still did not die, what justice was there left in this world?
This scene caused a great many Imperial Sons, including Ding Shu, Yang Yihuan and the others, to be extremely surprised.
That incredibly freakish prodigy, who was aiming straight for the throne, actually died just like that?
So calm? Such a worthless death? So simple?
But upon further thought, a Saint had already moved, so what Sect Master would be spared?

However, they were still slightly unable to accept this. On their way here, Ling Han had created far too many miracles. Thus, even though it was a Saint that had done this, they still felt a little uncertain.
They wanted to search for Ling Han’s corpse for further confirmation.

But with a single strike from a Saint, everything was shattered, and only the powerful martial intent of the Saint was boiling. Even if Ling Han had left behind slivers of his remnant soul, they would still be completely destroyed by the martial intent of the Saint.
Why did he have to kill so thoroughly? Couldn’t he leave behind some remnant soul to extract Ling Han’s memories?
In that case, it would be clear why Ling Han was so powerful.
But when they saw who the Saint that had moved was, everyone understood why he had done so.
That was the Fire Leaving Saint of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan.

—The Golden Generation of their clan had died, the Silver Generation had died, and the ordinary Imperial Sons had died even earlier. It could be said that there was completely no possibility for their clan to produce another Great Emperor.

Thus, since they could not produce an Emperor, they naturally did not want the other Imperial Clans to take advantage of them either. They would directly kill Ling Han, and destroy everyone’s hopes of obtaining the secret to Ling Han’s strength.
‘Holy f*ck!’
A great many Saints were cursing internally. With how murderous they were, it was naturally necessary for them to kill Ling Han, but at the same time, they too wanted to obtain Ling Han’s secret.
However, this didn’t matter.
Aside from Ling Han, there was also Ding Shu, Yang Yihuan, and the others.
“You guys—” These Saints looked towards Ding Shu, and the others, their eyes baleful and menacing.
“Hehe, what do you guys want to do?” One after another, Saints appeared, similarly turning into giants that were millions and millions of meters tall, protecting Ding Shu, Yang Yihuan and the others.

“If you don’t want your clan to be exterminated, you had best behave,” the old Saint who had escorted He Luo over said. The blood parasol above his head trembled slightly, exuding an incredibly terrifying aura.
“Let’s go.”
These Saints tore a rip into space, one after another, and left with Ding Shu and the others.

“Hey, give me back my brother’s life!” Brother Monkey shouted loudly. His right hand held the Saint-level metal rod, while his left hand held the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. His face was filled with fury.
He was completely unafraid of the Saint, and directly charged over.
None of the Saints made a move. Instead, they dodged.

“For the sake of the Battle Saint Emperor, I won’t lower myself to your level.” These Saints tore open space one after another, then grabbed their juniors and left. They didn’t seize even the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon.

For the sake of the Battle Saint Emperor, the so-called reason was only superficial. The real reason was naturally fearing that the Battle Saint Emperor had not died. Then, if his only descendant, Brother Monkey was killed, wouldn’t the Battle Saint Emperor go crazy?

In the past, this Great Emperor was renowned for his toughness and ferocity. He had a hot-tempered personality, and if he could resolve things through battle, he would definitely not waste time on words.
Though innumerable years had passed since the era of the Battle Saint Emperor, the Great Emperor had gone to the edge of the universe to seek immortality, and no one knew whether he had died or not.
That was the Great Emperor! He had ruled a whole era, and he was so powerful that even Saints couldn’t imagine it. It was extremely likely that he could perform a miracle!
Thus, even if there was only a sliver of a chance, these Saints would not dare to do anything to Brother Monkey.
Brother Monkey did not pursue. Instead, he immediately calmed down.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in his hands was naturally given to him by Ling Han. He didn’t flip out at the first instant because he received Ling Han’s divine sense transmission.

Xiu, he streaked through the universe, and very soon, grabbed a broken piece of stone. This was a piece of the same planet that had been shattered by the Fire Leaving Saint. He immediately put it away, then tore a rip into space and quickly left.
After traveling through a considerable number of galaxies, Brother Monkey finally stopped.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure appeared.
Previously, he had shrunk his body and adhered it to that rock.

—Before the Saint had made his move, Ling Han had already done a few things, because he knew that he had killed a great many Imperial Sons. The moment he exited the Imperial Path, he would be bombarded by the Saints of the Imperial Clans.
Firstly, he handed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower over to Brother Monkey, and quickly related his thoughts through divine sense.
Secondly, he channelled the Purple Calamity Grains in his body, forming a protective layer.

In this manner, the Saint’s attack was completely dispersed by the Purple Calamity Grains. Meanwhile, Ling Han took advantage of the opening to shrink his body, and attach himself onto a rock. With the shockwave created the remaining power of the Saint’s attack, he rushed into space.
He tried his best to suppress his life force, and added with the fact that the martial intent of a Saint was spreading everywhere in space, there was no way to detect his aura at all.
Hence, going by his inherent thinking, if he was struck by the Saint’s attack, he would definitely be deader than dead, and not even his soul fragment would be found.

chapters.title: Chapter 4491: Gloomy Chen Fengyan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Chen Fengyan was presently a Sect Master. Even if he had just broken through not too long ago, he could still be considered a great elite.
Yet now, two strangers had appeared soundlessly in front of him. Just how terrifying was this?
And there were two of them at that!
He did not say another word, and moved directly. As the saying goes, the one to make the first move wins.
“Brat Yan, are you disrespecting your elders?” Brother Monkey said with a humph. He reached over and grabbed Chen Fengyan’s wrist, rendering him immobile.
Yi?
Chen Fengyan was instantly startled. There was only one person in this world who would call him brat Yan.
“Uncle, Uncle Monkey?” He looked at Brother Monkey, both shocked and delighted.
“It is your Grandpa Sun!” Brother Monkey nodded.
Chen Fengyan couldn’t help but curse in his mind. ‘You’re my uncle, not my grandfather!’
Brother Monkey’s catchphrase was very aggravating.
“And this is?” Chen Fengyan looked towards Ling Han. He could sense that the aura that was vaguely exuding from Ling Han was also the aura of a Sect Master, and was even stronger than him.
Thus, even in his wildest dreams, he would not link this to Ling Han.
What a joke, it was absolutely impossible, all right?
“This is your Uncle Ling!” Brother Monkey said with a glare. His teeth bared, revealing his ferocious nature.
Ling, Uncle Ling?
Chen Fengyan was confused. Why was there another uncle?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Brat Yan, you have forgotten me so quickly?”
This voice... was Ling Han!
Chen Fengyan was instantly dumbfounded, his mouth wide open. How was this possible?
He could think of anyone, but definitely wouldn’t think of Ling Han.
At that time, he was already a Spirit Transformation True Lord, but what about Ling Han? He hadn’t even stepped into Celestial Path, and the gap between them could be said to be endless.

Now, he had advanced into Sect Master-level. In terms of time, it was already very fast, less than a hundred years, but in comparison, Ling Han had taken six consecutive steps on the Celestial Path. Wasn’t that a joke?
He could already be considered a prodigy, then what was Ling Han?
Pa!
Brother Monkey gave Chen Fengyan a smack on the back of the head, and said, “What are you standing there for? Hurry up and greet him. Don’t you know how to respect seniority?”

Chen Fengyan was extremely depressed. At first, he had thought that after he had advanced into the level of Sect Master, he could be awesome for a while. Who would have thought that Brother Monkey had also advanced further, and was still completely suppressing him? Furthermore, Ling Han had also advanced to the level of being his equal.
Even if he had experienced great ups and downs in his life, his heart was still slightly unable to accept it.
“Are you really Ling Han?” he asked.
“As true as I can be,” Ling Han said with a nod and a smile.

He could understand Chen Fengyan’s astonishment. According to the cultivation progress of most people, even if they could advance to the level of Sect Master, they would all be in their twilight years. Meanwhile, those like Chen Fengyan were definitely prodigies who had broken through in their prime.
But compared to him, that was practically the speed of a snail.
It could not be helped. Who was Ling Han competing with?
The Golden Generation, as well as Yang Yihuan, and other old prodigies from who knew how many years ago, as well as the Genesis World’s rulers!
This forced him to only have the choice of advancing bravely, and he could not stop for even a moment.
“Are you really a Sect Master?” Chen Fengyan asked dumbly.
Actually, he could sense Ling Han’s aura, but it was really too shocking. He had to confirm it again.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded again.

Chen Fengyan sighed and said, “I cultivated for so many years before finally breaking through to the level of Sect Master. You haven’t even reached the level of 100 years, and you’re already on par with me!”
This was really a blow to his pride.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Wrong. We’re not neck and neck. I’m a Three Star Sect Master. I’m more powerful than you.”
Pu!
Chen Fengyan felt as if his heart had been stabbed a few more times, causing him to feel even worse.
Is it really good for you to bully me like this?
“Hahaha!” Brother Monkey laughed loudly, then said, “Brat Yan, is there anything that you need Old Sun’s help for?”

“Not for the moment,” Chen Fengyan said with a shake of his head. “I’m still accumulating power. When the time is ripe, I’ll lead the Celestial Sea Planet to become independent and rebuild the Chen Clan’s Majestic Empire!”
“Alright.” Brother Monkey nodded, and said to Ling Han, “Brother, let’s go.”
“Uncle Monkey!” Chen Fengyan hurriedly shouted. “You’re leaving just like that?”
“What else?” Brother Monkey turned around and asked. He was the most straightforward in his actions, and hated being sloppy.

“Can’t you be a little more polite?” Chen Fengyan asked in frustration. This Uncle Monkey was far too straightforward. Thankfully, he hadn’t been pretending to be polite just then. Otherwise, he would have definitely been angered to death.
Brother Monkey rolled his eyes, and directly strode away.
Ling Han didn’t leave. Instead, he asked with a serious expression, “How are my descendants and friends?”

“Very good,” Chen Fengyan said with a nod. He didn’t put on any airs. Firstly, Ling Han was his senior, so he had to admit this fact no matter what. Secondly, Ling Han’s cultivation level was actually higher than his, so he also had to maintain his respect for him.
“However, your daughter and son-in-law seem to have left Celestial Sea Planet and gone to some academy on Moonlight Planet,” he added.
Yi, Ling Xi had gone to the Moonlight Planet?

The current Moonlight Planet was no longer the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s territory, but a subsidiary planet under the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s rule. However, it was once the center of a Majestic Empire, after all, so the Moonlight Planet’s martial arts level was still one of the top few in the nearby galaxies.
It was normal for Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing to go to the Moonlight Planet to cultivate martial arts. After all, the cultivation conditions there were definitely much better than here.
Ling Han nodded before waving at Chen Fengyan and leaving.
Chen Fengyan: “...”
‘Are you guys here just to strike a blow to my pride?’

‘It wasn’t easy for me to advance to the rank of Sect Master, and I thought that I would be able to show off my potential. Now, however, Brother Monkey has advanced to the rank of Venerate Tier, and he’s still superior to me. Moreover, Ling Han is even more exaggerated. He has surpassed him, though he had a late start, and he’s now a Three Star Sect Master.
He was a negative example of failure!
This was too sad.

Ling Han first returned to his hometown to visit his old friends that he had brought out of the Genesis World. Meanwhile, descendants like Ling Jianxue and others had stayed on Celestial Sea Planet. With Chen Fengyan taking care of them, he was very at ease.
Seeing Ling Han return, everyone in the Ling Clan, including Karmic Life Heavenly Venerable, Heavenly Venerate Wu Le and so on, were all overjoyed.
Ling Han introduced Brother Monkey to everyone, and briefly related his experiences over the years.

Then, he took out a large amount of alchemical pills and natural treasures, and distributed them to everyone. For him, this was already completely useless, but for Ling Jianxue and the others, it was incredibly precious.

—The fact that these people could come to the new world meant that they had at least cultivated to First Tier Heavenly Venerate in the Genesis World. They had already proven their talent. Thus, after coming to the new world, their cultivation progress was also very rapid.
The one who had improved the fastest was Ji Wuming, and he was already in Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, in the past, Ji Wuming was still Ling Han’s strongest competitor, and now this gap was already extremely wide.
Ling Han made some queries. Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing entered the Silver Moon Academy on Moonlight Planet. They had only gone there three years ago.
His daughter was dear to him, so Ling Han decided go alone to visit his daughter on Moonlight Planet. He would then plan his next course of action.

chapters.title: Chapter 4492: Silver Moon Academy
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
There was naturally no need for Brother Monkey to accompany him to visit his daughter.
Ling Han tore open a rip into the Void, and headed towards the Moonlight Planet. After reaching the level of Sect Master, he possessed the ability to tear open the Void.
However, he discovered that this was not as fast as Transfer Formation.
It couldn’t be helped. He was only a Sect Master. After reaching the Venerate Tier, his speed of traversing through the Void would definitely be faster than the Transfer Formation.
However, he had already entered into the Void, so he couldn’t retreat. If he came out halfway, it would be even more impossible. How could there be a Transfer Formation for him to use?
Thus, after spending half a month’s time, Ling Han finally arrived at Moonlight Planet.
Things had changed.
Ling Han stood in front of a large city, raising his eyes to look at the city wall. A strong feeling of emotion rose up in his heart.
The first time he came here, he hadn’t even stepped into Celestial Path, but now? He was already Sect Master-level, enough to sweep aside all opposition in the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.

—This Majestic Empire didn’t have a Venerate Tier elite on standby. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have gone to so much trouble to draw out the old Venerate Tier elite from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire with formations and killing weapons.
Even so, the Venerate Tier elite still managed to escape, leaving a hidden danger.
In the blink of an eye, almost a hundred years had passed. Ordinary people should have almost forgotten about the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
Ling Han sighed ruefully for a while, and then entered into the city.
He naturally changed his appearance, and even retracted his aura. With the help of the Soul Forming Technique, even Venerate Tier elites might not be able to recognize him.
What more when it was this kind of remote little planet, where not many people might know who he was.
Ling Han asked around for the location of the Silver Moon Academy, then used the Star Steps. When he reappeared, he had already arrived in another city.
He slowed down. He was only going to visit his daughter. There was no need for him to engage in battle.
As he strolled, he arrived at the Silver Moon Academy.
Yi, there were so many people.
He was just about to ask, when he was forced forward by the people behind him.
“Hurry up, hurry up, the registration deadline is today, hurry up!” The people behind shouted as they pushed and shoved.
The registration was over?
Ling Han followed the crowd and entered the academy.

As it turned out, the Silver Moon Academy was recruiting students recently, and today was the deadline. Thus, those who had come from far away were naturally anxious. No matter what, they had to first register themselves, and as for whether they could pass or not, that would be a matter for the future.
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and he couldn’t help but smile. Fine, then he would “test” himself into the academy and be classmates with his daughter for a few days.
He obediently followed the others to register. In terms of information, he naturally filled in the words “Han Lin”.

Cultivators were cultivators, after all. If they couldn’t even endure this little bit of hardship, then what was the point of cultivating?

The academy recruited disciples based on natural talent and character.
If one’s natural talent in martial arts was inferior, that would be a waste of resources and time, and if one’s character was inferior, that would be nurturing a future disaster.

However, it was very difficult to judge one’s character with one’s eyes. Furthermore, one could also disguise one’s character. As the saying goes, time reveals one’s true character. It was definitely not something that could be determined in a few days.
“I heard that the quota for recruitment this time is extremely limited, only a hundred.”
“Only a hundred?”
“Sigh, then I definitely have no chance!”
Those who were well-informed were whispering the information they had found out, which caused a heated discussion.
However, no one gave up.
They had come filled with hope, so it was naturally impossible that they would run away with their tails between their legs without even competing.
And what if?

“What, even these people are here?”
“Hey, hey, hey. Why are they joining us? Shouldn’t they have been specially recruited by the academy?”

“Hehe, I heard that it was Ding Liang that insisted on participating in the fair selection to prove his own strength. With his actions, Yi Zimo and Fang Feibai also gave up the spots for special recruitment, and insisted on participating in the selection together.”

Ding Liang, Yi Zimo, and Fang Feibai had all become seeded competitors without any doubt, and would definitely not be assigned to the same area. Furthermore, there were also some other young prodigies that were well-known, and they were evenly distributed among the divisions.

After others were announced to be in the same division as Ding Liang and the others, they all wore distressed expressions. This meant that there would be one less spot for them to enter directly into the academy.
It wasn’t long before everyone finished splitting up.

“Hehe, I, Qian Bing, have reserved a place!” A young man laughed loudly.
“Qian Bing?”
“Who is it?”
“Ah, it seems to be a very famous prodigy from Pu’an Town.”
“He’s just from a small town, so what’s so impressive about him!”
Everyone was discussing spiritedly, and Qian Bing was proud. He provoked everyone, and said, “If anyone is dissatisfied, I will beat him into submission now!”
“I’m not convinced!” Immediately, someone rushed up, but Qian Bing only used one move, and that person was knocked down onto the ground.
Hiss, everyone was stunned. Whether this was an elite or not, they would know once they made their move.
This Qian Bing could not be underestimated.

Seeing that he had intimidated everyone, Qian Bing couldn’t help but feel proud of himself. Previously, he had been hiding all this while, and that was why he had gained some fame. His aim was to amaze the world with a single feat. Otherwise, he was sure that his fame would definitely not be inferior to Yi Zimo and the others.
‘Hmm?’
He looked towards Ling Han, and saw that this person was completely unperturbed, as if he had not taken that stunning feat from him to heart at all.

Qian Bing was instantly displeased, but before he could fly into a rage, the teachers of the Academy came over, warning them not to make a move in private. Otherwise, they would all be disqualified from the tournament.
This caused Qian Bing to not dare to act recklessly, but the gaze he directed at Ling Han was already filled with animosity.
Everyone saw this, and all sighed ruefully for Ling Han, thinking that this was really an undeserved calamity, and Qian Bing was really too petty.
Next, it was time to test natural talent, which would be carried out division by division.

Ling Han casually dealt with this. His aptitude wasn’t too bad, nor was it too good. It was quite standard, and in Qian Bing’s case, his natural talent in martial arts was actually the highest grade of A!
Of course, this was only the judgement standard of the Silver Moon Academy. If it was Ling Han, this kind of aptitude would just barely qualify him to enter Spirit Transformation True Lord-level.
After Qian Bing’s test was over, he showed Ling Han an arrogant smile.
“Humph!”
