chapters.title: Chapter 4493: It’s raining, so it is time to spank the child
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han merely smiled faintly. With his present height, would he take a minor cultivator that had just stepped into Celestial Path to heart?
If he was displeased, he could just crush him to death with a single finger.

After the first round of the test, everyone was given a mark. Qian Bing took first place, while Ling Han was stuck in the twenties. If he was not careful, he would be eliminated, but if he improved any further, he would be able to pass.
The second test was comprehension.
The teacher from the academy was teaching a sword technique on the spot. Whoever could accurately repeat the performance would be able to pass, so the shorter the time, the better.

With Ling Han’s strength and comprehension ability, he could use this kind of sword technique after seeing it once. However, he didn’t want to show off, and only deduced his path of martial arts in his mind.
In a short while, Qian Bing stepped forward to practice. Though there was a slight error, he still passed the test.
He was extremely pleased with himself. He had gotten first place in two consecutive rounds, so he should be the undisputed number one in this division.
When he looked at Ling Han again, a cold smile curled up the corners of his lips. Whether Ling Han would be chosen by the academy or not, he would make him suffer greatly.
The second, the third... people gradually learnt the sword technique, and passed.
When about twenty people had passed the test, Ling Han also walked forwards. Using his foot to raise his sword, he very casually cast the sword technique.
This naturally meant that he had successfully passed the test.
He did it casually, but that teacher from the Academy was shocked.

That was because he discovered that Ling Han’s use of this sword technique was really too proficient. He was even more proficient than he was. Furthermore, there was a small weakness in the sword technique. That was caused by his habit, and could not be changed no matter what.
The others also copied this shortcoming, and only Ling Han was an exception. He had corrected this shortcoming.
Yi?
Was this a coincidence, or was it that this boy’s natural talent in cultivation was astonishing, and he had taken the initiative to make up for it?
He couldn’t help but take a second look at Ling Han.
Qian Bing also discovered this, and couldn’t help but feel angry.
He was the first to pass, and he didn’t see how much attention this teacher had to him. Why would he focus his attention on an insignificant person?
Qian Bing naturally did not dare to resent the teacher of the Academy, and this debt was once again placed on Ling Han’s tab.

After two rounds, a considerable number of people were sighing. They had fallen behind the top thirty, so even if they achieved a very good result in the last round, it would be useless. They would not be able to improve their ranking at all.
The third round, and also the last round, was actual battle.
“You guys can choose your opponents, and then battle. I will grade you based on your performance,” the teacher from the academy said.
Everyone hurriedly went to form their own teams, looking for those that were evenly matched. Otherwise, they would definitely be asking for trouble.
“You!” Qian Bing pointed at Ling Han, “Be my opponent.”
This was really a good opportunity.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Sure.”
This was a rainy day, so there was nothing better to do1.
“Those who have found a good opponent can come over now and start first,” the teacher from the academy said.
“I’ll go first!” Qian Bing called out loudly, and walked out.
Ling Han was very casual as he walked out as well.
“He’s done for!”

“In the first place, this guy was only ranked around twentieth. At first, he had a chance of qualifying, but he would definitely be no match for Qian Bing. If he was horribly defeated, how many points would he get?”
“What an undeserved calamity!”
“Shh, lower your voice.”
No one was optimistic about Ling Han, because Qian Bing had already displayed his strength in the previous two tests.
“Brat, do you regret it now?” Qian Bing smirked coldly.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “If you can fight, then stop blabbering.”
W-where did you get such courage from?
Qian Bing faltered for a moment, then burst out laughing balefully, “Brat, though you are pitifully stupid, I still have to admire your courage.”
He strode towards Ling Han, raising his right hand high. He would definitely let Ling Han know what pain and regret was.
He stretched out his right palm, and delivered a harsh slap at Ling Han.
Ling Han also shot out a palm strike. It was light, and it looked like he didn’t have any power at all.
Pa! However, his palm strike arrived first even though he had acted later. It landed crisply on Qian Bing’s face.
As expected, this palm strike really did not have much power. It only caused Qian Bing to sway slightly, but it was this sway that caused Qian Bing’s attack to miss its target.
Hiss!
Those who were watching the battle were all astounded. In fact, they actually felt that it was terrifying.

If it had to be said that Ling Han possessed boundless strength, and sent Qian Bing flying with a single slap, everyone could still accept that. After all, it was because Ling Han had an advantage in cultivation level. In the cultivation world, a higher cultivation level being superior to a lower cultivation level was absolutely normal.
However, the problem was that the force behind Ling Han’s palm strike was too small. It was so small that it only caused Qian Bing to sway slightly.
What was even more terrifying was that with just a sway, Qian Bing’s attack missed its target.
Was this a coincidence?
If that wasn’t the case, then just how skilled was Ling Han’s control over his power?
Their scalps went numb. The more they thought about it, the more terrifying it was.
Meanwhile, Qian Bing was furious. This slap was completely harmless to him, but being slapped in the face in full public, how could he swallow this kind of humiliation?
“You deserve to die!” It was as if he had gone mad, as he attacked Ling Han with all his might.

However, to say nothing of the fact that he had just stepped onto the Celestial Path, even if he was also a Sect Master like Ling Han, Ling Han could still deal with him however he wanted. There was no difficulty at all, all right?
Pa! Pa! Pa!
Ling Han casually waved his palm, but the crisp sound of slaps rang out repeatedly, endlessly.

In everyone’s eyes, Ling Han was really too relaxed. It was clearly just a casual palm strike, and should have been very easy to dodge, but it was as if Qian Bing was retarded, and actually took the initiative to lean forwards.
This was too strange. While everyone was stunned by the sight, they couldn’t help but feel their hair stand on end.

Qian Bing was defiant. As he saw it, both Ling Han’s power and speed were inferior to his, but it just so happened that Ling Han seemed to possess some kind of evil technique, and he could not hit him no matter what.
Hence, he gritted his teeth tightly, and thought that as long as he could seize a chance, and successfully counterattack, Ling Han would become a piece of meat on the chopping block, at his mercy.
Unfortunately, this kind of scene would never happen.
“Alright, stop.” In the end, the teacher could no longer bear to watch, and called a halt to the battle.

Though Ling Han’s slaps were not heavy every time, they still had some weight, after all. After several dozen to several hundred palm strikes, both sides of Qian Bing’s face were already very swollen, and it was a tragic sight.
Qian Bing had no choice but to stop. He stared at Ling Han, his eyes burning with fire, as if he wanted to devour him.
Even now, he still did not think that he was weaker than Ling Han, but rather that the latter had mastered some kind of evil technique.
“Next pair,” the teacher of the Academy called out.
After spending half a day’s time, the actual combat test finally ended, and after three rounds, the top twenty of each division had also been decided.
In Ling Han’s division, Qian Bing did not manage to get first place.

The battle that he had lost to Ling Han was really too humiliating, but thankfully, it was not because he was weak, but rather because Ling Han was too strong. Thus, he was still ranked in the top five.

It was the same for Ling Han. With his performance in the last round, he managed to squeeze into the top five, and was directly selected into the academy. There was no further need for him to participate in the semi-finals.
C

chapters.title: Chapter 4494: Bullying My Daughter?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The top fifty were brought to the dormitory area of the academy by a teacher. They were all relatively good seedlings, and would be heavily nurtured in future.
Ling Han walked out slowly in the Academy, searching for his beloved daughter.
Behind him, Qian Bing followed quietly.
He was dissatisfied. Originally, he should have been first place, but now, he had not managed to amaze the world with a single brilliant feat like he had planned. Thus, he hated Ling Han very much.
He was naturally tailing Ling Han secretly because he wanted to wait for Ling Han to walk to some secluded corner, and then take advantage of the opportunity to beat Ling Han up.
Otherwise, how could he swallow this injustice?

The other’s strength was definitely not as strong as his. He was just relying on his evil arts. Thus, if he attacked from behind, he would definitely be able to make Ling Han have no time to cast his evil arts.
The academy was very big. Ling Han slightly stimulated his divine sense, and soon located Ling Xi.
A smile curled up the corners of his lips. Then, he headed in that direction.
Not long after, he arrived in front of a dense forest.
Ling Xi was here.
‘Hmm?’
He faltered slightly, and saw a figure fly past in the skies, also falling into the dense forest.
Those who could fly with their physical bodies were at least at the Core Formation Tier.
With a thought from Ling Han, he spread out his divine sense, and had a panoramic view of everything in the dense forest.
‘F*ck! Why aren’t you going in?’
Behind him, Qian Bing was scratching his head. If Ling Han entered into the dense forest, he would immediately sneak over and launch a sneak attack, giving Ling Han a harsh beating.
But now, though there were few people in the surroundings, there were still people who could see him. He had no wish to leave behind any witnesses.
—If it was only him and Ling Han, then it would only be their one-sided retelling of events.
It couldn’t be helped. He couldn’t rush Ling Han, so he could only hope in his heart that this guy would quickly enter the forest.
In the dense forest.

Ling Xi was practicing her sword techniques. She had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and it hadn’t even been a hundred years, yet she had already advanced from a mortal to the third level of the Celestial Path. The speed of her advancement could only be described as rapid.
As expected of Ling Han’s daughter!

Xiu, a figure descended. It was a man dressed in a tight-fitting suit of treasured blue, carrying a treasured sword on his back. His black hair draped over his shoulders, and the contours of his face were as if they had been sliced by a saber, appearing to be filled with heroic spirit.
When Ling Xi saw this, she immediately put away her sword, clasped her hands and said, “Senior Brother Qi.”
This man in the treasured blue outfit had the surname of Qi, and his given name was Wuwei. He was a prodigy in the Silver Moon Academy.
He looked at Ling Xi, smiled, and said, “Junior Sister is practicing her sword technique.”
Wasn’t that nonsense?
Ling Xi merely smiled faintly, and did not continue the conversation. Her meaning was very clear. If there was nothing else, you may leave.

Yet Qi Wuwei did not have that kind of awareness. He stared at Ling Xi, his eyes filled with undisguised adoration, “Junior Sister, your natural talent in cultivation is truly amazing. I remember that when you first entered into the academy, you were only a Second Cauldron, but now, you have already advanced into the level of the Core Formation Tier. This advancement is truly amazing.”
Yet Ling Xi looked impatient, “If there is nothing else, Senior Brother Qi, then I have to concentrate on my sword training!”

Qi Wuwei didn’t show any displeasure even though he had been given a cold shoulder. He was naturally aware of Ling Xi’s personality. He smiled slightly, and said, “Junior Sister, have you considered the matter I told you about last time?”

Killing intent instantly appeared in Ling Xi’s beautiful eyes. She had always been gentle and kind to others, but if anyone thought that she really did not have a temper, that would be a great mistake.
Because she was Ling Han’s daughter!

“Senior Brother Qi, I’ve already explained everything clearly to you last time. Very clearly!” Her attitude turned cold. “I’m a married woman. Please watch your words and conduct yourself with honour, Senior Brother Qi!”
“Junior Sister, I really like you!” Qi Wuwei hurriedly said. “I don’t mind that you’re already married. Really, I don’t mind at all!”
With how beautiful she was, and how astonishing her natural talent in cultivation was, he naturally wouldn’t mind.
“I mind!” Ling Xi said coldly, “Now, you can leave!”
She didn’t say scram, so she was already being polite enough.
Qi Wuwei also showed a cold expression. After being repeatedly rejected, he had already lost his patience.

“Ling Xi, don’t be ungrateful!” he said balefully. “Who am I? The son of Great General Hengtian, Qi Longtu, under the Ninth King, stationed on Moonlight Planet of Shadow Moon Majestic Empire! The fact that I favor you is something that is due to the fortune that your ancestors have accumulated over eight lifetimes!”
“Get lost!” Ling Xi pointed outside the dense forest. She was also completely enraged.

“Humph, if you still don’t obey me this time, I’ll kill your man!” Qi Wuwei said. “He’s nothing but a Core Formation Tier cultivator. With the strength of our General’s Residence, it’ll be as easy as blowing off dust!”
“You!” Ling Xi was both furious and irritated. She had not thought that Qi Wuwei would actually use such a shameless underhanded move.
“How about it?” Qi Wuwei didn’t want to use this move either. This way, he would only be able to obtain Ling Xi’s body and temporary obedience, and he was greedy, so he wanted even more.
However, if he couldn’t obtain even her body, how could he obtain her heart?
Ling Xi remained silent. She naturally couldn’t agree. However, what could be done to help her and Fu Tianxing successfully escape from the Moonlight Planet?
“You don’t have much time, and my patience is also limited,” Qi Wuwei pressed further.
“Hehe, I have not managed to accumulate such good fortune in these seven lifetimes!” Ling Han moved, and had already appeared in the dense forest, as he said calmly.
Yi?
Qian Bing was stunned. Why had Ling Han disappeared?
He hurriedly set off in pursuit, arriving at the edge of the dense forest. Then, he carefully entered.
And in the dense forest, after hearing Ling Han’s voice, Ling Xi immediately looked excited.
How could she not recognize her father’s voice?
Now was the time when she was the most helpless, but her father appeared at the right time, making her feel warm and instantly have someone to lean on.
All this while, she had been filled with confidence in her father. As long as Ling Han appeared, there was nothing that could not be resolved!
This was the truth, and also a daughter’s admiration for her father.
“Who are you?” Qi Wuwei was taken aback. Why had someone suddenly barged in?
Seven lifetimes?
‘You’re not Ling Xi’s senior, are you? Oh, he said eight lifetimes just now, and now you’ve subtracted one generation?’
He said impatiently, “Before I lose my temper, get lost immediately!”
However, the scene that followed caused his face to turn livid.
Ling Xi pounced out like birds flying into the forest, falling into Ling Han’s arms, still hugging him tightly.
Qi Wuwei flew into a thunderous rage, and felt an indescribable disappointment.

He had always thought that Ling Xi was a chaste woman. No matter how much he tempted her, she would not fall for him at all. But now? She was actually throwing herself into the arms of an unfamiliar man!
This was definitely not Fu Tianxing!
F***, so you are this kind of slut. You actually still dare to pretend to be aloof in front of him. How shameless.
Ling Han patted his daughter’s shoulder before turning to Qi Wuwei and saying, “Commit suicide!”
To actually dare threaten his daughter, that was naturally a suicidal action.
At this time, Qian Bing had also sneaked in. He looked over through the closely packed leaves, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
That was Qi Wuwei! How could he not recognize him? He was a true prodigy!
Ling Han... actually dared to oppose Qi Wuwei?

chapters.title: Chapter 4495: Calling me a hero
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Qi Wuwei couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
“Where does your confidence come from?” He shook his head, “Do you know who I am?”
“You’re a corpse,” Ling Han said calmly. “No matter who you were when you were alive, you’re a corpse after death. No one will care who you are!”

“Impudence!” Qi Wuwei humphed. Looking at the clothes that Ling Han was wearing, he came to a sudden realization, and said, “I know. Today is the day that the academy is recruiting new students, and you’re not wearing the same attire, which means that you’ve just entered the academy.”
He came to his senses. No wonder Ling Han was so arrogant, and did not take him seriously at all. As it turned out, he was a pure rookie.
However, this made him even angrier.
He was clearly just a rookie, yet Ling Xi Xi had thrown herself into his arms. In comparison, what was he worth? He couldn’t even compare to a rookie?
How could he not explode in fury?
‘You b*tch, even if you want to find a man, you should find someone higher-level!’
“You’re truly seeking death!” Qi Wuwei said balefully, his killing intent intertwining.
As he spoke, he even glanced in Qian Bing’s direction. Did he think that he had not noticed?
How naive!

This glance caused Qian Bing’s heart to beat wildly. Though he was conceited, he had self-awareness. There was absolutely no way he could compare to Qi Wuwei, whether it was in terms of himself or his background.
It was clear that he thought that he was allies with Ling Han.
He had been wronged. If he was killed by Qi Wuwei because of this, he would really not be able to rest in peace even if he died.
However, being swept by the eyes of a Core Formation Tier cultivator, his heart shivered, and he couldn’t move a single finger, let alone turn around and flee.
Oh no, he was done for, he screamed in his heart.
At first, he had only wanted to teach Ling Han a lesson, but now? It seemed like he was about to suffer great misfortune.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “You’re not going to choose, right? Then I can only help you make your decision.”
“You’re seeking death!” Qi Wuwei roared as he charged at Ling Han. He launched a palm strike, not minding killing Ling Han at all. With his background, he could easily deal with the aftermath.
Boom, he sent out a palm strike, and the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier was unleashed.
Ling Han extended a finger, and with a light flick, peng, a force instantly pierced through Qi Wuwei’s forehead, penetrating out from behind, bringing with it a fountain of blood.
Qi Wuwei’s eyes widened. He could not believe it at all. He was actually no match for Ling Han.
A mere new student, you are just a new student!
With this kind of unwillingness, he collapsed loudly, his vitality completely extinguished.
‘F*ck!’
Not far away, Qian Bing was almost scared out of his wits.
What had he seen?
Qi Wuwei had actually been killed in a single move by Ling Han!
Gods, what abilities did this guy have that a Core Formation Tier couldn’t even withstand a single blow from him?
Furthermore, he was done for!
Qi Wuwei had died, so he should have been happy. He wouldn’t be dragged into this mess, but would Ling Han spare him?
He would definitely be killed to keep the secret.
Yet Ling Han did not take Qi Wuwei to heart at all. He smiled brightly at Ling Xi and asked, “Have you suffered any grievances?”

“I’m fine.” Ling Xi shook her head. Since she and Fu Tianxing came out to roam the world, they were prepared to face difficulties. However, Qi Wuwei was too despicable, so she didn’t know how to deal with him at this moment.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han patted his daughter’s shoulder. It had to be said that he was prejudiced. Among all his children, he doted on this daughter the most.
“En.” Ling Xi nodded.
The father and daughter duo strode off, neither taking Qi Wuwei’s death seriously, and simply allowed the other’s corpse to lie there.
After a long while, Qian Bing finally collapsed onto the ground.
“I, I’m actually still alive?” He breathed heavily, feeling that his whole body was completely drenched.
How could Ling Han not have discovered him?
Impossible!
Even Qi Wuwei had discovered traces of him, so how could Ling Han, who was even stronger than Qi Wuwei, not have noticed?
Yet the other had not killed him. This was blatant contempt.
At first, Qian Bing was still feeling a little fortunate, but now, his expression was twisted.
He was completely ignored.
This kind of disregard was the greatest humiliation to him. The other party did not mind his existence at all, and disdained from killing him to keep him quiet.
“Damn it! Damn it!” He clenched his fists, the veins on his neck popping, “You will definitely regret this! Not killing me is the greatest mistake of your life!”
He strode toward where the higher-ups of the academy were.
He was going to tell on him. Humph, if he killed Qi Wuwei, could it be that he could stay out of it and just leave?
‘Die.’
“Father, is it all right?” After walking for a while, Ling Xi suddenly asked.
“It’s fine.” Ling Han shook his head.
“What if the Qi Clan comes looking for us?” she asked again.

“Then I’ll kill them all,” Ling Han said calmly. “The reason why that criminal dared to threaten you is because of his background. So be it if I didn’t take the initiative to seek them out for an accounting. If they continue to pester me, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
How protective he was of his own people, and this was more so his beloved daughter. Now, someone was using underhanded means to coerce his beloved daughter, so how could he not be furious?
However, he wasn’t a god of death, after all, so he wouldn’t do such a thing. However, if the Qi Clan insisted on not knowing what was good for them, that would be exactly what he wanted.

When they returned to Ling Xi’s quarters, Fu Tianxing just happened to walk out. Seeing Ling Xi holding the arm of an unfamiliar man so cordially, he faltered for a moment, then revealed a joyful expression, “Father-in-law!”
He had absolute trust in Ling Xi. Thus, to be able to make Ling Xi hold onto his arm without any reservations, who else could it be but Ling Han?
It was not a problem at all for the appearance to not match. Those above Celestial Path could easily change their appearance.
Ling Han nodded. This Fu Tianxing had also advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and his abilities were no weaker than Ling Xi.
He had always had a high opinion of this disciple of his, and Fu Tianxing had not disappointed his expectations either.
After entering the room, Ling Xi couldn’t help but ask Ling Han about his experiences over the years.

Ling Han related some important experiences, then took out a large amount of natural treasures and stuffed them towards the two of them. It was enough to help Ling Xi and her husband charge up to the True Self Tier.
Right at this moment, a commotion was heard from outside.
“The people inside, come out quickly!” someone shouted loudly.
Fu Tianxing faltered for a moment. After entering the Silver Moon Academy with Ling Xi, he had always kept a low profile. Why were they suddenly provoked?
What was going on?
Meanwhile, Ling Xi explained, “Father killed Qi Wuwei!”

“Good kill!” Fu Tianxing immediately clapped his hands, “That b@stard keeps looking at you strangely. Could it be that he wanted to do something to you this time, and Father-in-law just happened to see him?”
His guess was really accurate.
Ling Han stood up, pushed open the doors and walked out.

“You’re the murderer who killed Qi Wuwei?” There were about a dozen over people at the entrance, and the person in the lead was about forty years old. When he saw Ling Han walk out, he immediately shouted.
“Murderer?” Ling Han shook his head, “You have used the wrong word. I am not the murderer.”
En, who else could it be but you?
“That’s him!” Qian Bing hurriedly jumped out, and pointed at Ling Han with his right hand. He emphasized this to the middle-aged man, looking like he was afraid that Ling Han would deny it.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Don’t be excited, don’t be excited. I was indeed the one who killed him, but you should call me the hero who eliminated evil for the people!”

“Good kill!” Fu Tianxing immediately clapped his hands, “That b@stard keeps looking at you strangely.
Could it be that he wanted to do something to you this time, and Father-in-law just happened to see him?”
His guess was really accurate.
Ling Han stood up, pushed open the doors and walked out.
“You’re the murderer who killed Qi Wuwei?” There were about a dozen over people at the entrance, and the person in the lead was about forty years old.
When he saw Ling Han walk out, he immediately shouted.
“Murderer?” Ling Han shook his head, “You have used the wrong word.
I am not the murderer.”
En, who else could it be but you?
“That’s him!” Qian Bing hurriedly jumped out, and pointed at Ling Han with his right hand.
He emphasized this to the middle-aged man, looking like he was afraid that Ling Han would deny it.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Don’t be excited, don’t be excited.
I was indeed the one who killed him, but you should call me the hero who eliminated evil for the people!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4496: Rebels?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hero?
The middle-aged man was furious. Pointing at Ling Han, he asked, “Do you know who Qi Wuwei is?”
“I don’t know,” Ling Han replied with a shake of his head. “I’m not interested either.”
He had killed even the Golden Generation just like that, so who else in the world would he not dare to kill?
Furthermore, to dare covet and threaten his daughter, that was definitely seeking death.

“Qi Wuwei is the only son of Great General Hengtian, Qi Longtu!” the middle-aged man said loudly. “The Great General Hengtian is the strongest general under the Ninth King. You killed Qi Wuwei, and this is a great calamity that you have brought onto yourself!”
At this moment, Qian Bing leaned over and muttered softly.
Hearing these words, the middle-aged man’s expression changed drastically again.

“You’re actually a new student that was only recruited by the academy today?” He was stunned. Being able to insta-kill Qi Wuwei, what need was there for him to be tested? He would definitely be directly recruited.
So, why did he hide his cultivation level when he clearly had such powerful strength? What was his purpose?
Was he deliberately targeting Qi Wuwei?
Or... was he trying to use Qi Wuwei to attack Great General Hengtian, and directly target the Ninth King?

It should be known that though the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had been destroyed for close to a hundred years, there were still some people who had not given up on their evil intentions, and wanted to rebuild it.

“You’re a rebel!” The middle-aged man was certain of Ling Han’s identity. This shocked him greatly, and he hurriedly used Galaxy Network to contact the other leaders of the academy. Perhaps, the person in front of him wasn’t someone he could deal with.

Although he was at the True Self Tier, it was said that there was no shortage of Spiritual Infant Tier cultivators among the rebels. Moreover, Ling Han dared to come alone, and he even dared to publicly commit murder, which proved that he was confident in his own strength.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “When did I become a rebel? You’re really funny!”
He paused for a moment, then continued, “If there’s nothing important, then kneel down.”
Kneel your sister!
The middle-aged man naturally couldn’t kneel. He was a leader of the academy, and from a certain aspect, he also represented the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. How could he kneel in front of rebels?
“Don’t be arrogant. The Great General Hengtian has already received the news, and will arrive soon,” he said darkly.
“Oh.” Ling Han nodded, killing intent flashing through his eyes.
If this Great General Hengtian also shouted about killing and fighting as soon as he arrived, then he would just kill one more person.
Right at this moment, a dozen over people were seen rapidly approaching from afar.

“Who killed my cousin!” Among these people, the leader was a man in embroidered robes. He was dignified and authoritative, and also had an indescribable murderous aura, intimidating people just by looking at him. However, a young man rushed out and shouted at Ling Han.
The middle-aged man from the academy turned around to glance at him. He hurriedly clasped his hands and said, “Greetings, General Liu.”

The leading man in fine clothes was a fierce general under the command of the Great General Hengtian. His surname was Liu, and his name was Luo. Though they were both in the True Self Tier, he had battled his whole life, and his battle prowess had been adequately tempered through actual battle. If the two of them were to exchange blows, he would probably be killed within ten moves.
Moreover, his status was higher than his, so even if their cultivation levels were similar, he still appeared very respectful.
Liu Luo nodded, and his eyes fell on Ling Han. As a general who had experienced hundreds of battles, his insight was naturally good. With a single glance, he had set his eyes on Ling Han.
However, he frowned. He actually couldn’t see through Ling Han’s cultivation level.
Could it be that this brat’s cultivation level was superior to his?
Impossible!
How old was this boy? No matter how talented he was, how could he have advanced to the level of Spirit Transformation True Lord at such a young age?
Thus, he immediately suppressed the little bit of unease in his heart.
The young man from before was extremely lively. In any case, there were several True Self Tier elites here, so what did he have to fear?
“You’re dead! You’re dead!” He pointed at Ling Han, and said, “You actually dared to kill my cousin! Humph! How audacious!”
Though he was rebuking angrily, there was an indescribable joy in his heart.

Because there were very few members of the Qi Clan, aside from Qi Wuwei, he was the only other member of this generation. Now that Qi Wuwei was dead, wouldn’t he become the focused target of nurturing?

For a long time, he wanted nothing more than for something to happen to Qi Wuwei. He wanted nothing more than for Qi Wuwei to die young, but he could only dream about it. He did not dare make any move at all.
Unexpectedly, his daydream had actually come true.
So how could he not be overjoyed?
How could he not be elated?
Ling Han glanced at him, and said with a smile, “Looking at your secretly pleased expression, you’ve long since wanted Qi Wuwei to die, right?”
F***, how could you tell?
The young man was shocked, but it was naturally impossible for him to admit it. Hurriedly, he said, “Nonsense! I have a close brotherhood with Wuwei, and want nothing more than to die on his behalf!”
Ling Han smiled, and said, “It’s impossible for you to die in his place. However, I can do you a good deed, and send you to the underworld to accompany this cousin of yours.”
This, you are too arrogant, aren’t you? There are so many elites here!
Liu Luo’s expression was also cold, as he said, “Young man, you are too arrogant! With me here, aside from kneeling down to accept your death, there is nothing else you can do!”
He was about to make a move!
Qian Bing was extremely expectant. Though Qi Wuwei had been insta-killed by Ling Han with a single move from Ling Han, this General Liu was a True Self Tier elite, and that was definitely different.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “I’ll kill him, and you can try and stop me.”
The young man from the Qi Clan was truly arrogant. He placed his hands on his hips and said, “I’ll stand here and not move. Let’s see how you’ll kill me!”
With several elites standing guard, how could it be that they would just sit by and watch?
Ling Han stretched out a finger, and very casually flicked his finger. A strong force shot towards that young man from the Qi Clan.
“How dare you!” Liu Luo was furious, and sent out a palm strike, intending to destroy this force.
However, when the palm swept past, that force was completely unaffected.
What!
With a ‘pu’, the strong force had already penetrated through the head of the young man from the Qi Clan.
The young man looked at Ling Han in disbelief. Even now, he still couldn’t believe that he was really going to die.
How was this possible? Impossible!
If he had known... he wouldn’t have put on such airs.
The last thought flashed through his mind. Then, he collapsed to the ground, dead.
Seeing this scene, a great many people inhaled sharply.
Hiss, just how strong was this guy?
If he wanted to kill someone, even True Self Tier elites wouldn’t be able to stop him?
Qian Bing’s legs were trembling, and he was sweating profusely.
He was scared to death.
Even True Self Tier elites couldn’t stop Ling Han; just how strong was this guy?
He actually dared to tattletale and report the news, and was even jumping around happily in front of Ling Han. He was really tired of living.
He was about to cry. ‘You’re so awesome, so why do you have to impersonate some new student?’
After a long while, Liu Luo finally recovered. He stared at Ling Han, and asked, “Who exactly are you, sir?”
This was very likely a Spirit Transformation True Lord!

Though it was practically unimaginable that there was such a young Spirit Transformation True Lord would, this was the only possibility. Otherwise, his attack just now would have affected the force he delivered, and not be completely ineffective.

chapters.title: Chapter 4497: This is what killing intent is
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han still hadn’t answered, and he raised his head to look at the sky.
Xiu, a figure tore through the air and arrived, then suddenly landed on the ground.
A frightening killing intent boiled, as if it was solid, causing one’s heart to tremble in fear.
This was a middle-aged man who was fully dressed in armor. There was also a scar from his left eye to the corner of his lips on his face, which added a hint of toughness to his appearance.
He wore a bright red cloak that billowed in the night wind, his divine might awe-inspiring.
Great General Hengtian, Qi Longtu.
“Greetings, Great General!” Instantly, those people from the academy, including Liu Luo, all knelt down in front of Qi Longtu.
This was... a Spirit Transformation True Lord!
Spirit Transformation Tier—no matter where they were, they were qualified to be called elites and have respected status.
Qi Longtu raised his hand, indicating for everyone to stand up. His eyes were fixed on Ling Han.
What he saw gave him a shock.
He actually couldn’t see through Ling Han.
How was this possible?
This young man’s vitality was exuberant, and his life force was astonishing. He was truly young, and could only be a few hundred years old.
However, he was only a few hundred years old, yet he was already able to cultivate to the Spiritual Transformation Tier and become his equal?

If Chen Fengyan were to find out about this, he would definitely say in a leisurely manner that it was impossible for them to be on equal footing. In fact, it would be impossible for them to be on equal footing in this lifetime.
“Who would’ve thought? You’re so young, yet you’ve already reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier!” Qi Longtu said in a dignified voice.
Everyone was shocked. What? Ling Han was actually a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite!
Others might have seen wrongly, but how could the Great General Hengtian have seen wrongly?
Heavens, such a young Spiritual Transformation Tier elite?
“However, do you think that just because you have cultivated to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, you can strut around in our Empire?” Qi Longtu couldn’t help but laugh coldly, “Too naive!”

Though this was a subsidiary planet of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, it was a very important subsidiary planet. That was why they had sent the Ninth King to stand guard here. That was a Sect Master-level elite, and Six Stars at that!
With the Ninth King keeping watch, all demons and monsters would have to retreat.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Since the main culprit is here, let’s have a chat! Your son does evil, and I’m exterminating evil for the people. How do you plan to thank me?”
W-what?
Everyone was dumbfounded, and couldn’t help but grin.
What kind of joke was this?
You killed his son, and still want him to thank you?
Crazy, he must have gone crazy!

Qi Longtu sneered repeatedly, “Young man, I admit that your natural talent in martial arts is astonishing. You have cultivated to the Spiritual Transformation Tier at such a young age. However, the result of rapid cultivation would definitely be an unstable foundation!”
“I’ve killed tens of thousands of people, and all of them are elites. Can you block such killing intent alone?”
His expression suddenly became stern. Boom, a surging killing intent surged out, instantly causing the knees of the people in the surroundings to go weak, and they all collapsed onto the ground.
This was too terrifying; this was the God of Slaughter!
However, this killing intent was negligible to Ling Han. He shook his head, and said with a smile, “Is this your killing intent?”
Qi Longtu was startled. Yi, why was it completely ineffective against Ling Han?
He was experienced on the battlefield, and his killing intent was almost tangible. Under his barrage, cultivators at the same cultivation level would definitely be affected.
“You!” He stared at Ling Han, and a coldness suddenly rose up in his heart.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Then you can also test out my killing intent.”
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura shot out.
Qi Longtu’s mind was instantly destroyed, and his eyes also dilated in an instant. There was no longer any spirit left in them.
Peng, he fell headfirst onto the ground. His blood-red cloak was still fluttering slightly, but it was difficult to show his heroic bearing on the battlefield again.
A dead silence fell.
The Great General Hengtian, the strongest general under the Ninth King, died just like that?
It was so easy, and there was no intense battle at all. He had died without a sound?
This! This, this, this, this!
Everyone was scared out of their wits, especially Qian Bing. Not only did his legs go weak, he even lost control of his bladder, and his eyes had also become clouded.
“Hahaha!” He suddenly laughed loudly, “I am invincible in this world! I am the Great Emperor Peerless!”
He suddenly got to his feet, and as he danced, he continued to run madly.
Crazy, he had actually gone mad from fear.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Everyone, the show is over, so what are you still gathered here for? Do you want me to treat you guys to supper?”
Subconsciously, everyone shook their heads.
What supper? At present, they only wanted to get as far away from this bringer of calamity as possible.

They hadn’t left before, firstly, because it had been too sudden, and have still yet to recover from their shock. Secondly, they didn’t dare to leave. Ling Han could insta-kill a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and if he didn’t say a word, who would dare to leave?
Now that Ling Han had spoken up to let them go, they naturally all hurriedly stood up and broke into a run.
Ling Han shot out a few streaks of flames, burning the corpses on the ground completely. What treasures could these people have on them? He couldn’t even be bothered to collect them.
After returning to his room, he began to teach his daughter and son-in-law various Imperial Techniques.
He had clearly done something huge, but the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire actually didn’t react at all. In the following three days, everything was calm and undisturbed. Not a single person came.

The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire obviously wouldn’t cower just like that. Instead, Ling Han was too strong, making them feel like they needed to make full preparations before making a move and killing him with a single strike.
Right now, a storm was brewing.
The academy gates of the Silver Moon Academy had already closed, and all the students had evacuated, to prevent them from becoming cannon fodder in future great battles.
Yet Ling Han was happy with the peace and quiet, and did not care at all.
Even if the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s elites ganged up on him, he was still unafraid. This was because his abilities were strong enough, and that was why he was so confident.

Of course, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was actually a puppet, while the true ruler was actually the Buddhist Race. Thus, what Ling Han needed to be concerned about was only the Buddhist Race. If they really did indeed mobilized a great elite of Venerate Tier-level, then even he could only flee.

However, this was only the beginning. The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire couldn’t possibly send a Buddhist Race’s big shot so quickly. It should be known that when they ambushed the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s old Venerate Tier, the Buddhist Race didn’t send out a Venerate Tier elite.
—If the Buddhist Race’s great elites attacked at the drop of a hat, then with so many territories under their control, wouldn’t they be busy to death?
Soon, it was the eighth day.
Ling Han was just predicting his own path of cultivation with eyes closed, when his eyes suddenly snapped open.
‘Finally here.’
He pushed open the doors and walked out.
There was a man in embroidered robes standing in front of him, wearing a flat crown on his head. He was tall and slender, and had an air of dominance.
Behind him, there were nine people dressed in monk robes. There were both men and women, and they had all shaved their heads. There were nine brands on each of their heads.
Oh, the Buddhist Racehad also moved.
“I am the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s Ninth King!” The man in embroidered robes spoke up, his voice resounding loudly, “Who are you?”
Ling Han sighed, “Don’t you know how to talk nicely?1”
The Ninth King’s aura was instantly stifled. ‘What kind of person are you? I’m asking you in the most formal manner.’
“Who is the mastermind behind you?” He suppressed his anger, and switched to a different tone of voice.
Ling Han was too young, so there was definitely someone backing him up. This was what made him wary.

Now that Ling Han had spoken up to let them go, they naturally all hurriedly stood up and broke into a run.
Ling Han shot out a few streaks of flames, burning the corpses on the ground completely.
What treasures could these people have on them?
He couldn’t even be bothered to collect them.
After returning to his room, he began to teach his daughter and son-in-law various Imperial Techniques.
He had clearly done something huge, but the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire actually didn’t react at all.
In the following three days, everything was calm and undisturbed.
Not a single person came.
The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire obviously wouldn’t cower just like that.
Instead, Ling Han was too strong, making them feel like they needed to make full preparations before making a move and killing him with a single strike.
Right now, a storm was brewing.
The academy gates of the Silver Moon Academy had already closed, and all the students had evacuated, to prevent them from becoming cannon fodder in future great battles.
Yet Ling Han was happy with the peace and quiet, and did not care at all.
Even if the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s elites ganged up on him, he was still unafraid.
This was because his abilities were strong enough, and that was why he was so confident.
Of course, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was actually a puppet, while the true ruler was actually the Buddhist Race.
Thus, what Ling Han needed to be concerned about was only the Buddhist Race.
If they really did indeed mobilized a great elite of Venerate Tier-level, then even he could only flee.
However, this was only the beginning.
The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire couldn’t possibly send a Buddhist Race’s big shot so quickly.
It should be known that when they ambushed the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s old Venerate Tier, the Buddhist Race didn’t send out a Venerate Tier elite.
—If the Buddhist Race’s great elites attacked at the drop of a hat, then with so many territories under their control, wouldn’t they be busy to death?
Soon, it was the eighth day.
Ling Han was just predicting his own path of cultivation with eyes closed, when his eyes suddenly snapped open.
‘Finally here.’
He pushed open the doors and walked out.
There was a man in embroidered robes standing in front of him, wearing a flat crown on his head.
He was tall and slender, and had an air of dominance.
Behind him, there were nine people dressed in monk robes.
There were both men and women, and they had all shaved their heads.
There were nine brands on each of their heads.
Oh, the Buddhist Racehad also moved.
“I am the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s Ninth King!” The man in embroidered robes spoke up, his voice resounding loudly, “Who are you?”
Ling Han sighed, “Don’t you know how to talk nicely?1”
The Ninth King’s aura was instantly stifled.
‘What kind of person are you?
I’m asking you in the most formal manner.’
“Who is the mastermind behind you?” He suppressed his anger, and switched to a different tone of voice.
Ling Han was too young, so there was definitely someone backing him up.
This was what made him wary.

chapters.title: Chapter 4498: Venerate Tier Killing Formation
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han nodded, “You see, talking like this doesn’t sound like much effort. So, you obviously know how to talk nicely, so why do you have to be so pretentious?”
The Ninth King began to grind hisr teeth again. ‘You mock me when I’m talking formally, but when I’m talking normally, you still mock me.’
What exactly do you want?
Yi, the other was deliberately diverting the topic!
The Ninth King immediately tensed; he almost fell for Ling Han’s trick.
Hiss, this brat looked young, but his ways were really too shrewd. He had quietly changed the topic.
“Looks like you are determined to force me to make a move!” the Ninth King said calmly.
Ling Han spread out his hands, “If I told you that I have actually come in peace, would you believe me?”
“Haha!” The Ninth King simply laughed coldly.
Would he believe it? How could he possibly believe it!

Ling Han laughed loudly, “If you don’t believe me, then forget it. Since you have even invited the members of the Buddhist Race, it is clear that there is no way that things would be settled peacefully. Then what is the point of continuing the pointless nonsense? Hurry up and make your move.”

“You really won’t give up until you’re faced with the grim reality!” The Ninth King sneered. With a wave of his hand, those monks behind him stepped into the sky one after another, each standing in nine corners. Then, they began to recite.
Instantly, a pillar of light rose from the Ninth King’s body, soaring into the skies. His aura had actually increased greatly.
The secret technique of the Buddhist Race, praying which could greatly increase the strength of the recipient.
The Ninth King was originally a six-star Sect Master, and after receiving such a boost, his aura actually increased to eight stars inconceivably!
A whopping two stars; this was far too astonishing.
The Ninth King moved, and shot out a palm strike. True enough, Eight Star power was boiling, but the Regulations that he shot out were only six streaks.
Ling Han nodded. This was more like it. If the secret technique of the Buddhist Racee could allow the Ninth King to blast out seven flashes of Regulations, that would really be too amazing.
At the level of Sect Master, power was far inferior to Regulations.

Thus, while the Ninth King looked to have reached eight stars in battle prowess, in truth, he only had power. In terms of true battle prowess, it could only increase his battle prowess by half a star, at most, and not even reach seven stars.

Ling Han shook his head. At first, he had thought that the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’ had prepared for so long, and would come up with some kind of great trick, but from the look of things now, it really disappointed him.

“You’ve put on an act for so many days, and you’re only going to show me this?” Ling Han shook his head, and his aura fluctuated slightly. Pa, pa, pa! In the sky, the nine monks instantly fell down like kites with their strings cut.
The Ninth King paled in shock. What was going on?
He hurriedly attacked Ling Han, giving the nine monks time to recover, so they could pull themselves together and once again boost his power.
Ling Han casually parried. The Ninth King was only a six-star Sect Master, so even if he reduced his abilities by a hundred times, he probably wouldn’t be weaker than him.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The battle between the two of them seemed to be very intense, but it was only the Ninth King that thought so himself. He wasn’t even qualified to make Ling Han take it seriously.
However, after battling for a short while, the Ninth King feinted and left the battle area, retreating far away.
“Activate the formation!” he called out loudly, his expression livid.
This was the last move, and it was one that he very much did not want to use. This meant that he was inferior to Ling Han.
However, there was nothing he could do. He couldn’t keep fighting like this, after all.
Boom! Multiple streaks of light soared into the sky, intertwining to form an Inescapable Net.
“Haha, you’re surrounded now, so let’s see how you’re going to escape!” the Ninth King said coldly.
This was the Trapped Heaven Formation, which could kill a Sect Master great elite.

There was too little time, and furthermore, there was only the little bit of resources that the Moonlight Planet had, which was not enough to set up a killing formation to snipe a Venerate Tier elite.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, and merely smiled. To fiddle with formations in front of a formation grandmaster like him, wasn’t that just making him laugh his head off?

He only had to step lightly with his foot, and he would be able to change the Earth Qi, rendering this great formation ineffective. In fact, he could even seize control of the great formation, and turn it around to attack the Ninth King.
Ai, just think, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s elite was only a Sect Master, so what could they offer that would make his eyes light up?
‘Boring!’
He threw a punch. Boom! The ground trembled violently, and endless sand and rocks flew into the sky. Instantly, the brilliance that soared into the sky dimmed.
The Ninth King couldn’t help but stare with bulging eyes. F***, he had shattered the great formation with a single punch!
Heavens, what kind of monster was this?

He could clearly sense that Ling Han’s aura was also Sect Master-level, but as a fellow Sect Master, to say nothing of destroying the great formation with a single strike, even being able to last over a hundred moves under the great formation was already quite impressive.
In comparison, the gap was really too wide.
This guy could not be judged on the level of an ordinary Sect Master. He could only be treated like a Pseudo Venerate Tier.
En, just like that old Venerate Tier from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
“Retreat!” he shouted lightly, and led the others away.

Ling Han didn’t give chase. He wanted to do Chen Fengyan a favor, and defeat a few more elites from the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. In this way, when Chen Fengyan led the Celestial Sea Planet to become independent, they wouldn’t be able to do much either.
No matter what, Chen Fengyan had helped him quite a bit in the past. Moreover, he was his junior now, so he naturally had to take care of him.

He continued to guide Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing in their cultivation. It could be imagined that he would definitely have to run all over the universe next, and would not have the time to guide his children in their cultivation. Thus, he had to make the most of every minute and second he had now.
He stuffed as much as he could, not caring about their cultivation level at all.
A dozen over days later, the elites of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire quietly arrived at the Moonlight Planet.

There were a total of nine Sect Master elites, and added with the Buddhist Race having also mobilized five elites, there were a total of fourteen Sect Masters, and the true killing move was the formation that they had brought, which could form a great killing formation to snipe a Venerate Tier!
Ling Han grasped everything through the ley lines. He was still unafraid.

Indeed, he was no match for the battle prowess of a Venerate Tier elite. However, in terms of formation masters, how could Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s people compare to him, a formation grandmaster?
Just how powerful was his divine sense now? With a single thought, he could affect the ley lines. And they wanted set up a formation in front of him?
Hehe, unless it was a Saint-level formation, they would only be a joke in front of him.
Thus, Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
The Sect Master elites began to set up formations. Every day, they would wander around the surroundings of the Silver Moon Academy.

Though Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing were a little worried, they believed Ling Han even more. Since Ling Han didn’t take this seriously at all, he must be confident in himself. Could it be that he would still screw over his daughter and son-in-law?
Seven days later, the formation was completed!
At this time, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s elites finally strutted out.

“Young man, you are indeed courageous beyond measure.” The Ninth King appeared once more. His status was very high, and even if fourteen more Sect Masters came, they still treated him as their leader, “However, it is precisely this kind of conceit that will endanger your life!”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “We haven’t even fought yet, and you’re already so sure?”

“Humph, though this formation is not a complete Venerate Tier-level killing formation, killing a Pseudo Venerate is no issue.” The Ninth King declared proudly, “Don’t tell me, your strength has already surpassed Sect Master-level!”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Not to that extent. I am still a little far from even Pseudo Venerate Tier.”

“Thus, if you bow your head now, I can still spare your life. Otherwise... no matter how prodigious you are, so what? The name of a dead person will not be passed down through the ages!” the Ninth King stated calmly.
Boom!
Right at this moment, the great formation suddenly trembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 4499: The old Venerate Tier elite appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The ground trembled, and the formation swayed, as if it had suffered a heavy blow.
This not only stunned the Ninth King and the others, even Ling Han was slightly surprised.
What was going on? He clearly hadn’t made a move.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The terrifying blasts came one after another, and they were getting closer and closer. It was as if someone had forcefully charged in.
This wasn’t an illusion. It was only an instant. Peng! The last layer of light that enshrouded them shattered, and an old man with white brows and a white beard charged over.
“Gagaga, Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s brats, never thought I’d return!” The old man laughed loudly, showing a kind of arrogance.
This!
Seeing this old man, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s elites all wore expressions of shock.
Heavens, this was the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s old Venerate Tier elite!
Ling Han was also very surprised. He had not thought that this old Venerate would actually dare make a comeback.
He could clearly sense that this Venerate Tier elite hadn’t fully recovered yet. It was just that his injuries had been suppressed.
Who was helping him?

Ling Han didn’t think that this Venerate Tier elite could do it himself. He hadn’t been able to do it in the past tens of thousands of years, so what allowed him to do it after fleeing for just a short while?
Thus, he must have obtained the help of someone, or some force.
“You actually aren’t dead yet!” the Ninth King said through gritted teeth. There was a look of intense fear on his face.

At the time, they had taken advantage of the fact that the old Venerate Tier was heavily injured, and laid out an inescapable net, which was why they had been fortunate enough to attack this old Venerate Tier to the point that his injuries would be compounded.

At first, he had thought that even if this old Venerate Tier elite had not died from serious injuries, he should still be licking his wounds in some corner of the universe. However, he had not thought that this old Venerate Tier elite would suddenly charge right up to his doorstep.
It was as if he had completely recovered his abilities.
This was a Venerate Tier elite, completely suppressinga Sect Master, so how were they supposed to resist?
“How is this possible?!”
The old Venerate Tier elite laughed loudly, “Nothing is impossible! Now that I’m back, you guys can also go die!”
He was very proud. At first, he had thought that there would be no hope of revenge in this lifetime, but now, he had returned here, looking down on all life with overwhelming strength.

“Let’s go! Let’s go! Let’s go!” the Ninth King called out loudly. To say nothing of the fact that they only had fifteen Sect Masters, even if their numbers were ten times more, they would still be no match for a Venerate Tier.
Venerate Tier could crush Sect Master; this was the truth of martial arts.
“Want to run?” The old Venerate Tier smirked coldly. Since he had appeared, how could he allow the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s people to flee?
He moved, and grabbed out at the Ninth King and the others.
Boom, his palm blotted out the sky and covered the earth, as far as the eye could see.
He was a Venerate Tier elite!

However, as soon as he made his move, Ling Han discovered that not only had this old Venerate Tier not recovered from his injuries, his strength was also far from recovering. Now, this old Venerate Tier only had Pseudo Venerate Tier-level battle prowess.

However, to suppress a Sect Master, the battle prowess of a Pseudo Venerate Tier was more than enough. In fact, no matter how heaven-defying Ling Han was, his current was no match for his current battle prowess was still not enough to compare to this.

The old Venerate Tier elite attacked aggressively. Pa, pa, pa! He moved with hatred, and killed a Sect Master with a single strike. In just a few minutes, including the Ninth King, the 15 Sect Masters were all killed.
“Hahaha!” The old Venerate was extremely pleased with himself. He had finally gotten his revenge!
Now, he only had to kill the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s old emperor, and he would have avenged himself completely.
“En?” He looked towards Ling Han, an abnormally young Sect Master.
He was really too young. His flame of life was blazing fiercely; at most, he was only a few hundred years old.
What cultivation level had he reached when he was a few hundred years old?
Cauldron Forging Tier? Or Core Formation Tier?

He couldn’t help but be filled with jealousy. Though he was fortunate enough not to die, his vitality was too poor. Even if his injuries were healed, there was no hope for him to reach Saint Tier in this lifetime.
But this brat in front of him was filled with unlimited possibilities.
“Brat, who are you?” he asked, his tone filled with command.
It could not be helped. He was a Venerate Tier elite.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “None of your business.”
Yi, so aggressive!
The old Venerate Tier was astonished. This brat actually dared to speak to him like this?
This was natural. He was the one who had suppressed Brother Monkey, so how could Ling Han possibly show him goodwill?
“You’re truly seeking death!” The old Venerate Tier elite humphed, and immediately moved, pressing down on Ling Han.

Xiu, Ling Han used the Star Steps, bringing Ling Xi and Fu Tianxing with him. In an instant, they had arrived at the other side of the Moonlight Planet. Then, he had them directly use the Transfer Formation to return to Celestial Sea Planet.
After doing all this, he used the Star Steps and returned to the Silver Moon Academy.
The old Venerate Tier frowned upon seeing this. Ling Han appeared and disappeared in quick succession, and even he couldn’t detect his movements.
What kind of movement technique was this? It was too strange.
“So you have grasped a strange movement technique. No wonder you dare to be disrespectful in front of me.” He humphed, “But if I really wanted to kill you, where would you be able to escape to?”
He moved again.
This time, the large hand covered a wider area.
Ling Han brandished his fists in response, “Old b@stard, do you really think I’m afraid of you?”
Just now, he only did not want his daughter and son-in-law to be implicated; it was not that he was afraid of battle.
Seeing that Ling Han actually dared to face him head-on, the old Venerate Tier couldn’t help but feel angry. This was a great disrespect to him!
“Die!” he humphed lightly. A mere Sect Master, have you gone blind? You actually dare to confront him head-on.
Boom!
The fist landed on the large hand, but was unable to break through the large hand. Instead, it was suppressed.
The giant palm slammed into the ground, causing the ground to tremble like a carpet. Peng, peng, peng! Underground flames gushed out, leaking energy.
This was only an ordinary planet, so how could it withstand the havoc caused by the battle prowess of a Pseudo Venerate Tier elite?
The old Venerate Tier couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise, because he could sense that Ling Han wasn’t dead.
He retracted his palm. True enough, though he had created a massive pit in the ground, Ling Han was still standing proudly in the pit.
Hiss, this was too shocking.
Though his abilities had fallen below the level of Venerate Tier, it was still a piece of cake for him to kill any Sect Master, so how had Ling Han managed to withstand it?
“Old b@stard, you’re nothing more than this!” Ling Han said calmly. With a battle cry, he launched a counterattack.
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura surged out, ruthlessly blasting outwards.
That old Venerate Tier couldn’t help but let out a muffled groan. He felt as if an awl had been stabbed into his head, and it was extremely painful.
What a terrifying young man. The divine sense attack was actually effective on him!
He hurriedly spread out his divine sense to stabilize his mind. Then, he raised an attack to counter Ling Han’s attack.
However, in this manner, his battle prowess was naturally greatly affected.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han was once again sent flying, but his disadvantage was no longer very obvious.

“You’re truly astonishing!” the old Venerate Tier elite said balefully. He launched a flurry of attacks at Ling Han. His palms were like axes, and it was as if he wanted to split heaven and earth apart with each strike.
In truth, his attack had indeed had a very great effect on the Moonlight Planet. A Pseudo Venerate was really too powerful.
However, Ling Han was still unafraid. That old Venerate could only use 20 Six Star Regulations, which was stronger than him, but it was still not enough to make him not dare to even battle.
Moreover, he had countless trump cards, so he was naturally unafraid.
This was just right. He could use the other party to temper his own path of cultivation.
Ling Han used the Han Fists. Fist intent blazed, each punch incredibly domineering.
